# How to use WABA templates in Bitrix24 automation rules and Business Processes

WhatsApp Business API templates can be automatically sent by [automation rules](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/add-an-automation-en/) and [Business Processes](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/how-to-send-a-message-to-whatsapp-from-business-processes/) on an event. For example, when a deal moves to the next stage of the funnel. So you can write to the client first and respond to his messages.

To submit a WABA template via Business Processes, [use our activity](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/how-to-send-a-message-to-whatsapp-from-business-processes/). There you can select a template from the list and not bother with the code.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/waba-in-activity.png)

To add a WABA template [to the automation rule](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/add-an-automation-en/), you need its code. The code will appear in your account when the template passes moderation:

1\. To send a template, copy its code [in the “Templates” section](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/templates?tab=api&utm_source=help&utm_medium=instruction&utm_campaign=en&utm_content=how-to-use-WABA-templates-in-Bitrix24-automation-rules) of your Wazzup account. Select the desired template in the list, click the edit button → copy the code.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bgselected-area-21-2.png)

2\. Then insert the code instead of the message text.

### Text template without variables

The code for the template looks like this: 2a6b105a-54d6-4a2b-9749-1a75188b102e { }

You don't need to change anything in it: just copy and add. You don't need to add anything to the template either — then the message won't go away.

### Template with variables

The code for the template with variables looks like this:![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Dizajn-bez-nazvaniya-8.png)

You need to fill them with text:

1. Remove the text "headerVarN", "bodyVarN" inside the square brackets. Leave the brackets themselves as they are.
2. Leave the cursor inside the brackets and type your text. The result should look like this: \[\[good text\]\].

### Template with media

To attach media, add a link to the file instead of "headerContentUrl". Use a direct link to the file. Those links that lead to Google Drive, Dropbox or other cloud storage will not work.

**How to prepare a link to an attachment:**

1\. Send the file via Wazzup chat to your or your client's number. The service will process the file and assign a link to it.

2\. Right-click on the picture → copy the URL of the picture.

It will look something like this: https://store.wazzup24.com/c4d2f98d9b3d75d1a8e8d760343c26cc66495ea4

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/media-e1675970794467.png)

Make sure the link works and leads to the right file. If there is a bad link in the template - the message will not be sent. In the deal card it will be displayed as an error message and in Wazzup chats it will be shown with a red cross.

You can add only the media type that you chose when you created the template. For example, if you agreed on a template with an image, and attach only pictures you won't be able to send a video or document.

If you need to check what type of media you can attach to the message, go to WABA Templates → click the "pencil" in the template line → see the type in the template header.

### Template with buttons: how to fill in the variable in the link

The button itself already has part of the link prescribed. So instead of "buttonVarN" add only the missing part of the link from the Bitrix24 field in brackets.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/ssylka-v-peremennoj-e1675970825257.png)

1. Remove the text "buttonVarN" inside the square brackets. Leave the brackets themselves as they are.
2. Leave the cursor inside the brackets and add the missing part of the link. The result should look like this: \[\[how-to-set-up/how-to-add-a-waba-template/\]\].

The example of what the completed template might look like if it contains variables:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/zapolnennyj-shablon.png)

Here in the first variable is the link to the picture. The second variable will be filled in with a client name from the CRM field. The third one contains the word “tomorrow”.

3\. Done! The client will receive the text of the selected WABA template.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to write first from Bitrix

Here we tell you how to write first manually on WhatsApp, Telegram and Viber. But we also have articles on how to write to a client automatically using [automation rules](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/add-an-automation-en/) and [Business Processes](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/how-to-send-a-message-to-whatsapp-from-business-processes/).

#### From Wazzup Chat

1\. Go to the deal card and enter the contact’s phone number.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If you write first on Telegram, we recommend writing by username. If you write to the number first more than once every three minutes, Telegram may temporarily ban you for suspicious activity. And you can write as much as you like by username

To write by username, in the contact card, fill in the TelegramUsername\_WZ field with the account name via @. For example, @Wazzup\_support\_bot

2\. Click on the “Wazzup” button on the top menu bar.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/VZ-iz-kartochki.png)

3\. A chat with the client will open. If the seller has multiple numbers available, the chat will be created from [the sales rep’s priority number](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/configure-additional-settings-for-integration-with-bitrix24/).

If you need to write from another number: click on the arrow next to the contact’s name in the chat list → create a chat from the desired number by clicking the “+ Create dialogue” button.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-akkordeon-6.png)

4\. Write and send a message.

5\. Done — you have created a dialogue and wrote first.

#### From Bitrix24 chat

Bitrix24 chat is in the comments to the deal.

1\. Go to the deal card. In the menu in the comments, select the action “SMS / WhatsApp” → click the “More” button with an underscore.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Group-623.png)

2\. Specify Wazzup in the “using” line.

In the line, you can select only the type of channel from which the message will leave — WhatsApp, Telegram or Viber. You cannot select a specific number. If the seller has more than one number available, the message will be sent from [the priority channel](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/configure-additional-settings-for-integration-with-bitrix24/).

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Group-627.png)

3\. Enter your message text.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Group-624.png)

You can add an attachment to it, but only by link. For this:

a) Prepare a link to the file. Send the file via Wazzup chat to your number or customer number. The service will process the file and assign a link to it.

b) Right click on the image → copy the URL of the image.

c) Add a link to the message. Enclose all links in square brackets \[ \]. It will turn out like this:

\[ [https://store.wazzup24.com/c4d2f98d9b3d75d1a8e8d760343c26cc66495ea4](https://store.wazzup24.com/c4d2f98d9b3d75d1a8e8d760343c26cc66495ea4)\]

4\. Click “Send” — the message will go to the client. It will be displayed in the comments to the card and Wazzup chats.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

It is better to write to new clients in Telegram no more than once every 3 minutes. Otherwise, Telegram will think that you write suspiciously often, and [may block you for a while](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/how-to-avoid-being-blocked-on-telegram/)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to write to Telegram if a client doesn’t have WhatsApp

If a Business Process (BP) could not send a message to a customer in WhatsApp because the number does not have the messenger – the BP can send a message in Telegram. To do this, configure the BP to send it when a 405 error arrives. How to do it:

1\. Go to “Settings” → “Automation” → “CRM Settings”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Place-your-screen-6.png)

2\. Click “Automation” → “Business Processes” on the left.

3\. Select the entity with which the business process will work: lead, contact, deal, company, etc.

In our example, this is “Deal” → “➕ Add Template”.

4. Check the “When added” checkbox under “Autorun” → go to the “Variables” tab and click “Add Variable”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-obshhie-nastrojki.png)

5\. Fill in the two lines in the expanded window: “Name” and “ID”. You can enter any values in Latin. Leave the variable type as String:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/peremennaya.png)

Click “OK” and then “Save”.

6\. Click on the triangle between “Start” and “End” → “Application Actions” → “\[WAZZUP\] Automatic sending of template messages”:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bgselected-area-12.png)

7\. Press the gear on the created action. The “Activity Parameters” window will open:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/shesterenka-1.png)

8\. Customize the activity [as instructed](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-send-a-message-to-whatsapp-from-business-processes/) and add a message that will go to the user.

When a new deal is created, the Business Process will start. If the recipient does not have WhatsApp on the number, Wazzup will return an error 405 to Bitrix, there will be a note with its description in the Workflow log:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-zhurnal.png)

9\. Click on the triangle between the Wazzup activity and the “End” → “Other” → “Set variables” button:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/set-variables.png)

10\. Click on the gear on the “Set Variables” action:

11\. Make sure that the same variable you created is selected in the drop-down menu. Next to this line, click the three dot button:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-tri-tochki.png)

12\. Click the “Additional Results” link in the window that opens → “\[WAZZUP\] Automatic sending of template messages” → double-click “…Response code”:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/ad-results.png)

13\. The code in the line with the variable will appear:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-zapmolnen-kod-1.png)

Click “Save”.

14\. Click the triangle below the “Set Variables” → “Flow Control” → “Condition” activity:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-usloviya-1.png)

15\. Click on any of the branches on the gear on “Condition”:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-shesterenka-usloviya.png)

16\. Select “Condition Type” — “Variable Value”, from the drop-down list “Property or Field” — your variable, “Condition” — “equals”, in the “Value” line type “405”. Save.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-usloviya-parametrov.png)

17\. Tap on the triangle below the condition you have configured → “Application actions” and select your application to send SMS.

18\. Press the gear on the created action.

19\. Fill in the fields to send an SMS, enter the text of the message and tap “Save”.

20\. Save the Business Process by clicking the “Save” button in the lower left corner.

Now when creating a deal, a WhatsApp message will be sent to the client, and if he doesn’t have WhatsApp on his number, an SMS will be sent.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Add integration with Bitrix24

Let’s look at how to connect Wazzup to Bitrix24.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

To connect the integration with Wazzup, you need an active subscription to the market in Bitrix24. Before you start setting up, make sure that your subscription is active.

If you have any questions, our [support team](https://wazzup24.com/contact-en/) is always ready to help.

#### Connecting Wazzup to Bitrix24 from the Market

1\. Open your Bitrix24 account. In the left-hand sidebar, go to the “Applications” → “Marketplace” section.

2\. Enter “Wazzup” in the search bar and select Wazzup (WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business API, Telegram, Viber).

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Angl-poisk.png)

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

Only a user with administrator rights for the Bitrix24 account can install the integration. If the account administrator changes, the integration will stop working and will need to be reinstalled.

When changing the domain in the Bitrix24 portal, you must [remove the old integration](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/how-to-remove-bitrix24-integration-en/?_gl=1*1b4junq*_gcl_au*Mzg0ODk3MDk5LjE3MzczNjc5Nzg.*_ga*MTIyODU2MTMxNy4xNzI5NTgzMzI1*_ga_7X6RZSKPXF*MTczNzU0NzcwOS4yMDIuMS4xNzM3NTQ5NTI1LjAuMC4w) in the Wazzup dashboard and then set up a new integration with the updated domain.

3\. In the pop-up window, click “Install”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Angl-instal.png)

4\. Review the information in the window, including the terms of use for the solutions catalog, the license agreement, and the privacy policy. Then click “Install”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Angl-instal-2.png)

5\. Click “Open Application”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Angl-instal-3.png)

6\. The Wazzup personal account will open in Bitrix24. Log in or register in your personal account.

7\. Then go to the “CRM Integration” section and click “Connect”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Angl-instal-4.png)

A new tab will open with a notification confirming a successful connection.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Angl-instal-5.png)

8\. You have successfully connected Wazzup from the Bitrix24 marketplace.

If you haven’t connected messengers yet, you’ll need to do this in [the “Channels” tab](https://app.wazzup24.com/2732-9096/settings/channels/).

To configure integrations, go to the “CRM Integration” section. To ensure everything works correctly — such as deals being routed to the appropriate pipelines, salespeople seeing only their own chats, and managers monitoring their team — [the integration needs to be properly set up](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/bitrix24-integration-settings-en/).

#### How to connect Bitrix24 from Wazzup

1\. Open your Wazzup account and go to the “CRM Integration” section → select “Bitrix24”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/ANGL-vybor-b24.png)

2\. To connect Wazzup to Bitrix24, follow steps 1–5 described above in this article.

- Start by installing the app in the Bitrix24 marketplace.
- After clicking “Open app” in Bitrix24, return to Wazzup.
- Paste the link to your Bitrix24 account, click “Confirm”, and then “Connect”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Ru-shagi-1.png)

3\. After that, a new tab will open with a notification about a successful connection.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

If you have any questions, our [support service](https://wazzup24.com/contact-en/) is always ready to help.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

## Knowledge Base

[Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/)

# How to work with Mexican numbers in Bitrix24

WhatsApp and Bitrix24 have different requirements for the format of Mexican numbers, so there are peculiarities in working with them. We will talk about them further on.

A little background: in Mexico there are 2 formats of phone numbers:

- +521-xx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx -the old format of 13 digits
- +52-xx-xxxxxx-xxxx -a new format of 12 digits

WhatsApp only works [with the full international format](https://faq.whatsapp.com/1294841057948784) that is, the old format in the case of Mexico. Wazzup chats work the same way.

Bitrix24, on the other hand, works with short Mexican numbers.

What these differences affect:

- In Bitrix24, a customer’s Mexican number will be recorded in short format. When you start a chat with this customer, the number will be displayed in Wazzup in long format — this is normal.  A Wazzup chat with a long number will be associated with a contact, Bitrix24 transaction, although in CRM the customer number is in short format.
- In the Wazzup chat window, regardless of the operator, you should search Mexican numbers in long format. If you enter a short number in the search, you will not find anything.
- You can create a new dialog in Wazzup only with a number in long format. In Bitrix24 this number will be pulled up in short format.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Notifications about incoming messages in Bitrix24

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If the channel is connected to Bitrix24 Open Channels, incoming message notifications will not be sent to the chat bot.

On the right panel of Bitrix24 there is a chat with the Wazzup bot – notifications about new messages come to it. The chat is created automatically when you install the Wazzup application.

👉 [Add integration with Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/integration-with-bitrix24-en/?_gl=1*9hx7s1*_gcl_au*NTM4MzM3NDMyLjE3Mjk1ODMzMjUuMTc0NjgxMjE2NC4xNzM1MTI1MTMyLjE3MzUxMjUxMzE.*_ga*MTIyODU2MTMxNy4xNzI5NTgzMzI1*_ga_7X6RZSKPXF*MTczNjc1OTQwMC4xNzEuMC4xNzM2NzU5NDAwLjAuMC4w)

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2021-05-24_18-15-58-1-1024x410.png)

Notifications from the bot will be sent to those responsible for the contact, lead or deal. If no responsible person is assigned, all managers who have the slider “Receives new clients” enabled in p. 1 of the [integration settings](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations/) “Select employee roles” will receive a notification about the message.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Angl-Chat-1.png)

If the option “Notify employees with the “Manager” role on all messages” is enabled in paragraph 3 of the additional integration settings, notifications will also be sent to all employees with the “Manager” role.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Angl-Chat-2.png)

#### How does the notification chat work?

Only clients with unread messages are displayed in the chat. Once a client is answered, their line will disappear from the list. If no answer is required, click “No need to answer” in the chat with the client to reset the notification. Then the line with the client will disappear from the notification chat and will not distract anyone.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Angl-Chat.png)

#### How to disable chatbot

In the “CRM Integration” section, under the “More” tab, you need to disable setting “Notify about new messages in the Bitrix24 chat bot“.

If the setting is disabled, employees will only see incoming messages in the Wazzup widget — the Bitrix24 bot won’t send anything. Therefore, if sales reps check conversations occasionally, it’s better to enable notifications via the chatbot to immediately know about new messages.

This setting applies to each chat user. If the chatbot is disabled but the additional setting in section 3 is active, employees with the “Manager” role will still receive notifications about all incoming messages, but only in the widget.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# What to do if Wazzup chat is not displayed

In Bitrix24, you can configure which of the employees will be shown the general Wazzup chat, and who will not. Add all employees if you want the general Wazzup chat to be displayed for everyone.

#### If the integration is added through the marketplace

1\. Go to the “Applications” tab on the left panel of Bitrix24.

2\. Go to the “Installed” section on the top panel.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/1-en-2.png)

3\. Find Wazzup in the list.

4\. Click “Access permissions” to the right of the “Delete” button.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2-en-2-1024x273.png)

5\. Select the employees who want to share the chat. The right column will display the employees who have been granted access.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/3-en-1.png)

The employees you have added in the settings will have a Wazzup tab on the left panel of Bitrix24. If the tab does not appear in the left pane, you can [add it manually](https://wazzup24.com/help/the-wazzup-button-is-not-displayed-in-bitrix24-en/).

#### If the integration is added manually

1\. Go to the “Applications” tab on the left panel of Bitrix24.

2\. Go to the “Developer resources” section on the top panel.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/4-en.png)

3\. Go to the “Integrations” tab on the top panel.

4\. Click on the menu with the “hamburger” icon — on the left, under the gear icon.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/5-en.png)

5\. Select “Employee access permissions” from the drop-down menu.

6\. Select the employees who want to share the chat. The right column will display the employees who have been granted access.

The employees you have added in the settings will have a Wazzup tab on the left panel of Bitrix24. If the tab does not appear in the left pane, you can [add it manually](https://wazzup24.com/help/the-wazzup-button-is-not-displayed-in-bitrix24-en/).

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

[Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/)

# No access to new leads and contacts

When distributing incoming customers to the “first respondent”, it may turn out that not every employee will have access to a newly created contact or lead. This can happen because of the division of access between units in the structure of the company. There are two ways to solve this problem.

**Option 1.** Suitable for Bitrix24 on-premise edition only.

Add the Wazzup chat bot to every branch (department) with at least 1 employee in need of access present.

In the left pane of Bitrix, click on the “Employees” section. Go to the Company – Company Structure section. Find the bot called wazzup in the “Chat Bots” division:

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/skrin-1-2.jpg)](http://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/skrin-1-2.jpg)

_With the Shift button held down_, drag the bot to all other departments with people. It should happen that the same bot is in all sections at the same time: [![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/skrin-1-novy-j.jpg)](http://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/skrin-1-novy-j.jpg)

This does not violate the divisoin of access rights between departments, but anyone who has an accessin your settings will be able to intercept the leads from the bot. If it does not work, use Option 2.

**Option 2.** Suitable for Bitrix24 cloud and on-premise editions.

Go to the “Settings” of the “CRM” section as shown on the screenshot.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2020-07-24_00-23-36.png)

In the settings, go to “Access Permissions”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2020-07-24_00-27-53.png)

Entry editing mode for the role that needs access. Most often, this role is “Employee”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2020-07-24_00-31-41.png)

In the “Read” and “Update” columns, set the “Personal and department” option for leads and contacts. In the “Automation” column, set the “Update” access option. Save the changes.

You can find out more about [roles and access](https://helpdesk.bitrix24.ru/open/6268091/) rights on the Bitrix24 site.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2020-07-24_00-34-10.png)

Done.

## Knowledge Base

[Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/)

# Roistat, Yandex.Metrics and Google Analytics in Bitrix24

The implementation of end-to-end Analytics allows you to track the effectiveness of advertising channels. You will receive data for Analytics when a user enters a dialog with you via a [wa.me link.](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/chats/how-to-use-click-to-chat/?lang=en)

Wazzup will send the client ID to Bitrix24, and from Bitrix24, the information will be sent to the Analytics service. This way you will find out which advertising source the client came from and will be able to determine the effectiveness of your advertising channels.

1\. Ask your developer to install the script on your site.

Roistat — [copy the script code](https://wazzup24.com/help/roistat-script-code-en/) or [download](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/roistat-kopiya.html.zip) (zip, 2 KB).

Yandex.Metrica — [copy the script code](https://wazzup24.com/help/yandex-metrics-script-code-en/) or [download](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/yandex_metrika-kopiya.html.zip) (zip, 2 KB).

Google Analytics — [copy the script code](https://wazzup24.com/help/google-analytics-script-code-en/) or [download](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/google_analytics-kopiya.html.zip) (zip, 2 KB).

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

When a client clicks on your wa.me link, he will be offered to send the following message: “Hello! My application number: {wz\_metric} “. For the client, the {wz\_metric} label will be displayed as a set of letters and numbers. You can change the text inside the script. It is important to compose the message so that the client understands what the request number is for and does not delete it. Otherwise, you will not receive data for analytics.

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **The client will erase the application number** ❌ | **The client will send the application number** ✅ |
| {wz\_metric} | Good afternoon! I want to place a discount order. My order number: {wz\_metric} |
| Hello! {wz\_metric} | Hello! I have a few questions. My order number: {wz\_metric} |

2\. [Go to the integration settings](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations) in your Wazzup dashboard.

3\. In point 1, see which entity is created when the client makes a new request: lead or contact with the deal. If the “Leads” funnel is selected, a lead is created, if any other funnel — a deal and a contact.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

The settings in point 1 apply only to channels that are not added to Open Channels. Data for analytics will not be transferred through channels that are added to Open Channels.

4\. Go to CRM on the left panel of Bitrix24.

5\. Go to “Settings”. They can be on the top panel or in the “More” drop-down menu on the right side of this panel.

6\. In the settings click “Form and report settings”, and then “Custom Fields”.

7\. Select which entity to add the field for recording the client ID: lead, contact, deal. The entity must be as in point 1 of the Wazzup integration settings. If you have any funnel other than “Leads” selected in step 1, you can add a field only to a contact, only to a deal, or both to a contact and a deal. The latter option is preferable.

8\. Click “Add Field”.

9\. Enter the field name in the window that appears. The name must contain:

- “roistat” for Roistat,
- “google” or ” ga “for Google Analytics,
- “yandex “or” ym ” for Yandex.Metrica.

10\. Click Save.

11\. Go to any lead, deal, or contact — the entity to which you added the field.

12\. In the “About the Lead” (“О лиде”), “About the Contact” (“О контакте”) or “About the Deal” (“О сделке”) section, click “Select field” and select the field name for the ID entry from the list.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/en.png)

If there is no field name in the list, click “Select from another section”, find the field name and click on it.

13\. [Go back to the integration settings](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations) in your Wazzup dashboard and click the “Update data from Bitrix24” button on the top panel.

14\. Done. Now the ID from the first message from the new client will be displayed in the field you created. Your end-to-end Analytics service will accept data from this field and include it in its analysis.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

[Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/)

# How to connect a Bitrix24 widget to your site

Bitrix24 widget on a website is a “button” that will take visitor to chat with your staff or leave a request for a call.

Only channels in Open Channels can be connected to the Bitrix24 widget. All messages sent by the visitor will go to the Open Channel.

### How to connect widget

First, connect your channel to an Open Channel in the “Integration with CRM” section in your Wazzup account: choose a channel → turn on “Add to Open Channel” setting. If you already did it, next step.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Angl_Polzunok.png)1\. Go to CRM → tab “Customers” → Contact Center.

2\. Select “Website Widget” → click “Add New Widget”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl_Kontakt-centr-vidzhet-1.png)

3\. Enter a name for the widget. Visitors to the website will not see it, you need it easily find the right widget later.

4\. Under “Connected channels” select:

- The Open Channel you want to connect to the widget,
- Channels from which you want to communicate with customers.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Kanaly-v-OL-ANGD.png)

In the same window you can configure the appearance of the widget, add a feedback form, greeting and specify the working hours of employees.

When everything is set up, click “Save”.

6\. Copy the code in the widget editor:

select “Website Widget” in the Contact Center → click on the desired widget in the list. The code will be at the beginning of the page.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl_skopirovat-kod-vidzheta.png)6\. Add the code to your site.

**If you have created your site in a website builder**— find the block for adding HTML.

In the example of the Tilda constructor: open Blocks Library → Other → Add block T123 → Content.

**If the site is built** — insert the finished code before the closing </body> tag.

7\. Publish changes on the site. This is all. The widget is ready for testing.

### What to do if you don’t work with Open Channels?

In WhatsApp, you can create a direct link for chatting and publish it on your website. When a client clicks on the link he will get into the chat with a manager.

To create a link, type https://wa.me/<number>.

Instead of <number>, substitute the phone number in full international format. Do not add zeros, brackets or dashes. The phone number must be linked to an active WhatsApp account.

Example: https://wa.me/79856256113

Also you can create a link with the message. The message will automatically appear in the chat after the user clicks on the link.

To create a link use a template: https://wa.me/number/?text=urlcodedtext, where _number_ is a phone number in full international format, and _urlcodedtext_ is a URL-encoded pre-filled message.

Example: https://wa.me/7923567890?text=I%20have%20a%20question

It is more convenient to use services that help to encode your text to URL-encoded format.

After creating the link:

1. Paste the link into the website code;
2. Add a link button in site builder and link to it.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

[Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/)

# The Wazzup button is not displayed in Bitrix24

In order for an employee to have a button to go to Wazzup chats, you need to give him access to the application in CRM.

1\. On the left panel of Bitrix24, open the “Applications” tab → click “Market”.

2\. In the upper right corner, click “More” → “Wazzup”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/en-1.png)

3\. Find Wazzup in the list → click “User Access”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl_dostup.png)

4\. Select the employees you want to share the chat with. The right column will display the employees who have been granted access.

Employees to whom you have granted access in the settings will have a Wazzup tab on the left panel of Bitrix24. If the tab does not appear in the left pane, you can [add it manually](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/the-wazzup-button-is-not-displayed-in-bitrix24-en/).

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

[Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/)

# Type of correspondence in the feed

#### Communication history

To maintain a context for all the communications with a client and take all the other activities and interactions with the client into account, all the messages are duplicated as comments into the feed. The messages are in the opposite order compared to the usual messengers. The most recent ones are on top:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/18-4.png)

To not lose track of the comments you need in the feed, you can pin them using a paper clip. You can pin up to three comments.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/20-5.png)

#### Where the client came from

In the “More” section of a lead’s or client’s card, the source – transport – is shown, as well as the name of the channel through which the client got into your CRM. When working through OC, the source will not be shown.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/21-2.png)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Where to find chats in Bitrix24

**To see all the chats available to you**, click Wazzup button on the left menu bar.

Sometimes Wazzup button doesn’t appear automatically. In that case you can add it manually.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/knopka-wz.png)

**To open a chat with a specific client**, go to the card of a lead, contact, deal. The button to go to the dialog is on the top menu bar.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/VZ-iz-kartochki.png)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Open Channels: how to set them up and how to use

When you enable integration with Wazzup, you can choose where to correspond with clients: in our chats or Bitrix chats, that is, Open Channels.

Content

Show

- [What to choose: Wazzup chats or Open Channels](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/what-are-open-channels-and-how-to-use-them/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)
- [How to set up Open Channels](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/what-are-open-channels-and-how-to-use-them/#wz24-toc-anchor-1)
- [How to remove the “Welcome to the Open Channel” auto response](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/what-are-open-channels-and-how-to-use-them/#wz24-toc-anchor-2)
- [How to write first from the Open Channel](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/what-are-open-channels-and-how-to-use-them/#wz24-toc-anchor-3)

  - [How to write first from the WhatsApp or Telegram channel](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/what-are-open-channels-and-how-to-use-them/#wz24-toc-anchor-4-0)
  - [How to write first from the WABA channel](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/what-are-open-channels-and-how-to-use-them/#wz24-toc-anchor-4-1)

- [How to write first through Open channels using automation](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/what-are-open-channels-and-how-to-use-them/#wz24-toc-anchor-4)

#### What to choose: Wazzup chats or Open Channels

In short, Wazzup supports more messengers and features for sellers. And Open Channels is more suited to customer support.

### Details and examples on which is better

**Message statuses — only in Wazzup**

A seller needs to understand if a customer has read his message so he knows how to proceed. Wazzup supports all messenger statuses while Open Channels do not, you can only rely on your gut.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/image_2023-01-20_03-11-54.png)

**Voice recording is not available in Open Channels**

Occasionally, salespeople send voice messages. Sometimes a customer asks for it, or the manager urgently needs to give out a lot of information. In such cases in Wazzup the salesperson can record a voice message, but in Open Channels he can't, it's text only.

**You can only write to Instagram via Open Channels in direct**

If you need to reply to comments on Instagram, you can do so in Wazzup chats. In Open Channels, you can't reply to comments — you can only write to direct.

**Wazzup supports quoting messages, but Open Channels does not**

Salespeople need a quote when customers send a lot of messages and the salesperson needs to respond to a specific one.

When working through Wazzup, the customer will get a reply to their message, just like in messengers. In Open Channels this function doesn't work properly.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/citata-na-anglijskom.png)

**Wazzup chats are more convenient for sales departments and Open Channels — for support**

When working in Wazzup chats, each salesperson sees dialogs only with those customers for whom he or she is responsible in the CRM. This helps managers not get lost in the chats of their colleagues. When the responsible manager in the CRM is changed, the chat automatically goes to another salesperson.

In Open Channels, you can pass the dialogue directly in the chat and without changing the responsible employee. This option is suitable for support staff who do not manage CRM and work with the flow of requests.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/peredat-chat-v-OL.png)

**Wazzup is easier to set up**

To get started with Wazzup chats you need to configure 3 items — it takes 5 minutes.

If you connect Open Channels, you'll have to open 8 tabs, beat the dragon, figure out more than 20 settings, and more sub-items to them. For this you will have to study the manual, but the result will be the same.

**Conclusion**

Wazzup is more useful for sales people because it has message statuses, voicemail recording, and quotes. It's also easier and faster to set up.

Open Channels are useful for support staff who don't run a CRM, but only handle requests: there you can pass a customer to another employee right in the chat room.

#### How to set up Open Channels

1\. In your personal Wazzup account, in the settings of the desired channel, click the “Add to Open Channel” checkbox and select an open channel.

2\. Go to the “CRM” tab in Bitrix24. Go to the “Customers” tab → Contact center.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/b24-angl-ol.png)

3\. Find among the applications “WAZZUP: WhatsApp” or “WAZZUP: Telegram” → Click on the icon, select the desired Open Channel.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/contsct-center.png)

If both channels are connected to the Open Channel, you can select either icon. The new settings will take effect on all channels connected to the Open Channel.

4\. In the window that appears, click the “Configure” button to the right of the Open Channel name.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/configure.png)

5\. Complete the settings in the “Queue” section. To do this, create roles and configure their access rights.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Queue.png)

6\. Select the desired item in the drop-down menu “Agent information”.

**“Use employee user profile”** — each outgoing message will automatically have a signature with the manager’s name.

This setting is useful if several employees are working with the client simultaneously and the correspondence is carried out from one number. Thus the client will understand with whom he/she is communicating right now.

The manager’s name is taken from Bitrix24. The signature with the name will not appear in the manager’s chat, but will be displayed in the client’s chat.

**“Use Open Channels entires”** — if you want to have signatures, but want to hide the real names of your managers. Enter an alias for each employee, which will be displayed in the customer chat. This will make it easier for customers to explain which manager they corresponded with, and managers will keep their anonymity.

**“Hide agent information”**— outgoing messages will not have a signature with the sales rep’s name.

7\. Check the “Verify client in CRM database” checkbox.

8\. Select in the drop-down menu “If client was not found in CRM” action for new clients:

- create manually in the chat window;
- auto create a new lead;
- auto create a deal.

The first option is suitable when not all incoming requests require creating a contact and a deal.

To create a contact and a deal from chat, in the upper right corner of the Open Channels chat click on the icon with three dots → select “Save to CRM” from the list.

9\. Click “Save”.

#### How to remove the “Welcome to the Open Channel” auto response

1\. Go to the “CRM” tab in Bitrix24. Go to the contact center.

2\. Go to the “CRM” tab in Bitrix24. Go to the “Customers” tab → Contact center.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/b24-angl-ol.png)

3\. Find among the applications “WAZZUP: WhatsApp” or “WAZZUP: Telegram” → Click on the icon, select the desired Open Channel.

If both channels are connected to the Open Channel, you can select either icon. The new settings will take effect on all channels connected to the Open Channel.

4\. In the window that appears, click the “Configure” button to the right of the Open Channel name.

5\. Go to the “Auto Actions” section. Disable the “Send greetings” setting.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/avtootvet_640210.png)

6\. Click “Save.” Done — you are no longer spamming your customers.

#### How to write first from the Open Channel

Open Channels allows you to write first from WhatsApp and WABA channels only. To write first from Telegram Personal channel, use our chats — the “Wazzup” button in the client card.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/knopka-Vz.png)

##### How to write first from the WhatsApp or Telegram channel

1\. Go to a lead, deal or contact.

2\. Select “SMS/WhatsApp” from the menu on the right.

3\. Click “More” in the same window.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/1en.png)

4\. Select “WAZZUP: WhatsApp” or “WAZZUP: Telegram” under “using”. If you do not have this option, click “Update data from Bitrix24” in the upper right corner [in the integration settings](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations) in your Wazzup personal account.

5\. Write a message and send it. You can attach a file to the message and it will be sent to the client as a link.

6\. Go to the Open Channel chat by clicking the «Open» button.

Done — you have created a chat in the Open Channel and sent a message.

##### How to write first from the WABA channel

1\. To send a template, copy its code in the “Templates” section of your personal Wazzup account. Select the desired template in the list, click the edit button → copy the code.![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-color-bgselected-area-11.png)

2\. Then insert the code instead of the message text.

### Text template without variables

The code for the template looks like this: 2a6b105a-54d6-4a2b-9749-1a75188b102e { }

You don't need to change anything in it: just copy and add. You don't need to add anything to the template either — then the message won't go away.

### Template with variables

The code for the template with variables looks like this:![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Dizajn-bez-nazvaniya-8.png)

You need to fill them with text:

1. Remove the text "headerVarN", "bodyVarN" inside the square brackets. Leave the brackets themselves as they are.
2. Leave the cursor inside the brackets and type your text. The result should look like this: \[\[good text\]\].

### Template with media

To attach media, add a link to the file instead of "headerContentUrl". Use a direct link to the file. Those links that lead to Google Drive, Dropbox or other cloud storage will not work.

**How to prepare a link to an attachment:**

1\. Send the file via Wazzup chat to your or your client's number. The service will process the file and assign a link to it.

2\. Right-click on the picture → copy the URL of the picture.

It will look something like this: https://store.wazzup24.com/c4d2f98d9b3d75d1a8e8d760343c26cc66495ea4

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/media-e1675970794467.png)

Make sure the link works and leads to the right file. If there is a bad link in the template - the message will not be sent. In the deal card it will be displayed as an error message and in Wazzup chats it will be shown with a red cross.

You can add only the media type that you chose when you created the template. For example, if you agreed on a template with an image, and attach only pictures you won't be able to send a video or document.

If you need to check what type of media you can attach to the message, go to WABA Templates → click the "pencil" in the template line → see the type in the template header.

### Template with buttons: how to fill in the variable in the link

The button itself already has part of the link prescribed. So instead of "buttonVarN" add only the missing part of the link from the Bitrix24 field in brackets.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/ssylka-v-peremennoj-e1675970825257.png)

1. Remove the text "buttonVarN" inside the square brackets. Leave the brackets themselves as they are.
2. Leave the cursor inside the brackets and add the missing part of the link. The result should look like this: \[\[how-to-set-up/how-to-add-a-waba-template/\]\].

Done! The client will receive the text of the selected WABA template.

#### How to write first through Open channels using automation

Starting a dialogue in Open channels can be automated. When you create a new lead, a deal or when a deal moves to a certain stage, automation will create a chat with the client in Open channels and send a message to this chat.

Let’s add an automation:

1\. Go to the “CRM” section on the left panel of Bitrix24.

2\. Go to the “Automation rules” tab.

3\. Click under “Automation rules”: “Add” → “Client communications” → “Send SMS”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/4en.png)

Although it is called “Send SMS”, but the message will go to WhatsApp or Telegram. This is how it is done in Bitrix ¯\\\_(ツ)\_/¯

4\. Enter the text of the message.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/5en.png)

5\. Select from the drop-down menu the type of customer number to which the message will be sent. You can change it in the contact or transaction card.

6\. Select from the drop-down menu “Provider” → “WAZZUP: WhatsApp” or “WAZZUP: Telegram”.

7\. Click “Save”.

8\. Click “Save” again.![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/6en-1024x397.png)

Done — you have added an automation that when you create a new deal or lead, adds a chat with the client in the Open channel and sends a message.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Write in the Bitrix24 mobile application

You can easily send messages from the Bitrix24 mobile app.

1\. Go to “More” → “CRM” and select the desired deal.

2\. In the bottom right corner, tap “+” to open the action menu.

3\. From the list, select “SMS” – this option allows you to send messages via Wazzup.

4\. To the right of the client’s phone number, tap “Settings” (gear icon) → select “From number \[Wazzup (WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business API, Telegram)\]”.

5\. Type your message and tap “Send”.

Once the client responds, you can continue the conversation in the Bitrix24 mobile app in the Wazzup chat.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Set up integration with Zoho CRM

Settings are displayed [in the “Integration with CRM” tab](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations/) after the integration is connected. If you have multiple channels connected, you need to configure integration for each channel separately.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bg-57-1.png)

Content

Show

- [1\. Select employee roles](https://wazzup24.com/help/configuring-integration-with-zoho-crm-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)
- [2\. A new client has written (a client who is not in the CRM). Where do I create a deal?](https://wazzup24.com/help/configuring-integration-with-zoho-crm-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-1)
- [Additional settings](https://wazzup24.com/help/configuring-integration-with-zoho-crm-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-2)

  - [1\. Save messages to the contact, lead and deal card](https://wazzup24.com/help/configuring-integration-with-zoho-crm-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-3-0)
  - [2\. Notify managers on all messages](https://wazzup24.com/help/configuring-integration-with-zoho-crm-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-3-1)
  - [3\. Priority channel](https://wazzup24.com/help/configuring-integration-with-zoho-crm-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-3-2)
  - [API key](https://wazzup24.com/help/configuring-integration-with-zoho-crm-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-3-3)

#### 1\. Select employee roles

The role determines the employee’s rights — which chats they see and whether they can correspond with customers. There are three roles:

- Quality Control — checks sales reps’ work. They see all sales reps’ correspondence, but can’t write anything.
- Sales rep — communicates with clients and conducts deals. They can only write to the clients he is responsible for in the CRM. They cannot see the correspondence of other sales reps.
- Manager — manages and supervises large deals. They see the correspondence of all sales reps and can write to any client.

The “Select roles” button opens a window with the selection of employee roles.

The “Receives new clients” slider allows the employee to participate in the distribution of new clients.

If a deal or lead is created, the manager participates in the distribution of the client in turn and gets the right to become responsible for the client in the CRM.

Click “Save”.

#### 2\. A new client has written (a client who is not in the CRM). Where do I create a deal?

To create a deal, select the name of the funnel in the left drop-down list — “Standard”, in the right drop-down list select the name of the stage. The contact will be created automatically when the deal is created.

To create a lead, select “Lead” in the left drop-down list and its status in the right drop-down list.

That’s it, you’ve configured which chats will be seen by salespeople and how customers will be distributed between them.

A window will pop up asking you to test the chats. We will automatically send you a test message to the first WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business API (WABA) or Telegram channel you add. You’ll be able to go straight to the chats and test the integration or do it later.

If you have salespeople with access to multiple channels or employees with the “Manager” role make additional settings.

#### Additional settings

Additional settings apply to all channels at once.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bg-13-1.png)

##### 1\. Save messages to the contact, lead and deal card

To see saved messages, go to Wazzup Log item on the left panel in the lead, contact or deal card in Zoho CRM.

If the setting is disabled, the Wazzup log item in the left panel will appear, but the messages will not be displayed there.

##### 2\. Notify managers on all messages

Employees with the “manager” role will receive push notifications in the mobile app for all clients, including those for which managers are not assigned to be responsible in the CRM.

If the setting is disabled, employees with the “manager” role will only receive push notifications in the mobile app for customers for whom they have been designated as responsible in CRM.

##### 3\. Priority channel

This setting is for employees who have access to more than one WhatsApp channel. Select which channel the message will leave from if the employee texts the client first.

##### API key

If you lack the functionality of the ready integration, you can refine it [with the API](https://wazzup24.com/help/all-about-wazzup-en/integration-by-api-en/#Integration_with_CRMAPI).

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

#### What to start with

The first thing we advise you to do in your personal account is to read the affiliate rules. They are, all of a sudden, in the “Rules” tab.

There you will learn how your reward will grow, where to get help, how you can influence the development of the product and our expectations from partners.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-pravila.png)

#### How to register a new client

You can register a client manually from your Partner Account. Here’s how:

1\. Go to the Clients tab and click Add client.

2\. Enter the client’s email address – this is where their login password will be sent.

Then, enter a name for the client. This name is visible only to you and helps you quickly find them in your account.

Click Add.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-dobavlenie-klienta.png)

Once added, the client will receive €10 or $10 to their bonus account, depending on their currency.

If your client is already registered in Wazzup, you won’t be able to add him through your account. Just [contact support](https://wazzup24.com/contact-en/) and they will add him to your account.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If you don’t plan to set up the service for your client — send him the referral link so he can register himself. We’ll help the new user to understand how Wazzup works, and you’ll get 20% of every client payment for a year.

#### How to create a referral link so that the client registers themselves

You can create links in the “Links and registrations” tab.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-referalnye.png)

You can create an unlimited number of links to place them on different sources. Your referral will receive 10 euros or 10 dollars to his bonus account for registering with the link. Currency is determined during registration.

You will receive 20% of each client’s payment during the year. Information about payments will be in the tab “Referral fees”.

Remuneration is credited automatically on the first day of each month to your affiliate account.

We do not pay for shows and leads. Only those clients who have paid for the service are counted.

#### How to set everything up for the client

You can manage your client settings directly from your account. Click this icon next to the client’s account.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bgselected-area-5.png)

A new tab will open the client’s personal account – you have access to all settings, payments and data.

#### How to replenish the account

The partner account is used to pay for the clients subscriptions and WABA balance, and there is also a percentage drop from the self-pay of clients.

To add money to your account:

1\. In the “Partner account” tab click the “Refill” button.

2\. Enter the amount you want to add to your account. If you are depositing money, which you received from the client, you can keep the reward amount, and put the remainder on the account.

3\. Choose method of payment: by bank card or by bank transfer → click “Refill”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-popolnenie-scheta.png)

#### How to create a subscription for a client

1\. Go to the client’s account. To do this, click this icon next to the client account.![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bgselected-area-5.png)

2\. Go to the “Subscriptions” section.

3\. Click “Add Subscription”.

4\. Select the subscription options and click “Continue”.

5\. Pay for the subscription from your affiliate account.

Done — you have created a subscription for a customer.

#### How to get money from an account

In the Referral payments tab, at the top right corner — your earnings. We calculate it using a simple formula: payment × your commission rate. Everything is fair, transparent, and always within reach.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Partnerka-ANGL-5-1.png)

We send rewards by invoice without a fee if you are an IE or LLC. Bill us and we will pay within three days.

To get help with filling out an invoice, message us on [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=%2B79852622249&text&type=phone_number&app_absent=0) or [Telegram](https://t.me/PartnerWazzupBot).

**Lifehack:** instead of withdrawing rewards from the referral program, you may use it to pay for discounted subscriptions. When you receive the money to renew the service, you can keep part of the amount, taking into account how much you have already paid for subscriptions.

#### How to sort clients in the table

In the client table, you can quickly find the right record — sort, filter by status, or use search. Easy as that.

You can sort clients by the following columns:

- Registration date
- Subscription end date
- Autopayment
- Paid by client

Next to each column name, you’ll see an arrow. Click on it to sort values in ascending or descending order.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Partnerka-ANGL-1.png)

The table has a Status column that shows current issues with the client’s subscription or channels. You can filter clients by these statuses to find what you need faster.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Partnerka-ANGL-2.png)

By default, inactive clients are hidden in the table.

To view them, enable the “Show inactive clients” toggle in the top right corner of the table.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Partnerka-ANGL-3.png)

Use the search bar to find a client by ID or name. Search works across the whole table.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Partnerka-ANGL-4.png)

#### How to use free channels

After you join an affiliate program, the “Clients” tab will have a “Demo” account. Five free subscriptions on the Max plan will appear there: for WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram , Viber and Avito channel.

Use them to show customers all the benefits of Wazzup.

Three of the same free subscriptions will appear in your main account. You can use them for personal commercial purposes.

If you want more channels in any of your accounts — they will cost 35% or 50% less than the regular price. A 35% discount on all partners. A 50% discount for partners who have sold subscriptions to 10 or more customers.

#### How can you find out how many more clients to connect to get 50%

In the “Clients” tab we show how many of your clients have paid for the service at least once, either on their own or through you. If there are 10 such clients, we increase up to 50% rewards from payments made in your account.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-color-bgselected-area-1-3.png)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

## Google Analytics Script Code - Wazzup Knowledge base

> **Source:** https://wazzup24.com/help/google-analytics-script-code-en/

> **Description:** Script for end-to-end analytics Google Analytics

# Google Analytics Script Code

```
<!-- Insert this script before the closing tag </body> -->
<!-- The {wz_metric} token is used for substituting the Analytics code. Make sure that the token and the text in which it is written are separated by at least one space character. -->

<script>
(function () {
function ChangeLinkWA() {
this.text = "Здравствуйте! Номер моей заявки: {wz_metric}";
this.cookieSource = "_ga";
}

ChangeLinkWA.prototype.editLink = function (url, id) {
if (
decodeURIComponent(url.split("text=")[1]) ===
this.text.replace(/{wz_metric}/gi, id)
)
return;
var regexNumberPhone = /\d+/;
if (!regexNumberPhone.test(url)) return;
var phone = url.match(regexNumberPhone)[0];
var host = url.split(phone)[0];
var newUrl =
host === "https://wa.me/"
? host.toString()+phone.toString()+"?text="+(this.text.replace(/{wz_metric}/gi, id))
: host.toString()+phone.toString()+"&text="+(this.text.replace(/{wz_metric}/gi, id));
return newUrl;
};

ChangeLinkWA.prototype.getCookie = function (name) {
var cookie = document.cookie;
var matches = cookie.match(
new RegExp(
"(?:^|; )"+(name.replace(/([.$?*|{}()[]\/+^])/g, "\\\"))+"=([^;]*)"
)
);
return matches ? decodeURIComponent(matches[1]) : undefined;
};

ChangeLinkWA.prototype.censusLinks = function () {
var links = document.querySelectorAll(
'[href*="//wa.me"], [href*="//api.whatsapp.com/send"], [href*="//web.whatsapp.com/send"], [href^="whatsapp://send"]'
);
var id = this.getCookie(this.cookieSource);
var that = this;
links.forEach(function (link) {
var newLink = that.editLink(link.href, id);
if (newLink) link.href = newLink;
});
};

window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
if (!(window.__wz_scripts && window.__wz_scripts.scriptsChangeLinkWA)) {
if (!window.__wz_scripts) window.__wz_scripts = {};
window.__wz_scripts.scriptsChangeLinkWA = new ChangeLinkWA();
var interval = setInterval(function () {
var id = window.__wz_scripts.scriptsChangeLinkWA.getCookie(
window.__wz_scripts.scriptsChangeLinkWA.cookieSource
);
if (id) {
clearInterval(interval);
window.__wz_scripts.scriptsChangeLinkWA.censusLinks();
}
}, 200);
}
});
})();
</script>
```

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to connect Amwork to Wazzup

Wazzup allows you to send and receive messages in [WhatsApp](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-whatsapp-personal/), [Telegram](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-telegram-personal/), [Telegram Bot](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-telegram-bot/) and [Instagram](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-instagram-api/) — all directly inside your Amwork CRM.

#### Connection steps

1\. Don’t have a Wazzup account yet? Register at [wazzup24.com](https://wazzup24.com/).

2\. After registration, log in to your Wazzup dashboard.

3\. In the left menu, go to “ [Channels](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/channels)”.

4\. Click Add Channel and choose the platform you want to connect: WhatsApp, Telegram / Telegram Bot, or Instagram.

👉 How to connect [WhatsApp](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-whatsapp-personal/)

👉 How to connect [Telegram](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-telegram-personal/) or [Telegram Bot](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-telegram-bot/)

👉 How to connect [Instagram](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-instagram-api/)

5\. Follow the instructions to complete the connection.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

All chats from connected channels will be visible in both Wazzup and Amwork. If you’re using a personal account, private messages may become visible to your team. For testing, we recommend using a shared (work) profile and limiting access.

6\. In the “ [Integration with CRM](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations)” section, choose Amwork → click “Continue” → “Add”.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Amvork-2.png)

7\. You’ll be redirected to Amwork → enter your login and password.

8\. If you’re logged in as an administrator, the API key will be auto-filled. If needed, you can find your API key in Wazzup → “ [Integration with CRM](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations)”.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If you’re adding another channel later, you’ll need to copy and paste the API key manually. Once a channel is connected, the key and selected channel can’t be edited.

9\. In Amwork choose the connected Wazzup channel from the dropdown list.

For each channel, assign users with specific roles:

- “Select users with access to all client chats” — users can view all conversations between employees and clients. They’re marked as chat owners and always have access.
- “Select who can see the messenger” — supervisors who can see chats created from incoming messages. Access can be removed if needed.
- “Users responsible for new clients” — users who will handle chats with both incoming and outgoing messages. Their access can also be revoked.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Amvork-6.png)

These settings help you assign the right permissions and manage your team’s chat access efficiently.

##### Managing and removing integration

To manage the integration, go to your Amwork account and click Manage next to the Wazzup logo.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Amvork-4.png)

To disconnect a channel, go to Settings → Integrations, click Manage, find the channel you want to remove, and click the trash icon.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Amvork-7.png)

#### Where to find Wazzup chats

To start a conversation, open a contact card in Amwork and choose the channel you want to use — WhatsApp, Telegram, or another.

The chat window with the client will open right inside the CRM. All messages will be saved and visible in the contact card.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Amvork-8.png)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to connect Eduncy to Wazzup

Follow this step-by-step guide to integrate your Eduncy CRM with Wazzup and start using [WhatsApp](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-whatsapp-personal/) for communication.

#### Set up the Eduncy integration

1\. Don’t have a Wazzup account or haven’t signed up yet, register at [wazzup24.com](https://wazzup24.com/).

2\. After registration, log in to your Wazzup dashboard and go to [“Channels”](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/channels).

3\. Click Add Channel and choose the platform you want to connect. Follow the on-screen instructions to link your [WhatsApp](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-whatsapp-personal/) or [WhatsApp Business account (WABA)](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-the-official-whatsapp-waba/). Once connected, your number will appear in the channel list.

👉 [How and why to verify a company in Meta](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-and-why-to-verify-a-company-in-meta/)

👉 [Integration with WABA and WhatsApp — differences, conditions, connection](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/waba-and-whatsapp/)

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

All chats from connected channels will be visible in both Wazzup and Eduncy. If you’re using a personal account, private messages may become visible to your team. For testing, we recommend using a shared (work) profile and limiting access.

4\. In your Wazzup account, open the [“Integration with CRM”](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations) tab → select Eduncy.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/EDUNCY-1.png)

5\. Enter your Eduncy CRM URL.

6\. Click “Add” — you’ll be redirected to the Eduncy login page.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/EDUNCY-4.png)

7\. Log in using your admin account credentials.

8\. Click Sign in to authorize the connection.

9\. That’s it!

Eduncy is now connected to Wazzup. You can send and receive WhatsApp messages directly from your CRM.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to Connect Wazzup to Flowlu

Integrating Wazzup with Flowlu allows you to connect WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business for seamless communication with your clients.

#### How to connect Wazzup to Flowlu

To set up Wazzup integration with Flowlu, follow these steps:

1\. In your Wazzup account, go to [the “Channels” section](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/channels) and connect [WhatsApp](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-whatsapp-personal/?_gl=1*zmkqrx*_gcl_au*MTE1OTIzNDUzOC4xNzQwMTI2NjgyLjUwMTM1MDUwMy4xNzQxMDg3Mzk5LjE3NDEwODczOTg.*_ga*NzY2NzE0MDk3LjE3NDAxMjY2ODI.*_ga_7X6RZSKPXF*MTc0MTE1NzY1MC4zMi4xLjE3NDExNTk1MDIuNjAuMC4zMTAwOTcxMTc.), [WhatsApp Business API](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-the-official-whatsapp-waba/?_gl=1*1pbu097*_gcl_au*MTE1OTIzNDUzOC4xNzQwMTI2NjgyLjUwMTM1MDUwMy4xNzQxMDg3Mzk5LjE3NDEwODczOTg.*_ga*NzY2NzE0MDk3LjE3NDAxMjY2ODI.*_ga_7X6RZSKPXF*MTc0MTE1NzY1MC4zMi4xLjE3NDExNTk1MjIuNDAuMC4zMTAwOTcxMTc.), or [Telegram](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-telegram-personal/?_gl=1*15labdf*_gcl_au*MTE1OTIzNDUzOC4xNzQwMTI2NjgyLjUwMTM1MDUwMy4xNzQxMDg3Mzk5LjE3NDEwODczOTg.*_ga*NzY2NzE0MDk3LjE3NDAxMjY2ODI.*_ga_7X6RZSKPXF*MTc0MTE1NzY1MC4zMi4xLjE3NDExNTk1NDQuMTguMC4zMTAwOTcxMTc.).

👉 [How to choose a pricing plan](https://wazzup24.com/help/payment-en/price-plans-en/?_gl=1*1usxx07*_gcl_au*MTE1OTIzNDUzOC4xNzQwMTI2NjgyLjUwMTM1MDUwMy4xNzQxMDg3Mzk5LjE3NDEwODczOTg.*_ga*NzY2NzE0MDk3LjE3NDAxMjY2ODI.*_ga_7X6RZSKPXF*MTc0MTE1NzY1MC4zMi4xLjE3NDExNTk0MjkuNjAuMC4zMTAwOTcxMTc.)

2\. Click on “More” in the left sidebar → select “Communications” → “Connect” → select WhatsApp or Telegram and copy the provided link

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/flovu-8-1.png)

3\. Return to Wazzup, go to the [“Integration with CRM”](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations) section, and select Flowlu.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/flovu-6.png)

4\. Paste the copied URL and click “Continue” → “Connect”.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/flovu-7.png)

5\. In the pop-up window, verify your phone number and click “Save”.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/flovu-5-1.png)

6\. Once the integration is successfully connected, you can modify its settings in Flowlu, such as:

- Assigning a manager queue.
- Selecting a CRM pipeline where new chats will be stored.

#### Where are Wazzup Chats in Flowlu

To access the chats, click the Wazzup button in the top menu bar.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/flovu-10.png)

After that, the chat with the client will open.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/flovu-11.png)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to Create a Scheduled Message

The scheduled messages feature allows you to plan message delivery at a time that works for you. It’s available for all channels and pricing plans, regardless of your subscription type.

A delayed message can be scheduled by:

- Administrator,
- Manager,
- Supervisor.

You can schedule text messages and messages with attachments across all channels.

Voice messages cannot be scheduled — in any channel.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

**Note for WhatsApp Business API (WABA):**

There are some specifics:

- Only text messages can be scheduled.
- If the session with the client is closed, the message will be sent as a template — only if it’s pre-approved and matches the content.

#### How to Create a Scheduled Message

There are two ways to create a scheduled message.

**First method:**

1\. Start typing your message in the input field.

2\. Click the icon that appears to the right of the message.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/ANGL-Vvod-teksta-dlya-sozdaniya-otlozhennogo-soobshheniya.png)

3\. In the pop-up window, select the date and time for sending.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/ANGL-Vybor-vremeni-otpravki.png)

4\. Click “Schedule” to add your message to the scheduled queue. If you change your mind, click “Cancel” to reset the settings and return to the initial state.

5\. If the message is scheduled, a “Calendar” icon will appear to the right of the input field.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/ANGL-Vvod-teksta-dlya-sozdaniya-otlozhennogo-soobshheniya-1-1.png)

6\. To view or edit the queue of messages, click this icon to open the scheduled messages list.

**Second method:**

1\. Click the queue icon (calendar) to the right of the input field to access the scheduled messages interface.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/ANGL-Vvod-teksta-dlya-sozdaniya-otlozhennogo-soobshheniya-1-1.png)

2\. Start typing your message.

3\. Select the date and time for sending by clicking the calendar.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/ANGL-Vybor-vremeni-otpravki.png)

4\. Confirm your selection or click “Cancel” to exit without saving.

#### Actions with Scheduled Messages

In the scheduled messages interface, you can perform the following actions by hovering over a message:

1\. **Send the message immediately.** Click the “Send Now” button to send the message to the chat. After sending, the message will be removed from the queue.

2\. **Edit the message text.** Make changes to the text if you want to correct or add something.

3\. **Change the time and date of sending.** Set a new time instead of the scheduled one.

4\. **Delete the message.** Remove the message from the queue if it’s no longer relevant.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/ANGL-Vvod-teksta-dlya-sozdaniya-otlozhennogo-soobshheniya-1.png)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to correctly specify the display name for your WhatsApp Business profile

When connecting a WABA channel, you need to specify the display name for your WhatsApp Business profile. During company verification, Meta will automatically check this name against their requirements. Without an approved name, you won’t be able to increase your conversation limits or obtain WhatsApp’s official business account status — in other words, the green checkmark next to your name.

#### How to name the profile correctly

The main requirement is that the display name must refer to your company. This is what Meta checks.

If the display name matches the legal name one to one, everything is okay, Meta will approve it.

If the display name does not match the legal name, Meta checks your site. The name must match the one indicated in the header and footer of the site.

Don’t edit the name. Do not remove words, do not add new ones, do not add emojis.

Exception: Only words that indicate the location of the company, a specific department or its function can be added to the name. For example, when you create separate profiles for different branches.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-primer-imya-profilya.png)

In some cases, it will not be possible to include your company name in the display name, because Meta does not allow you to use:

- General terms. For example, “Umbrellas”, “Textiles” and so on.
- Cities, countries, regions. For example, you cannot simply write “Moscow” or “Europe” in the name.
- Slogan or long description,
- Names printed only in lowercase letters or LIKE THIS, through Caps.

For such cases, there is a life hack:

1. Come up with a display name.
2. Publish it on the site instead of your name.
3. Change the display name according to the instructions below.
4. When Meta approves the display name, return the original name to the site.

#### **How to change your WhatsApp Business profile name**

1\. [Log in WhatsApp Manager](https://business.facebook.com/wa/manage/home/) and in the left menu bar, select the business account that the WhatsApp Business profile belongs to.

2\. In the left menu, select “Phone Numbers”.

3\. In the Name column click on the pencil icon near the display name → a window will open.

4\. Enter a new name that suits the requirements of Meta.

5\. Click “Next”.

Meta will check the display name within 1-2 days. If the name is approved, the certificate will say “Approved” next to the line with your display name.

6\. When the new name is confirmed [write to our support](https://wazzup24.com/contact-en/).

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)
