# How and why to verify a company in Meta

Company Verification — A Required Step to Start More Conversations with Clients via WhatsApp Business (WABA)

#### Why verify your company in Meta

Meta sets limits on the number of business-initiated conversations (the first messages that start a conversation) in the WhatsApp Business API. Without company verification, the limit is 250 unique users per day.

It is easy to verify a company: 10 minutes to send an application and 3-4 days to wait.

Once the company is verified, Meta will check the display name of the profile. It was already indicated when creating a WhatsApp Business profile and connecting the WABA channel. Therefore, nothing else needs to be done — just wait.

Once you’ve connected the channel, you can start up to 250 conversations per day. To increase the limit, **[keep your messaging active and high-quality](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/messaging-limits)**. Most importantly — **don’t send spam**. Violations may affect your number’s trust score and reduce your messaging limit.

👉 [What categories of templates are there?](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/waba-template-categories/)

#### Verifying company in Facebook Business Manager

Go to the [“Security Center” section](https://business.facebook.com/settings/security/) of Facebook Business Manager and click the “Start Confirmation” button.

1\. Check your company information and click “Next”.

2\. Select “None of these apply” from the list of companies that Facebook has found.

3\. Confirm the legal name of the company. Select the language and upload a scan of one of the documents: business license (if any), TIN, PSRN. It would be better if you upload several documents.

4\. Confirm the company address and phone number.

Upload a document with your company’s legal name, mailing address, or phone number that you entered:

- utility bill, such as electricity or telephone;
- a certificate from the bank showing the address;
- business license with the address or phone number of the company.

Click “Next”.

5\. Select the method of verification:

- by phone. A robot will call and give a code to enter on the website. We didn’t get a call ¯\\\_(ツ)\_/¯
- by email. Enter your email address, preferably on the domain of your company’s website. A code will come via email, which you will need to enter on the site. The code came to the email within 3 minutes.
- domain validation of the site. The site is confirmed by placing a meta tag in the <head> section. It works this way too.

Done — you have sent the company for verification. Confirmation can take up to 3 weeks, but usually 2-3 days.

- **If the application is rejected** — don’t worry. The verification is done by people, and sometimes mistakes happen. Just double-check everything and submit it again.
- **If the application is approved**, wait 1-2 business days for WhatsApp to check the displayed profile name. Once the channel status changes to “Not Subscribed,” you can pay for the subscription and start using the service.

Every few days, go to the [security center](https://business.facebook.com/settings/security?business_id=528465068225167) and check to see if the company has been confirmed or not. If your application was rejected, you can only find out about it in this section.

# How to add a WABA template

In Wazzup, you don’t have to add templates yourself. As soon as you connect a WABA channel, we automatically create several universal templates and send them for moderation in Meta.

Once the universal templates are agreed upon, you can use them. Open a chat with the client you want to write to, type any text in the input line and send — the text will be sent in a universal template.

👉 [What are universal templates and how do they work](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/what-are-waba-universal-templates-and-why-are-they-needed/)

**If you need a template with text.** For example, to send a newsletter:

As soon as the channel is connected, a few universal templates will be automatically sent from your personal account for moderation. When Facebook approves them, you will be able to write to your clients first.

Universal templates can be personalised when you send them: they contain variable fields that can be filled in however you like.

If the basic templates aren’t enough, add your own — it’s easy. Templates can be added and sent for moderation just from the Wazzup personal account. They are usually approved in 2-3 hours after they are sent. Sometimes within a couple of days. In very, very rare cases — in a couple of weeks.

#### How to add a template

Go to “Message templates” → “WABA templates” tab → “+ Add a template”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angd-dobavlenie-VABA-shablona.png)

**Template name.** Enter a name by which you can quickly find the template among the others. It can be changed at any time.

**Template tags.** Specify tags by which the seller can quickly find the template in chats.

**Language.** Specify the language in which you’re going to write. WhatsApp recommends not to use several languages in one template.

**Category.** Select the one from the list that fits the content. If you don’t know where to put the template, read the [WABA template category guide](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/waba-template-categories/).

**Select the channels from which you will send the template.** You can use the template on all channels that are linked to the selected WhatsApp Business account (you created it when you [added the WABA channel](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-the-official-whatsapp-waba/)). You don’t have to coordinate 100500 templates for each channel individually.

If you want to use a template on certain channels, select only them in the “WABA Channels” field. For example, a template that says “Thank you for applying for the job” is needed for the HR channel, but not for the sales channel.

##### Title

Click the slider if you want to use a header. It can be text or media.

###### Text header

It is distinguished from the main text by its boldface and separated from it by an empty line. It can contain important information for the client, so it will be immediately apparent.

You can add one {{variable}} to the text header. To do this, click the {…} icon to the right of the text input field.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

When the template passes moderation, the variables can be filled in:

**Manually.** You can enter any text in the variable: for example, address the interlocutor by name, specify order numbers or inform about promotions.

**Automatically.** You can substitute field values from CRM when sending a template using Kommo Salesbot or Bitrix24 Business Processes.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2-80-1024x388.png)

###### Media header

There are three types:

— .jpeg, .jpg, .png image;

— .mp4 video, .3gpp;

— .pdf document.

Template with media header = message with attachment. The client receives the media and text in the same message.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/3-70-1024x375.png)

Select the media type and attach a file that matches the text, so that the template passes moderation. Once approved, managers will upload the desired media when you send it

You can attach only the type of media to the template that you have approved. For example, if you approved a template with an image, you can’t attach a video or document to it.

##### Main text

You can add text and variables to the main text block.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

Variable text cannot be divided into paragraphs and cannot be indented. If you add hyphens, tabs, and more than 4 spaces in a row, they will just disappear from the text after you send it.

If you know that sellers will put a lot of text into variables, you can add multiple variables on different lines to the template. This way the message will be divided into paragraphs.

To format the text in the template, enclose it in special characters.

- The bold character is an asterisk (\*). For example: This is very \*important\* information.
- Italics – underline (\_). For example: Welcome to \_Wazzup\_!
- The strikethrough is a tilde (~). For example: I didn’t know it was called a ~worm~ squiggle.
- Monospaced font — three reverse apostrophes without a space (![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Snimok-ekrana-2024-10-06-v-21.24.01.png)). For example: ![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Snimok-ekrana-2024-10-06-v-21.24.01.png)This sentence is typed in monospaced type.![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Snimok-ekrana-2024-10-06-v-21.24.01.png)

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/4-64-1024x388.png)

##### Caption

The caption differs from the main text in colour and font size and is separated from it by an empty line.

Only text without variables can be added to the caption.

##### Buttons

You can add buttons to the template. Customers are more likely to respond, go to the site or call if they can do it in one click.

There are two types of buttons: “Quick response” and “Link/Call”.

###### Quick response

When a customer clicks a button, you will receive a message with the text of that button. You can [prepare automatic replies to the text of each button with Kommo Salesbot](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-work-with-waba-templates-in-salesbot/).

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/5-64.png)

You can add three “Quick response” buttons to the template. Each button has no more than 25 characters. Please note that for interactive WABA messages — for example, [via amoCRM Salesbot](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/how-to-write-to-a-client-on-whatsapp-with-salesbot/#how-to-send-with-salesbot-buttons) — the limits are different: up to 10 buttons of 20 characters each.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-alert.svg)

For some templates, we recommend adding an unsubscribe button. This way the client is less likely to send the template to spam.

###### Link/Call

**Button with a link** – when clicked, transfers the client to the link.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/6-50.png)

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

If you use [Kommo SalesBot](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-work-with-waba-templates-in-salesbot/) or Bitrix24 Business Processes, you can add one variable to the link and fill it with CRM field values. For example, to send customers driving directions to different branches or links to the products they wanted to buy.

Sending a template with a button that contains a variable with a link will not work from Wazzup chats.

### How to add a variable to a link:

The variable can be anywhere in the link, but it must come after the domain and after the "/".

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Snimok-ekrana-2022-07-28-v-13.50.39-1024x303.png)

Add a variable like this: {{1}}. In parentheses, specify "1", even if there are already variables in the template text.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/8-42.png)

**Call** — when clicked, the client will open a window and the number from the button will be substituted in it. The client does not need to copy or retype anything to make a call. All they have to do is tap the screen a couple of times.

In a template with a link/call button, there can be:

— only 1 button with a link;

— only 1 button with a call;

— two buttons: one with a link and one with a call.

Two buttons with a link or two buttons with a call cannot be in the template.

#### How to fill in examples of variables

When you fill out the template, click on the “Submit for moderation” button. If there are no variables in it, the template will simply go for verification.

If you have added variables to the text, a window will appear. Here you need to fill in the fields with examples for each variable.

Enter text that fits the meaning of the template. If you left a variable for the address, specify any address. If for a name, enter any name.

When everything is filled out, click “Send” again.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

The text you enter is only needed for Facebook. It won’t be saved in the template.

If the template does not pass moderation and you want to check it again — the examples of variables will be pre-filled, they can be corrected or left unchanged.

#### How moderation is going

During moderation, the template will be in the “On moderation” status. When approved, the status will change to “Active”, you can use it.

In your personal account, you can see when the WABA template was sent for moderation, and figure out how much longer to wait for approval. To view the time, click on the question mark next to the status of the template.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

Usually a template is approved in 1-2 days. In very, well, very rare cases the template can be delayed on moderation for a couple of weeks.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-vremya-i-data.png)

If [the template does not pass moderation](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/why-whatsapp-api-template-does-not-pass-moderation/), you will see “Rejected” and you can resend it for approval. To do this, change the template slightly (for example, add a symbol to the text) and click “Send to moderation”.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

A template can go from “Active” to “Rejected”. This happens if [Meta has blocked the template due to complaints](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-make-a-mailing-in-waba-and-not-get-banned/).

It can happen like this: Facebook will send to your mail notification that the template was approved, but in your Wazzup account it will be on moderation. If you need the template as soon as possible, click the “Update statuses” button. The status will change, and you will be able to send the template to clients.

If you do not click the button, the status will be updated automatically. But a bit later. Until this happens, the template cannot be sent.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl_obnovit-statusy.png)

#### How to work with WABA templates in chats

When the template passes moderation, it can be used.

Although templates are needed to start a 24-hour conversation, you can also send them to an already active conversation with a client.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

WABA templates can be sent automatically, but it’s important not to bore the client. If he considers the message spam, he can complain about it. If there are many complaints from different clients for one message, Meta will block your template.

##### How to submit a template

To send a WABA template from a Wazzup chat, go to the dialogue and select a template from the list. Also if there is no active 24-hour correspondence with the client, you can enter the text of the message and send it using an empty template. If there is, the text from the input line will leave as a normal message.

If the template contains variables, fill in the fields, otherwise, the template will not be sent. If you want to leave the variable field empty, put a space.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Wazzup-Google-Chrome-2022-07-27-14-44-52.gif)

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If you send a WABA template message of any category, you will be charged for each template sent, [regardless of whether it is the first message to that client within 24 hours](https://wazzup24.com/help/payment-en/waba-billing/). This also applies to empty (universal) templates that we automatically submit for approval.

The cost depends on the template category. To check a template’s category, go to the “Templates” section → WABA Templates → click the “pencil” icon next to the desired template.

Templates in the “Utility” category are free only when sent within 24 hours after the client’s message (the customer-initiated window). Outside this window, all template messages, including Utility, are charged.

##### How to fill in variables

Everything is simple — just enter the text. But take into account the features that affect the view of the message in the chat.

Variables are needed to tailor the message to different clients. They are not designed for a large amount of text, so variables cannot be indented. This means that it will not be possible to make a large text convenient for the client.

If you add hyphens or tab characters, they will disappear after the template is sent. Therefore, it is better to make the text in variables shorter, and after the client’s response, send the expanded text in regular messages.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

> **Description:** To automatically send messages from WABA and WhatsApp channels, create a process in the Workflows section. 1. Click the "Automation" button in the Hubspot

# How to automatically send messages to WhatsApp from Hubspot

To automatically send messages from WABA and WhatsApp channels, create a process in the Workflows section.

1\. Click the “Automation” button in the Hubspot menu → Workflows.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-color-bgselected-areasteps-9.png)

2\. Click in the upper right corner “Create workflow” → From scratch.

3\. Select the desired item. In our example, the robot will process contacts, so we choose “Contact-based”.

Select “Blank workflow” → click “Next”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-color-bgselected-areasteps-1-1.png)

4\. Click “Set up triggers”. Choose from the list the action with the entity, after which the trigger will work. In our example, when a contact is created. Click “Done” → “Save”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Place-your-screen-25.png)

5\. Click “+” → find on the left the “Send a webhook” action.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-color-bgselected-area-2-3.png)

6\. Select the POST method. Fill in the Webhook URL field with this link: [https://api.wazzup24.com/v3/message](https://api.wazzup24.com/v3/message)

For “Authentication type”, select “API Key”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-color-bgselected-area-3-3.png)

7\. In the “API Key” field, click “Add secret”. A window will open that needs to be filled in like this:

Secret name: Authorization

Secret value: Bearer + API Key

### [Where to get the API key](javascript:void(0))

In your personal Wazzup account. Go to [integration settings](https://app.wazzup24.com/7155-6251/settings/integrations) → tab "More". Copy the key at the bottom of the page.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bg-20-1.png)

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-color-bg-4.png)

Click “Save” — the API Key name field will be filled in automatically.

8\. Leave the “API Key location” field as Request header.

9\. In the “Request body” field, select “Customize request body”.

Here you should choose from which field in the deal the phone number will be taken, to which the automatic message will go. Click “Add property” and fill in the fields:

- Key: chatId
- Value: Phone number

Add three fields by button “Add static value”. First field fill in like this:

- Key: channelId
- Value: “ _your channel ID_“

### [Where to find the channel ID](javascript:void(0))

Go to the "Channels" section in your Wazzup account. Find the desired channel and click on the icon on the right to enter the card.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Place-your-screen-12-1.png)

Now you need to copy the channel ID from the link in the browser:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bgselected-area-4-1.png)

Second field:

- Key: chatType
- Value: “whatsapp”

Third field:

- Key: text
- Value: “ _your text_“

Here’s what it should look like:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bg-66.png)

10\. Save the Webhook, then save the created rule.

Ready! When changing the stage of a deal, Wazzup will automatically send a message to the number of the contact.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to connect Instagram API

In Wazzup you can only connect Instagram API — it’s an official solution by Instagram without bans and proxy connections.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

Connecting the Instagram API isn’t difficult, but you’ll have to poke and prod at the buttons to please the Facebook god of bureaucracy.

You can add the Instagram API channel if you have an Instagram business account linked to a Facebook business page. If you have, skip this section.

### How to convert a user's Instagram account to a business account and link it to Facebook

##### Convert your regular Instagram account to a business account

1\. Go to Instagram's profile page. Click the menu icon ![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/photo_2023-10-10_11-06-00-300x300.jpg) in the top right corner.

2\. Click “Settings and privacy” → near the end of the “Account type and tools” page → Switch to professional account → “Continue” several times.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-nachalo_perekljuchenie-na-prof-akkaunt.png)

3\. Select a category for the business account → "Done".

4\. Select the type of professional account "Business" and press "Next".

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-alert.svg)

If you select "Creator", you will not be able to add a channel.

5\. Check the contact information → Next.

6\. If you are not yet connected to the Accounts Center, a window will appear asking you to do so — click “Not now”. This is not necessary to connect the channel.

##### Switch to your Facebook business page

At this stage, we work with an existing business page or create a new one.

Open your personal Facebook page → go to the "Pages" section in the left panel.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/pages.png)

**If you already have a business page:**

Select the one you need from the list of business pages → click “Switch” on the left panel of the Facebook business page → click "Switch" again.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/more-tools.png)

Then move on to the next step.

**If you don't have a business page yet:**

1\. Click “Create New Page” at the top of the left panel.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-sozdat-novuju-stranicu.png)

2\. Fill in the information → “Create page” → “Next” several times. You now have a Facebook business page.

##### **Link your Instagram business account to your Facebook business page**

1\. Go to “Settings” → Linked Accounts → Instagram →  Connect Account.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-nastrojki-svyazannye-podkljuchit-akk.png)

2\. A window will open asking you to connect your account. Click "Connect".

3\. Leave the “Allow access to Instagram messages in inbox” slider turned on and click “Confirm”.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

The Instagram API feed will not work if you turn off the slider.

If you accidentally turned off this setting, in the Instagram app on your phone, go to “Settings and privacy” → “Messages and story replies” → “Message controls” → at the very bottom, turn on the “Allow access to messages” slider.

4\. A new tab may open to log into Insta — then log in to the account that you link to the business page.

Wait a bit. A notification will appear that the connection is successful.

That's it — you've linked your Instagram business account to your Facebook business page.

#### Add a channel in your personal Wazzup account

To connect the Instagram API, you need to log into Facebook.

1\. [Go to the Channels section](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/channels) of your Wazzup account.

2\. Click “Add channel” and select Instagram API.

3\. Click “Log In”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-dobavlenie-kanala-1.png)

4\. Choose a Facebook profile or log in with your username and password.

5\. Select the Instagram business account for which you are adding the channel → “Next”. You can select more than one account at a time.

6\. Select the Facebook business page to which this Instagram business account is linked and press “Next”. You can select more than one business page.

7\. Leave all the sliders on. If something is disabled and you do not give any rights to the Wazzup Messenger Official API application — the channel will not work properly.

Press “Done” → wait a while → press “Ok”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Group-6.png)

8\. Select the Instagram account you want to create a channel for and click “Add”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-dobavlenie-kanala.png)

If you need to add more than one channel — click the green “Add Channel” button again and select the account to create the Instagram API channel.

Once added, Instagram will appear in the channel list and you’ll start receiving direct messages and comments under the posts.

To prevent salespeople from getting distracted by comments like “I’ll help you make money on crypto” and to avoid “rubbish” deals being created in CRM, set up a comment filter or disable receiving them.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

When you add your first Instagram channel, you have three days to test it for free.

Once Instagram is connected, move on to setting up the integration [Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/integration-with-bitrix24-en/), [Kommo](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/integration-with-kommo-en/), [HubSpot](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/integration-with-hubspot-en/), [Zoho](https://wazzup24.com/help/zoho/integration-with-zoho-crm-en/).

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to connect Telegram Bot

Telegram Bot is needed for customers to write to your Telegram. Deals will be created for new messages, and the correspondence will be saved in CRM.

From this channel you can’t write to clients first. If you need such an option — [connect Telegram Personal](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-telegram-personal/).

#### How to connect

1\. Go to “Channels” → “Add a Channel”.

2\. Select Telegram → Telegram Bot.

3\. Insert the bot token → “Add”.

The channel will be added to the channel list. Chats will appear as soon as customers start writing to you.

### How do I know the token if I already have a bot

1\. Open a Telegram bot for creating bots — @BotFather.

2\. Click the "Menu" button next to the text input line → select the line "/token" from the drop-down list.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/shagi-token-bot-angl.png)

3\. Click your bot in the list that appears.

4\. The bot will send a token → copy it.

### How to get a token if I don't have a bot

1\. Create a bot. To do this, open @BotFather in Telegram.

2\. Click on the "Menu" button next to the text input line → select the top line in the drop-down list "/new bot":

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/shagi-token-novyj-bot-angl.png)

3\. Enter a name for the bot. It will be displayed to users at the top — the same place where the contact name is displayed in chats. After creating a bot, you can change the name through the @BotFather menu — slash to the right of the text input.

4\. Enter a unique name for your bot. It will be its address in Telegram. The name should be in Latin and contain the word "bot" at the end. For example, myCompanyNameBot or myCompanyName\_bot.

If the entered name is already taken — @BotFather will inform you about it:

_Sorry, this username is already taken. Please try something different._

If the name is available @BotFather will congratulate you on creating a new bot and give you a token → copy it:

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/token-angl.png)

Next, connect Wazzup to your CRM:

- [Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/integration-with-bitrix24-en/)
- [Kommo](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/integration-with-kommo-en/)
- [Pipedrive](https://wazzup24.com/help/pipedrive-en/connect-wazzup-to-pipedrive/)
- [HubSpot](https://wazzup24.com/help/integration-with-hubspot-en/)
- [Zoho](https://wazzup24.com/help/zoho/integration-with-zoho-crm-en/)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

## Knowledge Base

[How to connect a messenger](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/)

# How to connect Telegram

You can connect as many Telegram accounts as you want to Wazzup. On each account, chats are distributed to the right employees, and the manager controls the correspondence.

### How many accounts to connect

For most companies, one account is enough, but some companies need multiple accounts because they have:

**Multiple branches**. For example, a chain of beauty salons, where each salon needs a separate number. Employees won't have to distribute requests across branches — customers will write to the right place at once.

**Several departments**. For example, sales departments should have one Telegram account, and HR should have another Telegram account. Then job seekers will go to HR, and clients will go to salespeople.

**Different groups of customers that are handled by different people**. For example, retail customers are handled by some salespeople and wholesale customers by others.

**Each seller has a different number**. This is the case for those guys who handle large deals, like real estate or car sales, and work with the client personally. They usually have business cards with their personal number on them.

If you don’t already have a Telegram account, register it for the number your clients already call. Then they can call and text to the same number.

#### How to connect Telegram to Wazzup

1\. Go to [the “Channels” section](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/channels) → “Add a channel”.

2\. Select Telegram → Telegram Personal.

3\. Scan the QR code. If you have enabled two-factor authentication — enter your password → “Done”.

Once added, the channel will appear in the channel list.

Within 30 seconds, the last three message dialogs will be loaded. The rest of the chats will be loaded when new messages appear: you write to the client or they write to you.

Next, connect Wazzup to your CRM:

- [Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/integration-with-bitrix24-en/)
- [Kommo](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/integration-with-kommo-en/)
- [Pipedrive](https://wazzup24.com/help/pipedrive-en/connect-wazzup-to-pipedrive/)
- [HubSpot](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot/integration-with-hubspot-en/)
- [Zoho](https://wazzup24.com/help/zoho/integration-with-zoho-crm-en/)

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If you’re planning to work with Telegram group chats, make the chat public before anyone sends the first message. After that, you can close it back to private if you need to. Read more about these nuances [in the article about group chats.](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/group-chats/)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to connect the official WhatsApp (WABA)

To activate official WhatsApp, simply add a number to your personal Wazzup account — it takes 10 minutes. Right after that, you will be able to test the service.

You can connect as many official WhatsApp numbers as you want to Wazzup. On each number, chats are allocated to the right employees, and the supervisor controls the correspondence.

#### How to connect official WhatsAapp

Before you start connecting WABA, check your company’s website.

When connecting, you need to provide a link to your site. Meta will check it. If the site does not meet its requirements, your WhatsApp Business account may be blocked.

In order for a site to pass inspection, the “footer”, the very bottom block of the site, needs:

1\. Reference to privacy policy or processing of personal data. Not a PDF, Word doc, or Google Doc — it must be a separate page on your website. If you provide a file or a sketchy link, Meta will reject it.

In the policy, be sure to specify in a separate paragraph that you have the right to send mailings to clients. And the client can always unsubscribe from them.

For example:

_The Company has the right to send the User notifications about new products and services, special offers and various events. The User may opt out of receiving notifications by sending a letter to the Company to the e-mail address address@anymail.com with the note “Opt-out of notifications”._

The wording and method of unsubscribing can be different, but the main thing is to note that you can do mailings. And clients can unsubscribe from them.

2\. The legal name of the company. It must match the company name in Meta’s business portfolio in [Facebook Business Manager](https://business.facebook.com/select/?next=https%3A%2F%2Fbusiness.facebook.com%2Fsettings%2Finfo&ext=1719569849&hash=Afngqy8QoolXzCGMaaQBWbLfDhtLbwAUI1OPQL39uJC48w). One in the same.

If you don’t already have a business portfolio, you can create one when you connect your channel in step six of these instructions.

3\. Legal address. It must also be the same as the address in the Meta business portfolio in [Facebook Business Manager](https://business.facebook.com/select/?next=https%3A%2F%2Fbusiness.facebook.com%2Fsettings%2Finfo&ext=1719569849&hash=Afngqy8QoolXzCGMaaQBWbLfDhtLbwAUI1OPQL39uJC48w).

Example on how everything can look like:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Place-your-screen-9-2.png)

If everything is okay, proceed to connect in Wazzup

##### Adding a WABA channel in Wazzup personal account

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

Make sure that you connect the WABA number to the Wazzup account where it will be used. If you add the number to the wrong account, you will not be able to connect it to another account yourself. It will take time and help from our support.

1. Log in to [the “Channels” section](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/channels?utm_source=help&utm_medium=instruction&utm_campaign=en&utm_content=how-to-migrate-a-WABA-number-to-Wazzup-from-another-service) of your Wazzup account.

2\. Click “Add Channel” → WhatsApp → WABA → Continue Adding → a new tab will open in your browser. Leave this tab open until the end of the connection — you need it at the end.

3\. Click the blue “Continue with Facebook” button.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/continue-fb-1.png)

4\. A new browser window with Facebook will open → log in to Facebook in this window.

If nothing opens, check that:

- pop-ups in the browser are not blocked,
- and extensions that change the appearance of the page have been disabled. For example, translators, or ad blockers.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

You should log in to Facebook from your personal account with your real name and surname, photo and profile description. Meta can conduct identity verification

5\. Click “Get Started”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/vaba-angl-1.png)

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

Please note, when connecting, you may see a request for access from a Gupshup technical partner. Everything is fine — the connection is working correctly.

6\. Select a business portfolio or create a new one. It can also be called a business account.

If you already have a business portfolio, click on it, click “Next” and go to step 7. If you do not have a business portfolio yet, select “Create a business portfolio” → “Next” from the drop-down list.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Place-your-screen-19.png)

### [What is a Meta Business Portfolio and how to create one](javascript:void(0))

Meta Business Portfolio is your company's account to which WhatsApp and Facebook Ads are connected. You cannot connect WABA without it. The account is free of charge.

To create, specify:

- Company Name. Enter the name as it is recorded in the company documents. For example, in the TIN.
- Company email address. Enter the mail address;
- Company website. Specify at once an actual site that fits Meta requirements - it will be checked when creating an account;
- Company address. Specify it correctly right away, it must match the address on the website. How to fill in the address correctly: country, address starting with the street, city, state/region/region, postal code. Do not fill in the “Address 2” field.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If you specify an incorrect address, Meta will block the account as suspicious. Later, you will still have to go through verification and provide accurate data.

The exact address may not be added, but if you plan to [confirm the company](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-and-why-to-verify-a-company-in-meta) it is better to do it at once. Then write the address the same way as in the documents.

Click "Next."

7\. Select an existing WhatsApp Business Account or create a new one.

To create a new account, you must specify:

- the username for the account,
- the display name of the profile,
- time zone,
- category,
- website.

The username for the account won’t be seen by your clients. You need it to distinguish one account from another if you have more than one.

The display will be seen on your WhatsApp profile. The name must match the legal name of the company or the name in the header and footer of your site.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-imya-profilya.png)

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-alert.svg)

If the name is incorrect, you will not be able to star first more than 250 conversations in 24 hours. But you can reply to incoming messages without limits.

So if you plan to do mailings and often write first, it is better to specify the display name as required by Meta immediately.

👉 [How correspondence on WABA channels works](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/waba-and-whatsapp/#p2)

### [How to correctly name the profile](javascript:void(0))

The main requirement is that the display name must refer to your company. This is what Meta checks.

If the display name matches the legal name one to one, everything is a okay, Meta will approve it.

If the display name does not match the legal name, Meta checks your site. The name must match the one indicated in the header and footer of the site.

Don't edit the name. Do not remove words, do not add new ones, do not add emojis.

Exception: Only words that indicate the location of the company, a specific department or its function can be added to the name. For example, when you create separate profiles for different branches.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-primer-imya-profilya.png)

In some cases, it will not be possible to include your company name in the display name, because Meta does not allow you to use:

- General terms. For example, "Umbrellas", "Textiles" and so on.
- Cities, countries, regions. For example, you cannot simply write “Moscow” or “Europe” in the name.
- Slogan or long description,
- Names printed only in lowercase letters or LIKE THIS, through Caps.

For such cases, there is a life hack:

1. Think up and specify the name you want to use in the profile.
2. Before verification, change the name of the company on the site to the one indicated in the profile. This is just for a few days, while the verification is in progress.
3. Submit the company for verification. When it finishes, Meta will immediately start checking the profile name.
4. When the name is confirmed, you can return the original name to site.

You can specify the company description in this step, or you can specify it later in your Wazzup account.

Click “Next”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-profil-va-biznes.png)

8\. Add a WhatsApp Business number.

But it is better to proceedtothisstepif you are surethatyourcompanycomplies with the Metatradingpolicy.If in doubt, we recommend that you firstuse the instruction below“How to additionallysecure a numberfrom theban“so that yournumber is notblockedwhenconnecting.

### [How to additionally secure a number from the ban](javascript:void(0))

- In front of you is a windowforentering a phonenumber→closeit.
- Wait for about1hour, do nottakeanyaction.
- After1hour, clickon the [link](https://business.facebook.com/settings/whatsapp-business-accounts) →apagewithyourcompanies' accountsinBusinessManager opens →select the company(businessportfolio)that you registered.
- A windowwithinformationaboutyourcompany opens→ see the"Business information" section →"Accountstatus".
- Ifyousee the status"Approved",theneverything is inorderand you cancontinueregisteringyourbusinessportfolio.If there is anyotherstatus, writetoWazzupsupport,we will help you unlock the number. ![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/en-3.png)

Please note that the selected number must not have either a regular personal WhatsApp account or a WhatsApp Business account.

### [What to do if WhatsApp is already registered on the number](javascript:void(0))

1\. If the number has a WhatsApp or a WhatsApp Business account, you must delete it from the application on your phone: [Android](https://faq.whatsapp.com/android/account-and-profile/how-to-delete-your-account/?lang=en), [iPhone](https://faq.whatsapp.com/iphone/account-and-profile/how-to-delete-your-account/?lang=en) or change the number for this account: [Android](https://faq.whatsapp.com/android/account-and-profile/how-to-change-your-phone-number/?lang=en), [iPhone](https://faq.whatsapp.com/iphone/account-and-profile/how-to-change-your-phone-number?lang=en).

**Deleting the account** will entail:

— deleting the message history;

— removing you from all your WhatsApp groups;

— deleting the backup from Google Drive.

**In case of changing** WhatsApp phone number:

— all of your account information, including profile picture, name, individual and group chats, information and settings will be transferred from your old phone number to your new number;

— the WhatsApp account associated with your former phone number will be deleted. Your old number will no longer appear in your contacts’ WhatsApp contact lists.

2\. After that register the number in WABA.

When you delete the number from the application and the company has not yet been verified by Meta, you will not be able to write from WhatsApp on your phone and you will be out of touch with customers for a few days. If customers write — you won't get messages and you won't know that someone wrote to you.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-alert.svg)

Once you’ve added a phone number to WhatsApp Business, don’t add that number to the WhatsApp application on your phone!

If you add the WABA channel number to the app on your phone, the WABA channel will stop working!

**Select a confirmation method.** You will need to enter a 6-digit code to confirm the phone. You can get the code in a text message or by a call from the robot. SMS is better.

Click “Next”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-dobavit-nomer.png)

9\. Enter the code and press “Next”.

10\. Click “Continue”.

11\. Click “Finish”.

12\. The Facebook window will close. The tab that was open when you started connecting the feed will remain on the screen. It’s this one:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/gupshup-1.png)

The tab will automatically refresh. A list of numbers that are associated with your WhatsApp Business account will appear on the screen. Select the number you are connecting → tap “Confirm” → and again tap “Confirm”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/chekboks-gupshup-1.png)

13\. A loading screen will appear:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/gupshup-ekran-zagruzki-1-1.png)

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

Wait until the download completes and a notification appears on the screen that WABA is connected.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/gupshup-ekran-uspeha-1.png)

Only then can you close the tab.

14\. Done! In about 10 minutes the WABA channel will appear as “Active” [in your Wazzup account](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/channels?utm_source=help&utm_medium=instruction&utm_campaign=en&utm_content=how-to-connect-the-official-WhatsApp-WABA).

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

When you add your first WABA channel, you have a three-day test period. You can use the service for free and reply to incoming messages with regular messages.

To write first and try WABA templates, you need to replenish your balance. 1-2 dollars or euro will be enough to send templates of different categories several times

If you don’t have a Meta-verified business, after connecting the channel you’ll be able to initiate 250 conversations per day using WABA templates — this is a Meta limitation. You can reply to incoming messages without any restrictions.

### [WABA messaging limits](javascript:void(0))

When a customer sends you a message, this incoming message opens a 24-hour service window. If the contact messages you again within 24 hours, the new incoming message will extend the service window: it will remain active for 24 hours from the time of the last received message.

Within an active service window, you can send both WABA templates and regular messages.

If there's no existing conversation with the contact or no incoming messages have been received in the chat within the last 24 hours, you can only send a WABA template.

**Limits on correspondence**

Meta assigns tiers to WhatsApp Business accounts — these indicate how many WABA templates you can send within 24 hours outside of service windows:

- Tier 0: 250 templates,
- Tier 1: 1,000 templates,
- Tier 2: 10,000 templates,
- Tier 3: 100,000 templates,
- Tier 4: unlimited.

If a customer messages you first, you can reply with regular messages without limit — restrictions only apply to templates.

For example, you just connected WABA and have Tier 0. Salesperson Max received messages from 100 people in 24 hours — he can reply to all these inquiries since incoming messages aren't limited. Max can also send 250 templates outside service windows, meaning he can start conversations with 250 new customers by sending each one template. In total, the salesperson can communicate with 350 customers in 24 hours. A very productive salesperson.

If you frequently initiate conversations or plan to run messaging campaigns, we recommend verifying your business with Meta. Verification helps increase trust in your profile and may eventually raise your limits for initiated conversations.

[To increase your limit](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/messaging-limits), keep up a high-quality message history: start conversations with real clients, avoid spam, and respond promptly. The better your reputation, the more conversations you’ll be allowed to start each day — up to 1,000 and beyond.

[👉 How to verify your company](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-and-why-to-verify-a-company-in-meta/)

You can reply to incoming messages without limits, regardless of your current tier.

Once you have connected WABA, configure the integration: [Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/integration-with-bitrix24-en/), [Kommo](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/integration-with-kommo-en/).

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

## How to connect Viber to Wazzup - Wazzup Knowledge base

> **Source:** https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-connect-viber-to-wazzup/

# How to connect Viber to Wazzup

You can connect as many Viber numbers as you want to Wazzup. On each number, chats are distributed to the right employees, and the manager controls the correspondence.

### How many numbers to connect

Most companies need just one number, but some companies need several numbers because they have

**Several branches**. For example, a chain of beauty salons, where each salon needs a separate number. Employees won't have to distribute requests to branches - clients will write to the right place;

**Several departments**. For example, the sales department would have one WhatsApp account, and HR would have another WhatsApp account; then job applicants would go to HR, and clients would go to sales.

**Different groups of customers that different people work with**. For example, retail customers are handled by some salespeople and wholesalers by others;

**Each manager has a different number**. This is the case for those guys who handle big deals, like selling real estate or cars, and work with the client personally. They usually have business cards with a personal number on them.

If you don’t have a Viber account yet, register it for the number your customers already call. Then they can call and text to the same number.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If you have just registered a Viber account, we advise you to use the messenger from your phone for 24 hours. It is enough to communicate with 10-15 people, you can write anything and to anyone.

If you connect a new number to Wazzup at once — there is a risk that it will be banned

#### How to connect Viber

When active chats appeared on the number:

1\. Go to the “Channels” section in your Wazzup account.

2\. If you are connecting a channel for the first time, select Viber.

If you already have messengers connected to Wazzup, click “Add a channel” → select Viber.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-color-bgselected-area-31.png)

3\. Scan the QR code: in the Viber app on your phone, tap “More” on the bottom right → QR code icon in the top right corner.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Group-4.png)

4\. After a few seconds, you will receive a notification that you are logged in to your account from a new device. In the application on your phone there will be a suggestion to synchronize chats — click “Sync”.

Done — Viber will appear in the “Channels” section.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bg-61.png)

The last three conversations with messages will be loaded.

The rest of the chats will be loaded when there are new messages in them: you write to the client or they write to you.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

When you have added your first Viber channel, you have a three-day test period. You can use the service for free and test features without restrictions

#### Hownot to getbannedfromViber

Vibermaybanyouforspam.Blockingcanbebothtemporaryandpermanent,but there are no transparentcriteriafromViber. That‘swhatthey say:

> If you are suspected of being a spammer, your account will be blocked. This means that you won’t be able to send any messages; however, you will still be able to receive messages.
>
> Most first-time account blocks are temporary and resolved automatically after 24 hours. If Rakuten Viber’s anti-spam system identifies you as a spammer again, you will be permanently blocked.

You may be suspected of being a spammer if you used Viber to:

- Send messages containing suspicious links, phone numbers, or email addresses
- Send messages to people who don’t have you saved in their contact list, resulting in them blocking or reporting you
- Send the same message to a large number of people
- Send messages from your business to people who didn’t consent to receive messages on Viber from you

We advise you torespondtonotificationsinWazzupchats in time. For example,ifyoureceive an errorwith the textbelowwhensendingmessagesfrom the Viberchannel, you need to check if everythingisinorderintheViberapplication itself:

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-alert.svg)

Message not sent. Viber may have blocked your number. Try sending the message from the Viber app. If it doesn’t work, and there are no restrictions from Viber, please contact our support.

Next, connect Wazzup to your CRM: [Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/integration-with-bitrix24-en/), [Kommo](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/integration-with-kommo-en/), [HubSpot](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/integration-with-hubspot-en/), [Zoho](https://wazzup24.com/help/zoho/integration-with-zoho-crm-en/).

# How to connect WhatsApp

You will need a phone with the WhatsApp app or WhatsApp Business to connect.

You can connect as many WhatsApp numbers as you like to Wazzup. On each number, chats are allocated to the right employees and the manager controls the correspondence.

### How many numbers to connect

Most companies need just one number, but some companies need several numbers because they have

**Several branches**. For example, a chain of beauty salons, where each salon needs a separate number. Employees won't have to distribute requests to branches - clients will write to the right place;

**Several departments**. For example, the sales department would have one WhatsApp account, and HR would have another WhatsApp account; then job applicants would go to HR, and clients would go to sales.

**Different groups of customers that different people work with**. For example, retail customers are handled by some salespeople and wholesalers by others;

**Each manager has a different number**. This is the case for those guys who handle big deals, like selling real estate or cars, and work with the client personally. They usually have business cards with a personal number on them.

If you don’t already have a WhatsApp account, sign it up for the number your clients already call (even a landline will do). That way they can call and text to the same number.

### How to add a landline number to WhatsApp

Adding a landline number is very easy. You will need WhatsApp Business for this.

1. Open the WhatsApp application on your phone → "Accept and continue".
2. Enter your phone number → "Next".
3. Tap "OK".
4. Wait a minute for the buttons to become active.
5. Select "Call me".
6. Press "Not now".
7. Accept the call and enter the code that the robot will dictate.

Done, you have added a landline number to WhatsApp.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-alert.svg)

If you’ve just registered a WhatsApp account or if you logged into the account from another phone before connecting to the service — you should correspond in the messenger from your phone within a day. It’s enough to communicate with 10-15 people.

#### How to connect WhatsApp to Wazzup

If you connect a new number to Wazzup right away, you risk getting banned. To avoid it you should text from your WhatsApp app for 24 hours without connecting to our service. You can write anything and anyone you want. 10-15 active chats are enough.

1. [Go to Channels](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/channels) → Add Channel.

2\. Choose WhatsApp → WhatsApp.

3\. Scan the QR code on screen or connect the channel via phone number.

**How to log in via QR code**

Tap “⁝” (Android) or “Settings” (iPhone) → Linked devices → Link a device → scan the code with your camera.

**How to log in via phone number**

In the “Log in via phone number” tab, enter the WhatsApp account number you want to connect → tap “Continue”.

Enter the verification code that appears in your Wazzup account into the WhatsApp app. WhatsApp may automatically send you a notification requesting the code on your phone. If this doesn’t happen, tap “⁝” (Android) or “Settings” (iPhone) → Linked devices → Link a device → Link with phone number.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/podkljuchenie-po-nomeru-angl.png)

Done! The channel will appear in your channels list.

Within 30 seconds, the last three chats with messages will be uploaded. The rest of the chats will be loaded when you’ll get new messages in them: you text the client or they text you.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

To keep the channel running steadily, open WhatsApp on your phone once every couple of weeks. If you don’t, WhatsApp will unlog you out of Wazzup and other related devices. Then you’ll have to reconnect the channel.

.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

When you add your first WhatsApp channel, you have a three-day test period. You can use the service for free and test the features without restrictions.

Next, connect Wazzup to your CRM: [Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/integration-with-bitrix24-en/), [Kommo](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/integration-with-kommo-en/), [HubSpot](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/integration-with-hubspot-en/), [Zoho](https://wazzup24.com/help/zoho/integration-with-zoho-crm-en/).

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to give employees access to applications

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

Your employees can communicate with customers not only in Wazzup CRM chats, but also in our applications:

- in mobile app
- in PC application — it works from a computer desktop
- in Wazzup Web — it is a dialog box in the browser

Employees can use either one application or all of them at once.

👉 [Which Wazzup app is right for you](https://wazzup24.com/help/sell-easier-en/mobile-app-en/)

1\. Go to the [“CRM Integration” section](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations) → “Select roles”. You will see a modal window with a list of employees. There you will also find hints on how to assign roles and what they mean. If you have several channels, select the roles for employees on each of them.
![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Vybrat-roli-2-kanala-EN.png)

2\. Go to the [“Mobile Application” section](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/mobile). You will see a list of all employees. Employees with the status “No phone specified” do not have access to Wazzup applications yet, they are the ones we are interested in.
![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Ne-ukazan-tlf-EN.png)

3\. To give access, click on the pencil to the right of the employee’s name → enter the employee’s phone number (SMS codes will be sent to it to log in) → “Change”. The employee’s status will change to “Accessed”.
![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Group-8.png)

4\. SMS with a link to download the mobile application will be sent to the specified phone. The employee can use the link to install the application and log in using the phone number that you specified.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

There is a limitation: SMS will be sent to only 20 employees. If the employee would not receive an SMS, ask him to download the Wazzup mobile application [via the link](https://download-app.wazzup24.com/)

👉 Instructions for employees: [how to install and set up applications](https://wazzup24.com/help/sell-easier-en/how-to-install-and-set-up-applications/)

5\. After the employee logs into the mobile application, Wazzup Web or PC application, the employee’s status will change to “Already using”. The date of the last login will appear to the right in the “Was online” column.
![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Group-14.png)

# Integration with PlanFix

To begin, [create a channel](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-create-a-channel-in-wazzup-en/). You can find out more about what a [channel](https://wazzup24.com/help/communication-channels-en/) is in a separate article.

After that, go to the “Integrations” section in your Wazzup personal account and press the “Add integration” button. A window will appear. Choose “planfix”:

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/1-17.png)

A data entry window will appear. Do not close it – you will soon need the authorization key.

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2-22.png)

Now log into PlanFix to create the integration. In PlanFix, in the top right corner, there is the menu icon. Go to the “Account management” section.

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/3-19.png)

The settings menu will open on the left side:

— for WhatsApp, select the section “Integrations” → “Messengers” → “WhatsApp”,

— for Instagram, select the section “Integrations” → “Social media” → “Instagram”.

A menu to choose the integration type will appear. Click the toggle below the “WZ” logo.

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/5-17.png)A data entry window will open. In the same window, you can configure your templates. To complete the integration, you will need your authorization key. Go back to your Wazzup personal account and copy the key:

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/6-16.png)

Then return to PlanFix. Enter the e-mail address to your Wazzup personal account in the first field – and your authorization key in the second. Press “Save”:

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/7-16.png)

If all the fields have been filled in correctly, the icon will be surrounded with a green border and the toggle will become green:

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/8-11.png)

Return to your Wazzup personal account and fill in the fields:

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/9-13.png)

1\. Copy the full PlanFix domain name from the address bar:

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/10-12.png)

2\. Choose the channel you want to integrate with PlanFix.

3\. Press “Connect”.

After that, you will see a PlanFix entry in the list of integration. This means that the integration has been successful.

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/11-9.png)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

## WABA template blocking: why it happens and how to avoid it - Wazzup Knowledge base

> **Source:** https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-make-a-mailing-in-waba-and-not-get-banned/

> **Description:** WABA allows mailings, but if customers complain about your messages, it blocks the templates. In this case, the status of the template changes from

[Skip to content](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-make-a-mailing-in-waba-and-not-get-banned/#content "Skip to content")

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-help-logo.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/main-en/)

[How to connect a messenger](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/)

# WABA template blocking: why it happens and how to avoid it

WABA allows mailings, but if customers complain about your messages, it blocks the templates. In this case, the status of the template changes from “Active” to “Rejected”, and the tooltip next to the status indicates that Meta has blocked the template due to complaints.

As a result, the rating of the business account drops, and with it the number of available correspondence per day decreases. If you try very hard, you can even get your account blocked, but such cases are rare.

To keep customers from sending your marketing messages to spam, add an unsubscribe button to the template. If a person doesn’t want to receive a newsletter, they will simply unsubscribe from it. You’ll know about it, you can unsubscribe him, and you’ll save your account’s rating.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

Even if the customer opts out, you’ll still be able to contact him.

When a person clicks the unsubscribe button, they’re trying to opt out of a certain type of message. Promotional newsletters may not always be welcome — but a notification that a long-awaited order has been handed over to the courier is a different story.

If you don’t include an unsubscribe button, the customer might just hit “Report” and block you. The “Unsubscribe” button gives them a softer way to say no.

#### Types of messages you should send with the button

The button will be useful in “Marketing” templates.

Don’t add a button to every message in a row. It might encourage the customer to unsubscribe.

It’s best to attach a button to such messages:

- The first message the customer receives from your company.
- The first message after a long period of no marketing messages.
- Messages that are sent to unengaged customers.

#### How to add a button to the message

When you create a template, add a button with the text “unsubscribe”. You can choose a different text, but it should be clear that the client is unsubscribing.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/image_2023-01-22_17-06-47.png)

The button works just like other text buttons in templates. If a client wants to unsubscribe and clicks on it, you will receive a message with the text from the button.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-alert.svg)

If the client unsubscribes, you have to unsubscribe him yourself. Meta cannot unsubscribe a customer from your newsletters and offers no tools to do so, except sending messages to spam.

#### How to respond to opt-out mailings

Some tips on how to respond to a customer’s unsubscribe message:

- Send a confirmation that the customer has unsubscribed.
- Ask why the customer no longer wants to receive newsletters from you. For example, send a different template with response options in buttons, or a Salesbot button message if you work in amoCRM.
- Send a message with a “Subscribe” button in case the customer changes his mind or accidentally clicks the button.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/image_2023-01-22_17-08-33.png)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to transfer a WABA number to Wazzup from another service

Transferring WhatsApp Business API (WABA) number from another service is not difficult, but it is important to do everything according to the instructions together with our support team.

You will need access to the WABA number and the Facebook account to which the Meta business account with the required WABA number is connected.

#### Step 1: Disable two-factor authentication on your WABA account

To do this, contact the support of the service where you worked with WABA.

#### Step 2. Add a channel according to these instructions

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

If you are transferring several channels and they belong to different WhatsApp Business accounts, first transfer those that are linked to the same WhatsApp Business account. And then those channels that are tied to another. It will be easier.

To find out which WhatsApp Business account has a WABA number attached to it, go to [Facebook’s WhatsApp Manager](https://business.facebook.com/wa/manage/home/)

1. Log in to [the “Channels” section](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/channels?utm_source=help&utm_medium=instruction&utm_campaign=en&utm_content=how-to-migrate-a-WABA-number-to-Wazzup-from-another-service) of your Wazzup account.

2\. Click “Add Channel” → WhatsApp → WABA → Continue.

3\. A new tab will open in your browser. Leave this tab open until the end of the connection — you need it at the end.

Click the blue “Continue with Facebook” button.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/continue-fb-1024x543.png)

4\. A new browser window with Facebook will open. Log in to the Facebook account to which the Meta business account with the desired WABA number is linked.

If nothing opens, check that:

- pop-ups are not blocked in your browser,
- extensions that change the appearance of the page are disabled. For example, translators or ad blockers.

5\. Click “Get started”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/get-started.png)

6\. Select the Meta business account that is connected with the number you want to transfer to Wazzup → click “Next”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-meta-biznes-akk.png)

7\. Click “Create a WhatsApp Business account” → Next.

Also at this step you need to know the IDs of already created WhatsApp Business accounts — these IDs will be useful later to distinguish WhatsApp Business accounts:

Click on the “Choose a WhatsApp Business account” box → a list of your WhatsApp Business accounts will appear — take a screenshot or photo and save it.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If you are transferring several channels that are linked to the same WhatsApp Business account and you have already transferred one of them — when you start thansfer the others, chose the created WhatsApp Business account for the first of these channels.

In this case, a new WhatsApp profile is needed for each channel. That is, in the second field “Create or select a WhatsApp Business profile” leave the option “Create a new WhatsApp Business profile” while updating any channel

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-create-whatsapp-business-account-1.png)

8\. Fill in the company information.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

The username and the displayed profile name must match the one you are using for your WhatsApp Business profile now. For example, if it was “BestCompany Support”, it should be “BestCompany Support” now

Business description can be specified immediately, or you can specify it later in your personal Wazzup account.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-profil-va-biznes-1.png)

9\. A window for adding a number will open — select “Add new or existing number”. Enter your WABA channel number and select the number confirmation method → click “Next”.

Facebook will show a yellow warning that the number is already registered. Check that the phone with the WABA number is turned on and connected → press “Next”.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/photo_2024-06-25_00-47-04.jpg)

10\. Enter the code and click “Next” → then “Continue” → and “Finish”.

11\. The Facebook window will close. The tab that was open back at the beginning will remain on the screen. This one:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/continue-fb-1.png)

The tab will automatically refresh. A list of your WhatsApp Business accounts or a selection of numbers as in step 10 will appear on the screen.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bg-67.png)

Accounts are differentiated by ID. Select the new one you created in step five. To understand where it is, look at the screenshot with the list of WhatsApp Business accounts you created in the same fifth step. You need the account with the ID that is not in the screenshot.

When you have selected the account you want, click “Next”.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bgselected-areasteps-10.png)

12\. Select the phone number of your channel → press “Confirm” → and “Confirm” again.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bgselected-areasteps-11.png)

13\. You will see a loading screen:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/gupshup-ekran-zagruzki-1.png)

Wait for a notification that WABA is connected. Only then can you close the tab.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/gupshup-ekran-uspeha.png)

14\. Done! In about 15 minutes the WABA channel will be in the “Active” status.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to connect integration with Pipedrive

1\. Open [the “Integration with CRM” section](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations?utm_source=help&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=ru&utm_content=how-to-connect-integration-with-pipedrive) in your Wazzup personal account. Select Pipedrive.

2\. Insert your Pipedrive domain and click “Continue” → “Connect”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-111.png)

3\. In the browser tab that opens, select “All users”. Tick “Notify users via email as well” if you want your employees to receive emails about the connection.

4\. Click “Next”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-2.png)

5\. Scroll down the list of app permissions and click “Allow and Install”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/rus-3-e1715815083685.png)

Done! Now you should:

- [set up the integration](https://wazzup24.com/help/pipedrive-en/how-to-set-up-integration-with-pipedrive/),
- ask employees who will work in the application to install [Wazzup from the Pipedrive Marketplace](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/marketplace/app/wazzup-whats-app-instagram-and-telegram/8d137dd6cec902a8). There is no need for them to sign up in Wazzup.

Content

Show

- [How integration works](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/pipedrive-connection/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)

  - [Where is the correspondence stored](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/pipedrive-connection/#wz24-toc-anchor-1-0)

#### How integration works

##### Where is the correspondence stored

Chating history reserved:

- in Wazzup chats,
- in Pipedrive chats — Messaging Inbox,
- in notes.

👉 [Where are Wazzup chats located and how they work in Pipedrive](https://wazzup24.com/help/pipedrive-en/where-are-the-wazzup-chats-in-pipedrive/)

##### What chats do employees see

New messages are visible to everyone seller. And the messages of current customers are different in Wazzup chats and Pipedrive chats.

- In Wazzup chats, messages are displayed to employees depending on integration settings and responsibility for contact, lead, deal,
- In the Messaging Inbox, all messages are visible to all employees.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

Responsibility for conversations does not affect the visibility of chats in Wazzup — it is only affected by responsibility for contact, lead or deal.

As soon as an employee answers, they need to indicate in the contact card that they are responsible for it. This is necessary so that the chat is visible in Wazzup chats only for the seller who took the client. For other employees with the “Sales rep” role, the chat will disappear

##### How to create contacts, leads and deals

We do not automatically generate leads and deals in Pipedrive. If the salesperson decides they need to create a lead, they need to do it themselves in CRM.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

When creating a contact and a lead, do not change the fields that are already filled. So the client’s contact details will be correctly pulled into the contact and lead fields

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Setting up comments from Instagram

Not only direct messages come from Instagram, but also comments. Each comment from a new user creates a deal in the CRM — the salesperson can reply to the client under the post or in direct.

If you don’t want to receive comments from Instagram, turn them off and only correspond with clients in direct. Or set up filters to receive only selected comments.

### [How to disable comments](javascript:void(0))

1\. Go to the Channels section of your Wazzup Personal Area.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bgselected-area-3.png)2\. Press the gear icon on the right side of the channel bar → the channel card opens.

3\. Switch off the slider in step 3.

#### Comment filters from Instagram

1\. Go to [the “Channels” section](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/channels) of your personal Wazzup account.![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/oplaiy.png)2\. Tap the gear icon on the right side of the channel bar → the channel card opens. The comment filters are set in steps 3-4.

##### 3\. Receive comments from posts

This setting will save your staff time in processing comments.

**If you have posts from which you do not want to receive comments** → select “From all except those listed” and insert the links to the posts in the input field.

**If you rarely publish posts aimed at collecting bids** → select “Only from listed” and insert links to the selling posts.

For example, you’ve posted a post featuring a new product. In the comments, people ask about price, size range and delivery. These are potential bids that sellers need to handle. Add the posts to the filter and you won’t miss out on leads.

**If you want to receive all comments** → select “From all except those listed” and leave the “Links to posts” field blank.

##### 4\. Filter against spam comments

Emoji and comments often appear under posts on Instagram in which subscribers express their opinions rather than a desire to buy. To avoid employees wasting their time processing other people’s emotions — set up a filter.

Initially, the words “awesome”, “classy” and “great” are added to the filter. You can delete them and add your own. If comments contain any of the words in the filter — they won’t go into the CRM.

Remember to click “Save” on top of the channel card after making any changes to the settings.

# Integration with WABA and WhatsApp — differences, conditions, connection

There are two ways to connect WhatsApp to CRM: through integration with WhatsApp ( just WhatsApp in the text below) and the official Meta solution — WhatsApp Business API (WABA).

Both solutions allow managers to correspond with clients from the CRM, but the connection process, functions and tasks of these solutions are different. Not every business will benefit from integration with WABA, and not every problem will be solved by integration with WhatsApp.

Let’s look in detail at the advantages and disadvantages of each solution.
