# How to select employee roles in Wazzup without getting lost in chats

In Wazzup, every employee has a role. It defines which chats they can see and whether they can message clients.

#### How to select roles to employees

When setting up the CRM integration, the system will prompt you to assign roles to your team. Here’s how:

1\. Go to the “CRM Integration” section.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Roli-angl.png)

2\. Click “Select Roles” — a window will open where you can select roles.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

What does “Receives new clients” mean? This toggle appears next to the role. If enabled, the employee will receive messages from new contacts that are not yet in your CRM. Handy if you want to catch all incoming messages first.

3\. All set? Click “Save” — and you’re good to go 🚀

#### What roles are available and what they do

There are three roles — pick the one that fits the employee’s tasks:

- **Supervisor** — has full visibility and messaging access. Can chat with any client and see all conversations. Ideal for sales team leads, handling big deals, or overseeing the entire picture.
- **Manager** — handles client communication and orders. Can only see chats with clients they’re responsible for in the CRM. Other chats are hidden — helpful for staying focused.
- **Quality Control** — observer role. Can’t write messages but sees all managers’ chats to monitor communication quality.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

Just starting with Wazzup? Assign the Supervisor role to the CRM admin — it’s the easiest way to test and configure. You can change or remove it later.

#### Role assignment examples

Here’s how to distribute roles for different cases:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| If each manager works only with their own clients | Select them the **Manager** role. They’ll only see their own chats — no distractions, no confusion. |
| If everyone needs to see all messages sent to the number | Select the **Supervisor** role. Great for support teams or online stores — anyone available can reply, no need to reassign chats manually. |
| If only one person answers messages from the channel | Go with **Supervisor** again. Even if something goes wrong with CRM responsibilities, they’ll still see all incoming messages and be able to respond. |

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

> **Description:** When a WhatsApp Business API (WABA) template passes moderation, it can be sent to customers. When to Send a WABA Template WABA templates are required

# How to work with WABA templates in chats

When a WhatsApp Business API (WABA) template passes moderation, it can be sent to customers.

Content

Show

- [When to Send a WABA Template](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/how-to-work-with-waba-templates-in-chats/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)
- [How to write with WABA first](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/how-to-work-with-waba-templates-in-chats/#wz24-toc-anchor-1)
- [How to fill in variables](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/how-to-work-with-waba-templates-in-chats/#wz24-toc-anchor-2)
- [How to send out templates automatically](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/how-to-work-with-waba-templates-in-chats/#wz24-toc-anchor-3)

#### When to Send a WABA Template

WABA templates are required whenever you:

- want to start a conversation with a new customer you haven’t contacted before,
- want to message a customer but don’t have an active service window in their chat.

**What is a Customer Service Window** When a customer sends you a message, this incoming message opens a 24-hour service window. If the contact messages you again within 24 hours, the new incoming message extends the service window: it remains active for 24 hours from the time of the last received message.

Within an active service window, you can send both regular free messages and WABA templates.

If there’s no existing conversation with the contact or no incoming messages have been received in the chat within the last 24 hours, you can only send a WABA template.

#### How to write with WABA first

To send a WABA template from Wazzup chat, go to the dialog and select a template from the list by pressing the “/” button.

If there are variables in the template, fill in the fields — otherwise you will not be able to send the template. If you want to leave the variable field empty, put a space.

You can also start a correspondence with any text: not necessarily one that you have agreed with Facebook. To do this, type a message and send it — it will leave with an empty WABA template.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Wazzup-Google-Chrome-2022-07-27-14-44-52.gif)

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If you send a WABA template of one of the categories for the first time in 24 hours, [the money for starting a 24-hour conversation will be deducted](https://wazzup24.com/help/payment-en/waba-billing/) from your balance. Including if you use empty templates, which we automatically send for approval.

The cost of conversation depends on the category of the template. To see which category a template belongs to, go to the “Templates” section  → WABA Templates → click on the “pencil” next to the desired template.

#### How to fill in variables

Everything is simple — just enter the text. But take into account the features that affect the view of the message in the chat.

Variables are needed to tailor the message to different clients. They are not designed for a large amount of text, so variables cannot be indented. This means that it will not be possible to make a large text convenient for the client.

If you add hyphens or tab characters, they will disappear after the template is sent. Therefore, it is better to make the text in variables shorter, and after the client’s response, send the expanded text in regular messages.

#### How to send out templates automatically

WABA templates can be sent out automatically, but it is important not to bore the client. If he considers the message to be spam, he can complain about it. If there are many complaints from different clients about one message, Meta will block your template.

To send out the template, you will need CRM tools: Salesbot in Kommo and Business Processes or Robots in Bitrix24.

👉 [Kommo: how to send a WABA template via Salesbot](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/how-to-write-to-a-client-on-whatsapp-with-salesbot/)

👉 [Bitrix24: how to send a WABA template via Business Processes](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/how-to-send-a-message-to-whatsapp-from-business-processes/)

👉 [Bitrix24: how to send a WABA template via Robot](https://wazzup24.com/help/bitrix24-en/how-to-use-waba-templates-in-bitrix24-automation-rules-and-business-processes/)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How Wazzup chats work

Wazzup chats is a dialogue window from where you can correspond with clients.

You can use Wazzup chats in your CRM or through our apps. Chats look the same everywhere and have the features of familiar messengers.

👉 Where to find Wazzup chats in [Kommo](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/wazzup-chats-for-kommo-en/) and [Bitrix24](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/wazzup-chat-in-bitrix24-en/)

Content

Show

- [Unanswered and unread messages](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/how-wazzup-chats-work/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)
- [Which chats the seller can see](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/how-wazzup-chats-work/#wz24-toc-anchor-1)
- [How to write to a client from another channel](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/how-wazzup-chats-work/#wz24-toc-anchor-2)
- [Why Wazzup News chat is needed](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/how-wazzup-chats-work/#wz24-toc-anchor-3)

#### Unanswered and unread messages

Wazzup doesn’t have “unread” messages like messengers, it only has “unanswered” messages.

At the top of the chat list are chats with clients who haven’t yet received an answer. No dialog is lost if a sales rep reads a message and forgets to reply.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/neotvechennye.png)

To make the message notification disappear, you have to reply to the client or click the “No reply needed” button.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bgselected-area-4-3.png)

When there are no unanswered messages in the dialog, the button will disappear.

#### Which chats the seller can see

The visibility of chats depends on the employee’s role in the [integration settings](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations). The role determines the rights: what chats he sees and whether he can correspond with clients.

#### How to write to a client from another channel

1\. Open the chat window with a contact. If you don’t see all the dialogs with that contact to the left of the chat, click the “sandwich” in the upper-left corner of the window.

2\. A list of dialogs with the client appears. Click on the down arrow in the chat line and select “Create dialogue”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-akkordeon-6.png)

3\. A window for creating a dialog will open. Select the channel you want to write to the client from.

Click “Add” and a new dialog window opens.

#### Why Wazzup News chat is needed

The Wazzup News chat is displayed in the window with all chats. It cannot be deleted.

Important notifications are sent there. For example if we planned technical works. There’s also news about updates that will make your life better.

You can’t reply to us in this chat. If you want to know more about updates, contact support.

In the Wazzup chat interface, an employee only sees a news chat if he or she has been assigned a role. If a new employee has been given access to a Wazzup account, he won’t see the news chat until we write something new in it.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to work with WhatsApp calls

You can’t take calls through Wazzup, so any call will be missed.

A message about a missed call from a client will appear in the Wazzup chat and in the CRM chat, but only if a dialogue has already been created. If there is no dialogue, the missed call will not be displayed.

The CRM chat will receive a message about the call as “=== SYSTEM WZ === Missed call”.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

If you reset the incoming call from the phone, the missed call message will not come

There is an auto-reply on missed calls in Wazzup: “Hello. We were unable to take your call. But we will certainly respond if you write”.

You can change the text of the message that goes to customers in your personal account, or turn off the auto-reply on a missed call altogether.

👉 [How to work with autoresponders](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/auto-responses/)

Turning off autoresponse is still not recommended. If you can’t call or write back quickly, the customer will think you’re ignoring them and will go to your competitors.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Requirements for attachments

The limit for all attachments when sending from CRM chat is 10 MB. The limit via API using [the send message method](https://wazzup24.com/help/api-en/sending-messages/) is 51 MB.

The following restrictions apply when sending an attachment from the Wazzup widget and mobile app:

Content

Show

- [WhatsApp](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/requirements-for-attachments/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)
- [WABA](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/requirements-for-attachments/#wz24-toc-anchor-1)

  - [WABA templates](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/requirements-for-attachments/#wz24-toc-anchor-2-0)
  - [Regular messages](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/requirements-for-attachments/#wz24-toc-anchor-2-1)

- [Instagram](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/requirements-for-attachments/#wz24-toc-anchor-2)
- [Telegram](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/requirements-for-attachments/#wz24-toc-anchor-3)

#### WhatsApp

- Documents .pdf, .do\*, .xl, .ppt — 45 MB;
- Images .jpeg, .jpg, .png — 45 MB;
- Video .mp4 — 45 MB;
- Audio .aac, .mp4, .amr, .mpeg — 45 MB;
- Voice messages .ogg; codecs=opus — 45 MB.

#### WABA

##### WABA templates

- Documents .pdf — 50 MB;
- Images .jpeg, .jpg, .png — 5 MB;
- Video .mp4, .3gpp — 16 MB. Only the H.264 video codec and AAC audio codec are supported. Only videos with a single audio stream are supported.

##### Regular messages

- Documents .pdf, .zip, .docx, .xl, .ppt — 50 MB;
- Images .jpeg, .jpg, .png — 5 MB;
- Audio .aac, .mp3, .amr, .m4a, .ogg — 16 MB;
- Video .mp4, .3gpp — 16 MB. Only the H.264 video codec and AAC audio codec are supported. Only videos with a single audio stream are supported.

#### Instagram

Images: jpg, png, bmp — 8 MB.

Voice messages: ogg.

You can only reply to a comment with a text message. Messages with attached documents, photos, video and audio files will not be sent.

#### Telegram

- Documents .pdf, .zip, .gif — 20 MB;
- Images .jpeg, .jpg, .png — 5 MB;
- Audio .mp3, .m4a — 20 MB;
- Voice messages: after recording, they are converted and displayed in the chat as an mp3 file
- Video .mp4 — 20 MB.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

[How to use Wazzup chats](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/)

# Search for messages

The search system in Wazzup is fast and accurate. You can find any client or message — either globally across all chats or within a specific conversation.

Content

Show

- [Who sees what](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/search-for-messages/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)
- [Global search](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/search-for-messages/#wz24-toc-anchor-1)
- [Search within a chat](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/search-for-messages/#wz24-toc-anchor-2)
- [Search in the mobile app](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/search-for-messages/#wz24-toc-anchor-3)

#### Who sees what

Here’s how search works for different roles:

- A **manager** can search only in chats they have access to. For example, if the account has 30 chats and the manager can access 10, the search will work only in those 10.
- A **supervisor** sees all chats and can search across them — to monitor the team’s performance.
- A **quality assurance** specialist can search in the chats they have access to.
- If an employee **has no access** to any chats, search won’t work — there’s simply nothing to search through.

#### Global search

Looking for a client or message? Start typing in the search bar above the chat list — just three characters are enough.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

Search only covers messages from the past 6 months.

Results appear in two blocks:

- **Contacts** — search by name or phone number.
- **Messages** — shows all messages containing your query.

Click a contact to open the chat.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/ANGL-PPS-2.png)

Click a message to jump straight to that part of the conversation.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/ANGL-Kontakt-ne-najden.png)

To clear the search query, click the “X” in the search bar.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

To exit chat search — simply send a message, switch to another chat, or click the “X”. The first click clears the field, the second closes search. You can also click outside the search bar or start a global search — it will close the current one.

#### Search within a chat

When you need to find a specific message in a conversation:

1\. Click the magnifying glass icon at the top of the open chat.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/ANGL-Kontakt-ne-najden-1.png)

2\. Type a word or part of a phrase.

Use the arrow buttons in the search field to move through results.

3\. Click “Show as list” to view all matches in the side panel.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/ANGL-Kontakt-ne-najden-1-1.png)

4\. Click a message — it will be highlighted so you can spot it easily.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/ANGL-PPS-1-1.png)

To reset the search, click the “X” next to the search field.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

You can exit search by switching chats, sending a message, or clicking the “X”. If the field is empty, clicking outside the search bar will also close it.

#### Search in the mobile app

Everything works the same in the mobile app. Global search covers all messages and contacts.

To search within a chat, tap the magnifying glass icon in the conversation.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Security

Wazzup is located in two independent data centres. These data centres are comply with international information security standards DIN ISO/IEC 27001 and undergo audit annually.

The service’s architecture duplicates all services to enable the failsafe operation of each individual cluster. All performance indicators are monitored around the clock by our engineers, and all critically important parameters are being tracked in real time.

Content

Show

- [Data backup](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/security-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)
- [Personal data protection](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/security-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-1)
- [SSL encryption](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/security-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-2)
- [Data removal](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/security-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-3)

#### Data backup

We backup all Wazzup data daily. Thanks to the encrypted archives located on our servers, we will be able to restore your Wazzup operation environment for any moment within the last 3 months.

#### Personal data protection

Wazzup complies with the requirements of the EU’s General Data Protection Regulation as well as the Russian law in accordance with the Federal Law of July 27, 2006 No 152-FZ “On Personal Data”.

#### SSL encryption

All Wazzup accounts access the data using the TLS 1.2 cryptographic protocol. The encryption certificate is issued by COMODO RSA Domain Validation Secure Server CA. The connection is encrypted and verified using AES\_128\_GCM. Key exchange is performed using ECDHE\_RSA. This eliminates the possibility of data interception between the client and the server throughout the working process since all data is transmitted in encrypted form.

#### Data removal

If you stop using our service, we will remove your account together with all its data. To do this, please, contact [Wazzup support](https://wazzup24.com/contact-en/).

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

## What are WABA universal templates and why are they needed - Wazzup Knowledge base

> **Source:** https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/what-are-waba-universal-templates-and-why-are-they-needed

> **Description:** We’ve created universal WhatsApp Business API (WABA) templates so you can start a conversation with a customer using any text you want. No need to

# What are WABA universal templates and why are they needed

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

Updated to reflect changes effective from July 1, 2025

We’ve created universal WhatsApp Business API (WABA) templates so you can start a conversation with a customer using any text you want. No need to pre-approve a template for every possible case with Meta.

Content

Show

- [What are universal templates](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/what-are-waba-universal-templates-and-why-are-they-needed/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)
- [How to start WABA correspondence with text in a universal template](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/what-are-waba-universal-templates-and-why-are-they-needed/#wz24-toc-anchor-1)
- [How much does it cost to send a universal template](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/what-are-waba-universal-templates-and-why-are-they-needed/#wz24-toc-anchor-2)
- [What you can send in a universal template](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/what-are-waba-universal-templates-and-why-are-they-needed/#wz24-toc-anchor-3)
- [Why you shouldn’t remove universal templates from Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/what-are-waba-universal-templates-and-why-are-they-needed/#wz24-toc-anchor-4)

#### What are universal templates

Universal templates are WABA templates that we’ve already pre-approved with Meta. You’ll find them in “Message templates” → “WABA templates” under the name _universalny\_shablon_. These templates are empty — there’s no fixed text inside.

You can start a conversation with a client using universal templates, but you are now charged for each template sent, not for starting a session. Universal templates are most often approved in the Marketing category, so the cost to send will be the same as a marketing message.

👉 [How correspondence on WABA channels work](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/how-to-work-with-waba-templates-in-chats)

#### How to start WABA correspondence with text in a universal template

Spoiler: you don’t need to search for a template in the WABA list in chat. It’s easier:

1\. Open a dialog with the client you want to start a 24-hour correspondence with.

2\. Enter the text of the message and send it – done. The text will automatically go in the universal template.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-hitrenkij-shablon.png)

If you can’t enter the message text, the templates are probably still being approved by Facebook. To find out if a template is approved, go to “Message templates” → “WABA templates” and see the status.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If your universal templates are rejected, write to support

#### How much does it cost to send a universal template

When you send text in a universal template, it looks like you are sending a regular message. A universal template is a WABA template, so Meta charges per template sent, not per conversation.

Most often, Facebook approves universal templates with the Marketing category – we cannot influence this. Therefore, starting a conversation with any text in them will cost the same as the Marketing template.

👉 [How much do WhatsApp Business API conversations cost](https://wazzup24.com/help/payment-en/waba-billing/)

#### What you can send in a universal template

You can only send text without paragraphs or indents. There are no attachments or buttons in the template.

Therefore, we do not recommend writing too much at once: it will be difficult for the client to read one large paragraph without structure. It’s better to send a short message, wait for a response, and then write everything down in detail.

Also, write to your contacts only what is interesting to them. Otherwise, messages will be thrown into spam or your number will be blocked, and this will affect the quality of your WhatsApp account; I can ban the templates.

#### Why you shouldn’t remove universal templates from Wazzup

Without universal templates, you won’t be able to start a correspondence with any text. You will have to send only what is agreed with Facebook, and it does not approve everything.

Even if you don’t plan to use universal templates, we suggest leaving them. So that they do not interfere with your personal account and sellers in the chat, move them down in the list of WABA templates using the![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/image-2.png)button. This way, if you ever don’t have a suitable template, a universal one will help you, and you won’t have to waste time creating a new one.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-color-bgselected-area-34-1.png)

If you accidentally delete our templates, [please contact support](https://wazzup24.com/contact-en/). The guys will create new.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# What is Read Rate in WABA and how to maintain a high score

Since April 2024, Meta has introduced a new metric—the **Read Rate**—to assess the quality of marketing templates in **WhatsApp Business API (WABA)**. If the read percentage is low, Meta may pause or even block the template to protect users from spam.

👉 [How much does WhatsApp Business API cost](https://wazzup24.com/help/payment-en/waba-billing/?_gl=1*lbwma1*_gcl_au*MTEwMDU5NzM3NC4xNzQxNTgxNzEw*_ga*NDExMzQ1MTc5LjE3NDE1ODE3MTA.*_ga_7X6RZSKPXF*MTc0MTc3NTMyMS4xMy4wLjE3NDE3NzUzMjEuNjAuMC4xNjI5Njc1ODE1)

In this article, we will cover how to track Read Rate, what to do if your metrics drop, and how to avoid template blocks.

#### What is read rate and why is it important

Read Rate is the percentage of messages that have been opened and read by customers. In WhatsApp, these messages are marked with two blue checkmarks. Read Rate applies only to marketing templates—Meta tracks it only for templates that initiate a new marketing conversation.

👉 [What are universal WABA templates and why are they important](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/what-are-waba-universal-templates-and-why-are-they-needed/?_gl=1*1w21uve*_gcl_au*MTEwMDU5NzM3NC4xNzQxNTgxNzEw*_ga*NDExMzQ1MTc5LjE3NDE1ODE3MTA.*_ga_7X6RZSKPXF*MTc0MTc3NTMyMS4xMy4xLjE3NDE3NzUzNzIuOS4wLjE2Mjk2NzU4MTU.)

Meta introduced this metric to evaluate the effectiveness of marketing templates. If a template performs poorly—meaning it has a low Read Rate or users report it as spam—Meta may suspend its sending.

Templates from the Utility and Authentication categories are not subject to this rule. Additionally, if a user has disabled read receipts in WhatsApp settings, their messages will not be included in the Read Rate statistics.

#### Where to check your read rate

You can track the Read Rate directly in [WhatsApp Manager](https://business.facebook.com/wa/manage/message-templates/). Follow these steps:

1\. Go to [WhatsApp Manager](https://business.facebook.com/wa/manage/message-templates/) and select the WABA account linked to your number in the top right corner.

2\. Open the “Message Templates” tab → “Manage Templates”.

3\. In the table, find the column “Messages Read Rate”—this displays the percentage of read messages for each template.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/shablony-angl-1.png)

4\. Click on a template to access detailed statistics.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/shablony-angl-2.png)

The Statistics tab provides graphs and a detailed breakdown of sent, delivered, and read messages.

If your Read Rate drops, analyze your recipient list, template text, and sending frequency to prevent blocks.

👉 [How to work with WABA templates in chats](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-use-en/how-to-work-with-waba-templates-in-chats/?_gl=1*1rlmnpv*_gcl_au*MTEwMDU5NzM3NC4xNzQxNTgxNzEw*_ga*NDExMzQ1MTc5LjE3NDE1ODE3MTA.*_ga_7X6RZSKPXF*MTc0MTc3NTMyMS4xMy4xLjE3NDE3NzU0MDcuNjAuMC4xNjI5Njc1ODE1)

### What happens when a template is blocked?

If a template is blocked, it will receive the status "Rejected".

When attempting to send such a template, you’ll see the error: "Receiver is incapable of receiving this message."

You won’t be able to send the template anymore.

### What to do if your template gets blocked?

Create a new template with different text. You can follow the recommendations listed below.

Change your approach to messaging — reduce the frequency, add buttons, and segment your audience.

Check your statistics in WhatsApp Manager regularly to catch drops in Read Rate early.

#### How Meta evaluates read rate

Meta does not disclose the exact blocking algorithm, but based on experience, here are the key factors:

- If the Read Rate drops below 60–70%, the template enters the risk zone.
- If multiple templates have a low Read Rate, Meta may freeze them or completely block the WABA account.
- User complaints are also considered—if users mark messages as spam or block the sender, this speeds up the blocking process.

### How to maintain a high Read Rate?

To ensure your templates work effectively and avoid being blocked, follow these recommendations:

- Send messages only to those who have opted in for the newsletter. Spam messages to random contacts quickly lead to blocks.
- Keep templates short and clear. Long texts from unfamiliar numbers are rarely read. It's better to keep the messages short and useful.
- Don’t forget to add buttons. Buttons like "Reply," "Call," and "Unsubscribe" help clients interact with the message, and help you avoid complaints.
- Clients usually read the first 60 characters that appear in the preview in WhatsApp. Plan the beginning of your message carefully to make it interesting and encourage the client to open and read the entire message.
- Avoid mass messaging during holidays. During this period, clients receive many messages and often ignore them.
- Monitor quality metrics in WhatsApp Manager. If they drop, rethink your strategy—check the target audience, message text, and sending frequency.

# Working with Planfix’s channels

When integrating with Wazzup, you can work with several channels at the same time.

#### How to add multiple WhatsApp channels to Planfix

To add a channel, go to your account settings:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/1-28.png)

A settings menu will appear on the left side. Choose “Integrations” → “Messengers” → “WhatsApp”:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2-31.png)

A menu to choose your integration will open. Click the cog symbol under Wazzup logo to go to the settings:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/3-28.png)

Add the channels in the “Connected channels” row. You can input the numbers in any familiar format: with +7, 7, or 8. They should all be linked to WhatsApp. To delete a channel, click the cross icon.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/4-26.png)

After adding your channels, click “Save”.

##### Working with WhatsApp channels in Planfix

To write to a contact you have not previously had communication with, you can use any channel you prefer. To do this, open the “Contacts” tab. Choose the user and channel you want to create a task from.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/5-25.png)

When writing a message, fill in the mandatory fields: the name and the task description. Additional fields to be filled if needed are the time limits, the ones responsible, the attachments etc. The task description text will be sent as a message to the recipient in WhatsApp. If the contact replies, this message will be reflected in a comment to the task.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/6-24.png)

You can choose the channel to use only if you are writing to the client for the first time. You cannot change it during communication. If the dialogue has already been started, Planfix will not show the list to choose the outgoing phone number from. You will only be presented one channel: the one you have written from initially.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/7-22.png)

If you need to change the channel of communication, go to the task, delete it and create it again.

##### Creating tasks in different channels

When you write to a client first from one channel but this client later reaches out using another one, such a client will have 2 tasks created for them. Both will be reflected in their contact card:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/8-17.png)

The communication for each of the tasks is maintained through the channel it has been started on.

#### Working with the Instagram channel in Planfix

When working with Instagram in Planfix, you can:

— reply to an incoming message in Direct,

— reply to a user’s comment,

— reply to a user’s comment with a message in Direct.

Incoming messages and new comments on Instagram posts will be displayed as tasks.

##### Reply to a message in Direct

A task is created for an incoming message in Direct in Planfix. The name of the task displays the nickname of the user who wrote it, and the body of the task displays the first message. All subsequent messages will go to the task comments.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/1-angl.png)The first and second incoming message to Direct in Planfix (left) and Instagram (right)

To reply, click “Accept” and add a comment. You can attach media and documents to the message. Audio, video and documents will be sent to the recipient in Direct in the form of links that can be viewed or saved when clicked, and the image will be displayed in Instagram immediately with a preview.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2-angl-1024x417.png)Reply with attached image in Planfix (left) and Instagram (right)

To quote a post, click on the arrow in the lower left corner of that post and add a comment.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/3-angl.png)Reply with quoting and sending the document to Planfix (left) and Instagram (right)

##### Reply to comment

When a user has left a comment under a post, a new task is created in Planfix. The task body will contain a link to the post under which the comment was left. The user’s comment itself will be in the task comments.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/4-angl.png)

To reply to a comment, click Accept, enter your message, and click Send. On Instagram, your response will appear as a second level comment.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/5-angl-1024x251.png)Reply to a comment in Planfix (left) and Instagram (right)

The message will fall into the same task if the user wrote another comment to the post or replied to the comment of another user under this post. At the same time, your replies to him will always fall into the thread with his first comment.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/6-angl-1024x419.png)The user left a second comment, and the response from Planfix came to the thread with the first comment. Planfix (left) and Instagram (right)

The comment can be answered with a quote. To do this, in Planfix, click on the arrow ![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/image6-35.png)in the lower left corner of the user’s message and add a comment.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/7-angl-1024x220.png)Reply to a comment with a comment with a quote. In Planfix (left) and Instagram (right)

##### Reply to a comment by post in Direct

In Planfix, you can reply to the incoming comment with a message in Direct. Click on the user’s nickname above the received message. In the opened contact card, select “Message” → “Instagram (Direct)”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/8-angl-1024x485.png)

A window for creating a new task will open. Enter your answer in the Description field and click Create.

Your first message to the user will be both in the body of the task and in the comments in the new task.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/9-angl-1024x291.png)Reply to a comment in Direct in Planfix (left) and Instagram (right)

The user’s response and subsequent correspondence will be displayed in Planfix in the comments of this problem.

It may be that after the user’s response, you will not be able to write a response comment and an error window will appear. This happens due to the individual settings of Planfix. Click “Go back and choose who to notify”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/10-angl.png)

To send a comment, tap the circle with three dots above the message field and select a recipient. Click «Send».

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/11-angl-1024x264.png)

#### What happens if you delete a channel

All the tasks from the deleted channel are retained in the system. If you later create a new channel for the same number, all the incoming messages will come in to the already existing chats. Outgoing messages will also be sent from the old task. If a channel has been deleted and then you create another one with another number, then the client will not be able to send messages to the already existing tasks. It is also be impossible to send messages from a deleted channel.

##### Tasks

The “Tasks” tab shows all the dialogues you have. If a contact has written you first, the system will name it automatically. This name includes:

- the name of the contact itself;
- the message [transport](https://wazzup24.com/help/what-is-a-channel-en/);
- the service for integration;
- the number of the channel the message came in to.

If you are the first to write to a client, you specify this full name automatically.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/9-21.png)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Write first to the Open Channel

To send the first WhatsApp message to a customer through the Open Channel, you only need the customer’s phone number.

Make sure that you have [configured the Open channel](https://wazzup24.com/help/configure-open-channel-en/) in your [Wazzup personal account](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations).

1\. Go to a lead, deal or contact.

2\. Select “SMS/WhatsApp” from the menu on the right.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/1en.png)

3\. Click “More” in the same window.

4\. Select “\[WAZZUP\] Wazzup SMS” under “using”. If you do not have this option, click “Update data from Bitrix24” in the upper right corner [in the integration settings](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations) in your Wazzup personal account.

5\. Write a message and send it. You can attach a file to the message and it will be sent to the client as a link.

6\. Go to the Open Channel chat by clicking the ![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/image1-53.png) button in the lower right corner of the notification.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2en.png)

7\. Done — you have created a chat in the Open Channel and sent a message.

#### Write first through Open channels using automation

Starting a dialogue in Open channels can be automated. When you create a new lead, a deal or when a deal moves to a certain stage, automation will create a chat with the client in Open channels and send a message to this chat.

Let’s add an automation:

1\. Go to the “CRM” section on the left panel of Bitrix24.

2\. Go to the “Automation rules” tab.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/3en-1024x222.png)

3\. Click under “Automation rules”: “Add” → “Client communications” → “Send SMS”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/4en.png)

Although it is called “Send SMS”, but the message will go to WhatsApp. This is how it is done in Bitrix ¯\\\_(ツ)\_/¯

4\. Enter the text of the message.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/5en.png)

5\. Select from the drop-down menu the type of customer number to which the message will be sent. You can change it in the contact or transaction card.

6\. Select from the drop-down menu “Provider” → “\[Wazzup\] Wazzup SMS”.

7\. Click “Save”.

8\. Click “Save” again.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/6en-1024x397.png)

Done — you have added an automation that when you create a new deal or lead, adds a chat with the client in the Open channel and sends a message.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to work in Wazzup partner account

In the instruction we tell you how to work in your partner Wazzup account. If you don’t know about our affiliate program yet, take a look [at the page about the program](https://wazzup24.com/official-partnership-en/?utm_source=help&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=en&utm_content=how-to-work-in-partner-account). There we tell you about earnings and all the benefits of affiliates.

Content

Show

- [What to start with](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-work-in-wazzup-partner-account/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)
- [How to register a new client](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-work-in-wazzup-partner-account/#wz24-toc-anchor-1)
- [How to create a referral link so that the client registers themselves](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-work-in-wazzup-partner-account/#wz24-toc-anchor-2)
- [How to set everything up for the client](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-work-in-wazzup-partner-account/#wz24-toc-anchor-3)
- [How to replenish the account](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-work-in-wazzup-partner-account/#wz24-toc-anchor-4)
- [How to create a subscription for a client](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-work-in-wazzup-partner-account/#wz24-toc-anchor-5)

#### What to start with

The first thing we advise you to do in your personal account is to read the affiliate rules. They are, all of a sudden, in the “Rules” tab.

There you will learn how your reward will grow, where to get help, how you can influence the development of the product and our expectations from partners.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-pravila.png)

#### How to register a new client

You can register a client manually from your Partner Account. Here’s how:

1\. Go to the Clients tab and click Add client.

2\. Enter the client’s email address – this is where their login password will be sent.

Then, enter a name for the client. This name is visible only to you and helps you quickly find them in your account.

Click Add.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-dobavlenie-klienta.png)

Once added, the client will receive €10 or $10 to their bonus account, depending on their currency.

If your client is already registered in Wazzup, you won’t be able to add him through your account. Just [contact support](https://wazzup24.com/contact-en/) and they will add him to your account.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If you don’t plan to set up the service for your client — send him the referral link so he can register himself. We’ll help the new user to understand how Wazzup works, and you’ll get 20% of every client payment for a year.

#### How to create a referral link so that the client registers themselves

You can create links in the “Links and registrations” tab.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-referalnye.png)

You can create an unlimited number of links to place them on different sources. Your referral will receive 10 euros or 10 dollars to his bonus account for registering with the link. Currency is determined during registration.

You will receive 20% of each client’s payment during the year. Information about payments will be in the tab “Referral fees”.

Remuneration is credited automatically on the first day of each month to your affiliate account.

We do not pay for shows and leads. Only those clients who have paid for the service are counted.

#### How to set everything up for the client

You can manage your client settings directly from your account. Click this icon next to the client’s account.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bgselected-area-5.png)

A new tab will open the client’s personal account – you have access to all settings, payments and data.

#### How to replenish the account

The partner account is used to pay for the clients subscriptions and WABA balance, and there is also a percentage drop from the self-pay of clients.

To add money to your account:

1\. In the “Partner account” tab click the “Refill” button.

2\. Enter the amount you want to add to your account. If you are depositing money, which you received from the client, you can keep the reward amount, and put the remainder on the account.

3\. Choose method of payment: by bank card or by bank transfer → click “Refill”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl-popolnenie-scheta.png)

#### How to create a subscription for a client

1\. Go to the client’s account. To do this, click this icon next to the client account.![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bgselected-area-5.png)

2\. Go to the “Subscriptions” section.

3\. Click “Add Subscription”.

4\. Select the subscription options and click “Continue”.

5\. Pay for the subscription from your affiliate account.

Done — you have created a subscription for a customer.

#### How to get money from an account

In the Referral payments tab, at the top right corner — your earnings. We calculate it using a simple formula: payment × your commission rate. Everything is fair, transparent, and always within reach.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Partnerka-ANGL-5-1.png)

We send rewards by invoice without a fee if you are an IE or LLC. Bill us and we will pay within three days.

To get help with filling out an invoice, message us on [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=%2B79852622249&text&type=phone_number&app_absent=0) or [Telegram](https://t.me/PartnerWazzupBot).

**Lifehack:** instead of withdrawing rewards from the referral program, you may use it to pay for discounted subscriptions. When you receive the money to renew the service, you can keep part of the amount, taking into account how much you have already paid for subscriptions.

#### How to sort clients in the table

In the client table, you can quickly find the right record — sort, filter by status, or use search. Easy as that.

You can sort clients by the following columns:

- Registration date
- Subscription end date
- Autopayment
- Paid by client

Next to each column name, you’ll see an arrow. Click on it to sort values in ascending or descending order.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Partnerka-ANGL-1.png)

The table has a Status column that shows current issues with the client’s subscription or channels. You can filter clients by these statuses to find what you need faster.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Partnerka-ANGL-2.png)

By default, inactive clients are hidden in the table.

To view them, enable the “Show inactive clients” toggle in the top right corner of the table.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Partnerka-ANGL-3.png)

Use the search bar to find a client by ID or name. Search works across the whole table.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Partnerka-ANGL-4.png)

#### How to use free channels

After you join an affiliate program, the “Clients” tab will have a “Demo” account. Five free subscriptions on the Max plan will appear there: for WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram , Viber and Avito channel.

Use them to show customers all the benefits of Wazzup.

Three of the same free subscriptions will appear in your main account. You can use them for personal commercial purposes.

If you want more channels in any of your accounts — they will cost 35% or 50% less than the regular price. A 35% discount on all partners. A 50% discount for partners who have sold subscriptions to 10 or more customers.

#### How can you find out how many more clients to connect to get 50%

In the “Clients” tab we show how many of your clients have paid for the service at least once, either on their own or through you. If there are 10 such clients, we increase up to 50% rewards from payments made in your account.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-color-bgselected-area-1-3.png)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to set up integration with Pipedrive

After connecting the integration, the settings are displayed [in the “Integration with CRM” tab](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations). There we configure the roles of employees.

#### How to choose a role for an employee

The role determines which chats an employee will see in Wazzup chats. To assign roles, click “Select roles” → a modal window will open with a list of all employees from CRM.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

Role settings apply only to Wazzup chats. In Pipedrive chats, every employee sees all chats, regardless of role

If not all employees or funnels are displayed in the list, click “Update data from CRM” — everything will be pulled up.

For each employee, select one of the roles:

- “Sales rep” — can write only to those clients for whom he appointed responsible in CRM. He does not see the correspondence of others.
- “Manager” — sees all correspondence and can write to any client.
- “Quality Control” — sees all correspondence, but cannot write anything to clients.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

If only the seller responsible for the client works with the client:

As soon as the employee answers, he needs to indicate in the contact card that he is responsible for him. This is necessary so that the chat is displayed only at the seller who took the client in Wazzup chats. For other employees with the “Sales rep” role, the chat will disappear

That’s it, you’ve configured which chats will be seen by salespeople and how customers will be distributed between them.

A window will pop up asking you to test the chats. We will automatically send you a test message to the first WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business API (WABA) or Telegram channel you add. You’ll be able to go straight to the chats and test the integration or do it later.

If you have salespeople with access to multiple channels or employees with the “Manager” role [make a couple more settings](https://wazzup24.com/help/pipedrive-en/configure-additional-settings-for-integration-with-pipedrive/).

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Set up integration with HubSpot

Settings are displayed in the [Integration with CRM](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations/) tab after the integration is connected. If you have multiple channels connected, you need to configure integration for each channel separately.

![](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bg-57.png)

Content

Show

- [1\. Select employee roles](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/hubspot-integration-settings-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)
- [2\. A new client has written (a client who is not in the CRM). Where do I create a deal?](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/hubspot-integration-settings-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-1)
- [Additional settings](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/hubspot-integration-settings-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-2)

  - [1\. Save messages to the event feed of the lead, contact and deal](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/hubspot-integration-settings-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-3-0)
  - [2\. Notify managers on all messages](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/hubspot-integration-settings-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-3-1)
  - [API key](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/hubspot-integration-settings-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-3-2)

#### 1\. Select employee roles

The role determines the employee’s rights — which chats they see and whether they can correspond with customers. There are three roles:

- Quality Control — checks sales reps’ work. They see all sales reps’ correspondence, but can’t write anything.
- Sales rep — communicates with clients and conducts deals. They can only write to the clients he is responsible for in the CRM. They cannot see the correspondence of other sales reps.
- Manager — manages and supervises large deals. They see the correspondence of all sales reps and can write to any client.

The “Select roles” button opens a window with the selection of employee roles.

The “Receives new clients” slider allows the employee to participate in the distribution of new clients.

If a deal or lead is created, the manager participates in the distribution of the client in turn and gets the right to become responsible for the client in the CRM.

Click “Save”.

That’s it, you’ve configured which chats will be seen by salespeople and how customers will be distributed between them.

A window will pop up asking you to test the chats. We will automatically send you a test message to the first WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business API (WABA) or Telegram channel you add. You’ll be able to go straight to the chats and test the integration or do it later.

If you have salespeople with access to multiple channels or employees with the “Manager” role make additional settings.

#### 2\. A new client has written (a client who is not in the CRM). Where do I create a deal?

Choose in which funnel at which stage to create the deal. The contact will be created automatically.

#### Additional settings

Additional settings apply to all channels at once. ![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Frame-60-1024x710.png)

##### 1\. Save messages to the event feed of the lead, contact and deal

Enable the setting to save messages in the event feed of a lead, contact or deal.

In Hubspot, in a lead, contact or deal card, open the event feed filters window and check the Wazzup checkbox.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/3-en-4-1024x346.png)

New messages will now be displayed in the event feed. To read the text of a message, click on the triangle in the upper left corner. Media files and documents in messages are displayed as links in the event feed.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/4-en-3.png)

##### 2\. Notify managers on all messages

If the setting is enabled, employees with the “manager” role will have the sum of unanswered manager and unanswered other employees on the button with the window with all chats. Managers will receive push notifications in the mobile app for all clients, including those for which they are not assigned responsible in CRM.

If the setting is disabled, employees with the “manager” role will have unanswered only from those customers for whom the manager is assigned as responsible in CRM on the button with the window with all chats. Managers will receive push notifications in the mobile app only for those clients for which they are responsible in CRM.

##### API key

If you lack the functionality of the ready integration, you can refine it [with the API](https://wazzup24.com/help/all-about-wazzup-en/integration-by-api-en/#Integration_with_CRMAPI).

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Connect Wazzup to HubSpot

Before creating an integration, [connect a messenger](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/).

1. [Go to “Integration with CRM”](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations) in your personal Wazzup account.

2\. Select “HubSpot” in the window that appears.

3\. Insert your HubSpot domain and click “Continue” and then “Connect”.

4\. Select the HubSpot account for which the Wazzup integration will be installed.

5\. Click “Connect app.”

Done — you have connected your HubSpot integration.

Now a contact and deal will be created when new messages come in. In the contact and deal cards, you can open a Wazzup widget with an individual chat. If you opened this chat from a contact card, the correspondence with that contact will be displayed there. If you opened this chat from a deal card, the correspondence with the contacts involved in the deal will be displayed there.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/1-53.png)

To access the general chat, where all your dialogs are displayed, add a general chat button.

#### Add a general chat button

Users of Chromium-based browsers: Chrome, Opera, Vivaldi, Microsoft Edge, Yandex Browser, Brave, Colibri can add Wazzup general chat button.

[1\. Install the extension](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/wazzup-for-hubspot/fjnlkmelocdiljhcfphmfnkpfolcpbjm/related?hl=en) from the Chrome Web Store.

2\. Click on the “Wazzup for HubSpot” extension icon on the top bar of your browser.

3\. Click “Connect with HubSpot”. ![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2-55.png)

4\. Select the HubSpot account to link to the extension. This should be the same account you selected when you set up the Wazzup integration.

5\. Click “Connect app”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/3-48.png)

Done — you’ve added a general chat button to the top bar of HubSpot. Now [set up the integration](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/hubspot-integration-settings-en/).

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Wazzup chats in HubSpot

Wazzup Chats is a conversation window from which you can correspond with clients on WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and VK.

You can use Wazzup chats:

— in CRM by opening a chat window;

— from your phone by installing [the mobile app](https://wazzup24.com/help/all-about-wazzup-en/mobile-app-en/);

— from your personal Wazzup account.

Regardless of where you open Wazzup chats, they look equally stylish and have the same functionality.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/1-en-10-1024x456.png)

Wazzup chat has the classic messenger look, with a list of chats on the left and a correspondence box on the right. In the mobile app, there is a list of chats on the home screen, and when you click on it, a dialog box opens.

Content

Show

- [General chat](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/wazzup-chats-in-hubspot-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)
- [Individual chat](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/wazzup-chats-in-hubspot-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-1)
- [Sorting chats](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/wazzup-chats-in-hubspot-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-2)
- [Group chats](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/wazzup-chats-in-hubspot-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-3)
- [Message status](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/wazzup-chats-in-hubspot-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-4)
- [Citations](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/wazzup-chats-in-hubspot-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-5)
- [Fast switching between deals](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/wazzup-chats-in-hubspot-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-6)
- [Emoji](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/wazzup-chats-in-hubspot-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-7)
- [Attachments](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/wazzup-chats-in-hubspot-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-8)
- [Message templates](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/wazzup-chats-in-hubspot-en/#wz24-toc-anchor-9)

#### **General chat**

There are two types of Wazzup chats: general and individual. The general chat shows all dialogs available to the employee, and the individual chat shows dialogs with those contacts who are in the deal.

What dialogs will be displayed in the general chat of the employee, you determine in [the integration settings](http://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations). You can use the general chat in the CRM, personal account, and mobile app.

To enter the general chat, click the message icon in the top bar:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2-67.png)

#### **Individual chat**

You can open the Wazzup widget with an individual chat from the contact and deal cards. If you opened this chat from a contact card, the correspondence with that contact will be displayed there. If you opened this chat from a deal card, the correspondence with the contacts involved in the deal will be displayed there.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/3-en-5.png)

#### **Sorting chats**

The chats in the left panel are not lined up by the time of messages. At the top of the list are chats with clients who have not received a reply. Such sorting helps not to miss the correspondence in the general flow.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/8-en-1024x488.png)

In the mechanics of Wazzup there are no “unread” messages, only “unanswered”. To make the message notification disappear you need to reply to the client or press the “no reply required” button — a red envelope to the right of the text input line. No dialogue with a client who has not been answered can disappear from the list of chats due to inattention.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/9-en-1-1024x299.png)

When there are no unanswered messages in the dialogue, the envelope will turn gray and a green arrow will appear next to it.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/10-en.png)

#### **Group chats**

Group chats appear in the general Wazzup chat. They can be seen by anyone who has access to the chat window. By default, group chats are disabled. You can turn them on in the “Integration” section of your personal account settings.

Group chats do not create a separate lead, contact or deal and are not attached to them. Messages from group chats will not be displayed in the cards.

#### **Message status**

Wazzup chats show message status similar to WhatsApp. One gray checkmark — sent; two gray checkmarks — delivered; two green checkmarks — read.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/11-en-1024x617.png)

“Clock” means that the message is being processed. If this status hangs for more than two minutes, please [contact support](https://wazzup24.com/contact/). Exclamation mark in a circle — the message has not been sent. Hover your mouse cursor over the exclamation mark icon — a tooltip describing the error will appear.

#### **Citations**

In Wazzup chats, you can send a reply by quoting the person you’re chatting with. To do this, click on the arrow to the right of the incoming message.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/12-en-1024x266.png)

#### **Fast switching between deals**

The Wazzup chat in CRM has the ability to quickly navigate through client’s deals, including completed ones.

Click the “suitcase” icon to the right of the text entry bar.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/13-en-1024x335.png)

To open the page in a new tab, press Ctrl before clicking. You can also use this button to add a new deal.

#### **Emoji**

Wazzup chat supports native WhatsApp emoji. Click on the icon in the bottom left corner to open a tab with all the emoticons.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/14-en.png)

#### **Attachments**

In the bottom left corner of the panel there is a button with the image of a paper clip. It is used for sending files. Besides files and pictures from the client it is possible to receive geomarks in the form of a link to googlemaps, voice messages and contact cards in the form of text.

#### **Message templates**

You can [create message templates](https://wazzup24.com/help/all-about-wazzup-en/templates-in-wazzup-en/) in your personal Wazzup account. They help reduce the response time, save managers from writing one-type messages manually, exclude possible mistakes or typos of specialists. You can attach media to the template.

Use ready-made messages to explain the route map, send pricelists, instructions.

To send a template, click the document icon at the bottom left of the client dialogue panel and select the desired template from the list.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/16-en-1024x299.png)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Write first on WhatsApp in HubSpot

1\. Go to a deal or contact card.

2\. In the “Wazzup” menu on the right, click “Start chat”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/image10-16.png)

### Features of correspondence with Mexican and Brazilian numbers on WhatsApp

Mexico and Brazil have 2 phone number formats:

**Brazil**:

+55-xx-xxx-xxxxx-xxxxx — old format of 12 digits
+55-xx-xxx-9xxxxx-xxxxx — the new format of 13 digits

**Mexico**:

+521-xxxx-xxxxxx-xxxxxx — old format of 13 digits
+52-xx-xxxxxx-xxxx — new format of 12 digits

In WhatsApp, chat is only possible with a long number, that is, the new format for Brazil and the old format for Mexico. Wazzup also works only with long numbers in both cases.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

To reach customers in Brazil and Mexico, write to them on long numbers, i.e. 13-digit numbers. If you try to write to a short number (of 12 digits), you will get an error: "This number is not in WhatsApp. The client may have changed the number or deleted the account"

3\. Write your message.

4\. Done — you’ve created a conversation and wrote your first message.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to reply to incoming messages using Salesbot

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-tip.svg)

Here we tell you how to reply to incoming messages using Salesbot. If you want to create a chat from a WhatsApp, Telegram or WABA you can do it by [Wazzup widget in Salesbot](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/how-to-write-to-a-client-on-whatsapp-with-salesbot/).

Salesbot is a bot that can be programmed to perform certain actions. For example, reply to the first customer’s message.

Salesbot can only send a message to a user with whom a deal has already been created. Since “Incoming leads” is not a stage of a deal, you can’t send a message to a customer from “Incoming leads”.

#### How to create a Salesbot

1\. Go to the “Leads” section → select a pipeline → click “Automate”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/perejti-v-nastrojki-voronki.png)2\. Click on the empty box below the stage where the bot should act → select Salesbot

This will open the bot’s settings. Select:

- the event that will trigger the bot,
- time at which the bot will be triggered.

You can also add a condition for the bot to send a message to a contact from the lead.

In our example, the bot will be triggered when the lead has moved to the “Offer made” stage. It will be triggered always and for all leads that have been moved to the selected stage.

3\. After that click “+ Create a new bot”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Angl_Sozdanie-sejlzbota.png)

4\. The bot editor will open. In the “Add next step” panel, select “Message”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/vybrat-shag.png)

5\. Chose where to write and from which channels.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/vybrat-kontakty-i-kanal.png)6\. Enter the text your clients will receive after moving to this particular funnel stage.

If you want to send a media file in a message, insert a link to the file in \[square brackets\] in the Salesbot text box. Your client will get an image, not the link.

7\. As a next step chose “Stop bot”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/stop-bot.png)

8\. Save your settings in the upper right corner of the window. Now, when lead is moved to the funnel, a message will go to the client.

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/Frame-2.png)

#### Salesbot sends messages to all messengers in the lead

Salesbot does not know where to write and where not to write, so it sends messages to all applications that are added to the lead.

To unpin a chat from the lead, click on its icon under the client’s name, select “Detach chat” in the drop-down list and reload the page.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/3-en.png)

All information will remain in contact and will be detached only from the selected deal.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Connect Wazzup to HubSpot

Before creating an integration, [connect a messenger](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/).

1. [Go to “Integration with CRM”](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations) in your personal Wazzup account.

2\. Select “HubSpot” in the window that appears.

3\. Insert your HubSpot domain and click “Continue” and then “Connect”.

4\. Select the HubSpot account for which the Wazzup integration will be installed.

5\. Click “Connect app.”

Done — you have connected your HubSpot integration.

Now a contact and deal will be created when new messages come in. In the contact and deal cards, you can open a Wazzup widget with an individual chat. If you opened this chat from a contact card, the correspondence with that contact will be displayed there. If you opened this chat from a deal card, the correspondence with the contacts involved in the deal will be displayed there.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/1-53-1024x199.png)

To access the general chat, where all your dialogs are displayed, add a general chat button.

#### Add a general chat button

Users of Chromium-based browsers: Chrome, Opera, Vivaldi, Microsoft Edge, Yandex Browser, Brave, Colibri can add Wazzup general chat button.

[1\. Install the extension](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/wazzup-for-hubspot/fjnlkmelocdiljhcfphmfnkpfolcpbjm/related?hl=en) from the Chrome Web Store.

2\. Click on the “Wazzup for HubSpot” extension icon on the top bar of your browser.

3\. Click “Connect with HubSpot”. ![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/2-55.png)

4\. Select the HubSpot account to link to the extension. This should be the same account you selected when you set up the Wazzup integration.

5\. Click “Connect app”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/3-48.png)

Done — you’ve added a general chat button to the top bar of HubSpot. Now [set up the integration](https://wazzup24.com/help/hubspot-en/hubspot-integration-settings-en/).

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# Blank screen in Kommo

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl_seroe-okno.png)

After that, try to open the Wazzup chat window.

#### Second method: disable cookie blocking

First of all, try logging into your Wazzup account using the same machine and browser via the following link: [https://app.wazzup24.com](https://app.wazzup24.com/). If everything is fine, it means that the error is caused by your browser which is blocking cookies for embedded windows.

To fix this error, allow third-party cookies.

##### Google Chrome

1\. In the upper right corner of the browser, click on the three dots ![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/image-10-1.png)→ go to the “Settings” section.

2\. Open the “Privacy and security” tab on the left → select “Third-party cookies”.

3\. Scroll to “Default behavior” → enable “Allow third-party cookies”.

##### Opera

1\. Go to “Settings”.

2\. Click the “Privacy and Security” link in the side panel.

3\. In the “Cookies” section, disable the blocking.

##### Mozilla Firefox

1\. In the menu, choose “Content Blocking”.

2\. In the “Privacy & Security” panel, review the content blocking settings to enable cookies.

3\. Choose the “Standard” mode. It means that cookies are not blocked by the browser.

# Configure additional settings for integration with Kommo

Additional settings can be found [in the “Integration with CRM” section](https://app.wazzup24.com/settings/integrations) → in the “More” tab. They apply to all channels at once.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Screen-white-bg-9.png)

Content

Show

- [1\. The numbers within your CRM that are written with an 8 are considered as beginning with a +7](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/configure-additional-settings-for-integration-with-kommo/#wz24-toc-anchor-0)
- [2\. Decrypt the links sent by Salesbot into their normal view](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/configure-additional-settings-for-integration-with-kommo/#wz24-toc-anchor-1)
- [3\. Notify managers of all messages](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/configure-additional-settings-for-integration-with-kommo/#wz24-toc-anchor-2)
- [4\. Show Wazzup widget in the left panel of the Kommo menu](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/configure-additional-settings-for-integration-with-kommo/#wz24-toc-anchor-3)
- [5\. Priority channel](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/configure-additional-settings-for-integration-with-kommo/#wz24-toc-anchor-4)
- [API Key](https://wazzup24.com/help/kommo-en/configure-additional-settings-for-integration-with-kommo/#wz24-toc-anchor-5)

#### 1\. The numbers within your CRM that are written with an 8 are considered as beginning with a +7

We can only send a message to a number beginning with +7. Turn this setting on so you don’t have to change 8 to +7 in your CRM numbers.

Turn this setting off only if you have customers from Asia.

#### 2\. Decrypt the links sent by Salesbot into their normal view

Salesbot shortens links into the form amo.sh. For example, the link kruglosutka.ru will look like this: amo.sh/4823.

Decrypted links do not cause distrust, so the number of clicks on them is greater. When decrypted, WhatsApp will display a preview of the link’s content.

Do not enable transcription if you use link navigation in automation. For example, so that when a link is clicked, the sales rep is automatically set a task. If the link is decrypted, the automation will not work.

WhatsApp will not display a preview when you send an unencrypted link.

#### 3\. Notify managers of all messages

If the setting is enabled, employees with the “manager” role will have a sum of unanswered messages on the Wazzup button: unanswered messages from the manager + unanswered messages from other employees. Managers will receive push notifications in the mobile app for all clients, including those for which managers are not assigned as responsible in CRM.

If the setting is disabled, employees with the “manager” role on the Wazzup button will only have unanswered push notifications from those customers for whom the manager is assigned as responsible in CRM. Managers will receive push notifications in the mobile app only for those customers for whom they are assigned as responsible in CRM.

#### 4\. Show Wazzup widget in the left panel of the Kommo menu

After integration is enabled, the Wazzup button appears on the left panel of the Kommo menu. If you click on it, the window with all manager’s chats will open.

If you turn off the setting, the button with all available chats will disappear. Then the seller will only be able to open a chat with a specific customer from the card.

#### 5\. Priority channel

This settings item is for employees who have access to more than one WhatsApp channel. Select which channel the message will leave from if the employee texts the client first.

#### API Key

If you lack the functionality of the built-in integration, you can refine it [with the API](https://wazzup24.com/help/all-about-wazzup-en/integration-by-api-en/#Integration_with_CRMAPI).

# How to write in WhatsApp using a trigger

You can use the webhook to create a chat with a client:

1\. Go to “Deals” on the left panel of Kommo.

2\. Select “Setup” in the upper right corner.

3\. Click on the empty box in the stage you want to add the webhook to, then “+ Add Trigger”

4\. Type “Wazzup” in the search bar of the modal window that opens and click “Add”:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Frame-71.png)

5\. Select the condition that triggers the webhook. If you want the webhook to work on the clients that are already in this funnel, check the “Apply the trigger to all leads already in this stage” box:

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/Frame-72.png)

6\. Enter a message in the field “Send message thru WhatsApp”. If you leave the message field empty the chat will be created, but no message will be sent to the client.

7\. Enter the phone number of the channel for sending the message into the field “The channel’s phone number” and press “Done”.

If this field is left blank, the message will be sent from the channel of the sales rep who is assigned to the client.

If the client does not have WhatsApp on his number, the chat will not be created. The deal chat will receive an error notification and the deal will be tagged “no WA”.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)

# How to add a Kommo feedback button to your site

A feedback button is an embedded messenger for your site. The workflow is the same as if a client was writing in your WhatsApp from their phone. You can create a button, edit it, and choose it from your Kommo account. This button can only be enabled for WhatsApp channels.

![img](https://wazzup24.ru/help/wp-content/uploads/message-box-warning.svg)

The button source can only be added to one funnel, and the same is true for the button itself. If you are working with several funnels, you should decide which of them is the most logical choice to send requests from your site to.

#### How to add a button to your site

In the “Deals” section, go to the chosen funnel’s settings and click “Add source” in the left panel to add the deal source.

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2020-03-18_07-39-50.png)

A window will appear containing deal sources. Find the “CRM Plugin” source and click “Add source”.

![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/angl.png)

A window will open to add the button. In the window, you will be able to configure the location of the button and its parameters:

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2020-03-18_07-40-46.png)

To add a WhatsApp channel into the button, click the WhatsApp icon:

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2020-03-18_07-40-58.png)

After that, it will move to the right part of the field. Click the WhatsApp icon and go to the settings.

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2020-03-18_07-41-15.png)

A window will appear. Click “Add” under the Wazzup widget.

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2020-03-18_07-41-40.png)

Kommo will throw an error:

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2020-03-18_07-41-55.png)

This is a bug, and we are currently fixing it. Close the window and save the changes in the button creation window:

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2020-03-18_07-42-16.png)

After that, the “Button for site” element will appear in the left side of the panel. This means that the button is ready to use. To change its settings or copy the embed code, click on it:

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2020-03-18_07-42-40.png)

In the settings window, copy the code and paste it into the HTML markup of your page.

![](https://help.wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2020-03-18_07-42-59.png)

As a result, an Kommo button will appear on your site containing WhatsApp. By clicking on it, your client will be redirected to WhatsApp Web or the desktop version.

[![](https://wazzup24.com/help/wp-content/uploads/wz-logo-desktop-1.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/help/)
