## Less routine — more sales in Instagram

### Wazzup doesn't slow things down — it makes things easier

### Familiar features

Wazzup keeps all the familiar Instagram features: message statuses, emojis, and voice messages

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/features_for_everyone_amo_insta.CwfAHogu.png)

### Just what you need

Managers don’t get lost in chats — they only see conversations with their own clients, while the team lead sees everything

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/nothing_personnel_kid_amo_insta.D37cT2lI.png)

### No message gets lost

When things get hectic, a manager may read a message but forget to reply. No need to worry! The chat stays at the top of the list, and the notification won’t go away until they send a reply

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/clients_always_answered_amo_insta.EeZZVfUp.png)

### From chat — straight to the deal

No need to look for clients in the amoCRM. Just click the button and go directly from the chat to the deal

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/from_chat_to_deal.lvlBqUH-.png)

### Attach images and files

Managers can share images in DM right from amoCRM. Less text, more action. Message gets through quickly - everyone is happy

## Build your business with Wazzup

Wazzup is a service to integrate WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and VK with CRM and Help Desk systems. We help companies improve communications with their clients and automate business processes.

You can interact with clients using the means of communication convenient for them, right from your CRM window, and all the message history will be stored in the contact’s or deal’s card.

## We make sales in Instagram easier

### for both managers and team leads

Clients stay in CRM

Full control for team leads

Easy to sell

Less daily grind

In touch any time, any place

CLIENTS AND MESSAGES FROM INSTAGRAM — IN YOUR CRM

Replies to DMs and post comments are saved in CRM — right in the client’s chat. If a manager quits or goes on vacation, the full chat history stays in the CRM. You can hand off clients to a new teammate in just a couple of clicks — no stress.

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/clients_insta_crm.BgNh1BBz.png)

THE TEAM LEAD HAS FULL CONTROL

The team lead can see every conversation and track how many messages each manager sends, when they send them, and who they talk to. No more excuses.

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/calm_manager.CnKKWasH.png)

SELLING MADE EASY

Messages and post comments go straight to CRM — the deal and contact are created automatically. The entire chat is stored in the client’s card, so any manager can quickly jump in and continue the dialogue — the client won’t notice a thing.

You can add multiple Instagram accounts

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/convenient_sales_insta_crm.BK1kctDa.png)

MORE CLIENTS, LESS DAILY GRIND

Auto-replies and templates save time and keep you connected 24/7. Rest assured, your competitors won’t stand a chance — even at night, the client gets a quick response.

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/routine.D27eQzvC.png)

ALWAYS CONNECTED — ANYWHERE

By the water cooler, on the road, or even in line at the ATM — your managers can message clients right from the Wazzup mobile app. All conversations are synced to your CRM.

Employees can access the mobile app via their Wazzup personal account

## Build your business with Wazzup

Wazzup is a service to integrate WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and VK with CRM and Help Desk systems. We help companies improve communications with their clients and automate business processes.

You can interact with clients using the means of communication convenient for them, right from your CRM window, and all the message history will be stored in the contact’s or deal’s card.

## We make sales in Instagram easier

### for both managers and team leads

Clients stay in Bitrix24

Full control for team leads

Easy to sell

Less daily grind

In touch any time, any place

CLIENTS AND MESSAGES FROM INSTAGRAM — IN YOUR CRM

All contacts and chats are stored in Bitrix24. If a manager goes on vacation or quits, the full chat history stays in Bitrix24 — not in their phone. You can hand off clients to a new teammate in just a couple of clicks — no stress.

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/clients_bitrix_insta.CZjyuTGs.png)

THE TEAM LEAD HAS FULL CONTROL

The team lead can see all chats and track when and who the manager communicates with. End-to-end analytics show where the client came from, how much the lead cost, and which channels actually make money.

Yes, we can set up analytics that tracks users via their Google ID

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/calm_manager.CnKKWasH.png)

SELLING MADE EASY

Client messages go straight to Bitrix24 — the deal and contact are created automatically. The entire chat is stored in the client’s card, so any manager can quickly jump in and continue the dialogue — the client won’t notice a thing.

You can add multiple Instagram accounts

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/convenient_sales_bitrix_insta.CrBxvlG3.png)

MORE CLIENTS, LESS DAILY GRIND

Auto-replies, chatbots, and templates save time and keep you connected 24/7. Rest assured, your competitors won’t stand a chance — even at night, the client gets a quick response.

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/routine.D27eQzvC.png)

ALWAYS CONNECTED — ANYWHERE

By the water cooler, on the road, or even in line at the ATM — your managers can message clients right from the Wazzup mobile app. All conversations are synced to Bitrix24

Employees can access the mobile app via their Wazzup personal account

### Wazzup doesn't slow things down — it makes things easier

### Familiar features

### Just what you need

Managers don’t get lost in chats — they only see conversations with their own clients, while the team lead sees everything

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/nothing_personnel_kid_amo_insta.D37cT2lI.png)

### No message gets lost

When things get hectic, a manager may read a message but forget to reply. No need to worry! The chat stays at the top of the list, and the notification won’t go away until they send a reply

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/clients_always_answered_amo_insta.EeZZVfUp.png)

### From chat — straight to the deal

No need to look for clients in the Bitrix24. Just click the button and go directly from the chat to the deal

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/from_chat_to_deal.lvlBqUH-.png)

### Attach images and files

Managers can send any files to Instagram directly from Bitrix24. Important documents won’t get lost in emails — they’re saved in the CRM

## Build your business with Wazzup

Wazzup is a service to integrate WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and VK with CRM and Help Desk systems. We help companies improve communications with their clients and automate business processes.

You can interact with clients using the means of communication convenient for them, right from your CRM window, and all the message history will be stored in the contact’s or deal’s card.

## Упростили продажи в Instagram

### руководителям и менеджерам

Клиенты в Planfix

Руководитель спокоен

Продавать удобно

КЛИЕНТЫ И ПЕРЕПИСКИ ИЗ ИНСТЫ В CRM

Ответы в Директе и на комменты под постами хранятся в Planfix — внутри диалога с клиентом. Если менеджер уволится или уйдет в отпуск, история общения останется в CRM. Так что клиентов можно передать новому сотруднику в пару кликов и не париться

РУКОВОДИТЕЛЬ СПОКОЕН

Руководитель видит все переписки в Planfix и контролирует, сколько, когда и с кем общался менеджер.

еще в Wazzup есть раздел «Аналитика» — там можно найти статистику по диалогам

ПРОДАВАТЬ УДОБНО

Сообщения из Директа и комменты под постами сразу летят в Planfix — обращение и контакт создаются автоматически. Вся переписка хранится в обращении, чтобы любой менеджер мог быстро вникнуть и продолжить диалог с клиентом

## Build your business with Wazzup

Wazzup is a service to integrate WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and VK with CRM and Help Desk systems. We help companies improve communications with their clients and automate business processes.

You can interact with clients using the means of communication convenient for them, right from your CRM window, and all the message history will be stored in the contact’s or deal’s card.

# Wazzup Partner Program Rules

If you participate in the Wazzup Partner Program, you agree to these rules.

**Contents**

[What is the essence of partnership and why do we need rules](https://wazzup24.com/integrator-partner-rules-en/#one)

[What kind of compensation does the partner receive](https://wazzup24.com/integrator-partner-rules-en/#two)

[What else does a partner get](https://wazzup24.com/integrator-partner-rules-en/#three)

[What we in turn expect from a partner](https://wazzup24.com/integrator-partner-rules-en/#four)

[The partner understands the peculiarities of working with an IT product](https://wazzup24.com/integrator-partner-rules-en/#four-1)

[The partner will receive training and use promotional materials](https://wazzup24.com/integrator-partner-rules-en/#four-2)

[The partner sells an existing product, not a promise](https://wazzup24.com/integrator-partner-rules-en/#four-3)

[How a partner receives referral fees](https://wazzup24.com/integrator-partner-rules-en/#five)

[Where to go for help](https://wazzup24.com/integrator-partner-rules-en/#six)

[Rules for attracting customers](https://wazzup24.com/integrator-partner-rules-en/#seven)

### What is the essence of partnership and why do we need rules

As partners, we share tasks and profits with you. Our team makes a product that solves people’s problems, and you bring in customers and get money and other bonuses for it.

So that you understand what to expect from us and what we, in turn, want from our partner, we have prepared these rules. Here we tell you:

- how and under what conditions we will divide the earnings from the payments of the clients,
- how you will be credited,
- what else you will receive in addition to the remuneration.

### What kind of compensation does the partner receive

Partner receives interest for subscription payments and WABA balance top-ups.

#### Reward for subscription payments

The size of payments depends on the way you work with the client. You can work on one or two schemes at once at your choice:

**1\. Accept payments from clients and receive 35% or 50%.**

The mechanics are the same as in Kommo or Bitrix24 partnerships. You [register a new user through the partner account](https://wazzup24.com/help/the-affiliate-program-en/#addclient) set up Wazzup, accept payment and [buy him the service](https://wazzup24.com/help/the-affiliate-program-en/#partneraccount) at your partner discount. We do not communicate with this client.

The discount is your reward. You keep the amount of the discount right away, and you put the rest of the payment into a partner account to buy the service.

The percentage of commission on payments that go through you depends on the number of customers you have sold Wazzup to:

- if 9 or less — 35%,
- If 10 or more — 50% of all payments you accept.

That is, as soon as you bring the tenth client, you will get 50% from all the next payments of already connected and new users.

If you stop working with a customer, but they continue to use Wazzup and pay for the service themselves, you will receive 20% according to the scheme below.

**2\. Bring clients — they will pay for the service directly to us, and you will receive 20% of the payments for a year from the moment of their registration.**

This scheme is necessary if you do not want to work with a client. If this is the case, register a person using [your referral link](https://wazzup24.com/help/wazzup-referral-program/), and we will set up the service for him ourselves. We will pay the reward every month to your partner account.

#### Rewards for WABA balance top-ups

All partners get 10% of WABA balance top-ups regardless of the number of clients and payment method:

- If the partner tops up the balance via their account, the sum of the top-up will be 10% less;
- If the clients refill in their cabinet — 10% of the amount will be returned to the affiliate account within a year from the moment of client’s registration.

### What else does a partner get

**Transparency of payments:** you can see [in the partner’s cabinet](https://wazzup24.com/help/en/all-about-wazzup-en/the-affiliate-program/) payments of clients who registered through links, and you will understand what remuneration we will accrue to you.

**Training and [assistance](https://wazzup24.com/integrator-partner-rules-en/#six) at all stages of work with the client.** We tell you how the service is set up, how to promote it, and how to communicate with clients about the product.

**Free channels and discount on service**. Official partners get one WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and Avito channel each on the Max tariff in two accounts:

- In your personal cabinet, channels that you can use for your own commercial purposes.
- In a demo account. Use it only to demonstrate the service to customers and test its capabilities.

You can also add channels and pay for them from a partner account at a discount equal to the amount of your commission.

**Opportunity to get remuneration from payments of your clients, who connected to the service before you became a partner.** If you are working with a Wazzup user and they are not working with another partner, you can attach them to you through support.

**The ability to influence the development of the service.** Your suggestions will 100% of the time be discussed by the Wazzup product team — we review them every week.

> We collect feedback, but we don’t always do something based on it. If we think that a feature “won’t score” or won’t solve clients’ problems — we don’t take on it, because the ultimate risk of development is borne by our company.

**Bonuses for partners who have sold the service to 10 clients:**

- free WhatsApp Business API channel on Max tariff.


To connect, write [to support](https://wazzup24.com/contact-en/). The guys will create a subscription, you’ll top up your [balance](https://wazzup24.com/help/how-to-set-up/waba-billing/) to pay for dialogs, and you can use the channel to work and demonstrate the service

- personal manager.

### What we in turn expect from a partner

#### The partner understands the peculiarities of working with an IT product

**1\. The partner knows that bugs are inevitable in any IT product, and Wazzup is no exception.**

We integrate WhatsApp in the CRM: if the messenger or CRM will malfunction, it will affect the service.

If there is a problem, it will take time to find and fix the cause. During these periods, users may react violently to problems, so the partner’s job when there is a failure is to reassure customers.

**2\. The partner understands that it is impossible to predict the timeline for solving bugs and developing features.**

We can give you a timeline when we know what the problem is and can estimate how long it will take to fix it. The problem is that when something breaks down, it’s not always possible to pinpoint the cause quickly — signs can point to a variety of problems.

For example, queue delays can appear because of a DDoS attack, iFrame bugs, server problems, or CRM problems. To figure it out, we look to see if the requests are different from the normal load. Then we dig deeper and exclude what definitely doesn’t fit.

It is the searching for the cause that takes the most time. When we know what’s wrong, we fix it right away. It makes no sense to give a deadline, because it usually takes 5 minutes from the moment we know what the problem is to fix it.

✅ Calmly respond to bugs, report problems to support and reassure the client in case of technical difficulties.

❌ Scolding the company in times of trouble, demanding deadlines to solve them, and not helping customers.

#### The partner will receive training and use promotional materials

Participants will be trained to know the benefits of the service and understand how to solve a customer’s problem with Wazzup. If you don’t build on your customers’ needs when selling a service, you can’t sell it.

✅ Knowing the benefits of the service, its features and how they help customers.

❌ Not understanding why customers choose Wazzup over the competitors.

#### The partner sells an existing product, not a promise

Sometimes people sell features that don’t exist yet — we’re against that approach. The task of the partner is to communicate the value of existing functionality.

Customers choose from those services that are already on the market and cover their needs, rather than waiting for the perfect product. So if they need integration with WhatsApp, they will choose one of the apps anyway, and it makes no sense for you to rely on the customer’s “cravings” that none of the services will fulfill.

Wazzup has enough value to make people choose us: the service already solves more problems than competitors’ products. So in order to sell, you only need to explain how the current version of Wazzup solves real human problems and why we are better than other services.

✅ Offering customers solutions to their problems using existing Wazzup features.

❌ Selling customers features that don’t exist, but may someday.

### How a partner receives referral fees

If customers pay for the service themselves, on the first day of each month your affiliate account gets 20% of their payments for the previous month.

> For example, if a referral paid for the service on May 10, you will receive a percentage of the payment not immediately, but on June 1.

Rewards can be used [to pay for the service](https://wazzup24.com/help/en/all-about-wazzup-en/the-affiliate-program/) for other clients, or [withdrawn from a partner account](https://wazzup24.com/help/en/all-about-wazzup-en/wazzup-referral-program/) through [support](https://wazzup24.com/contact-en/). You can recieve your money by invoice without a fee if you are an IE or LLC. Write to support — they can help you invoice us correctly, and we will pay within three days.

> If a client pays 1000 dollars, you will get 20% — 200 on your partner account. When we send money, we will give 7% from the sum to the payment system. As a result, you will get 186 dollars — almost 19% of the client’s payment.

Remuneration is paid in euros and dollars. The partner pays all his own taxes.

### Where to go for help

If you have any questions, [write to support](https://wazzup24.com/contact-en/). The support team will solve technical problems, tell everything about the service and put you in touch with a partner manager, if necessary. Support responds within 5 minutes 24/7 and will help with urgent requests.

To consult with other integrators, ask questions to the Wazzup management and get news about the service, ask the support to be added to the chat in WhatsApp.

### Rules for attracting customers

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| How not to do: | How to do: |
| Impersonate a Wazzup employee. | Introduce yourself as an “official partner”. |
| Sell your free partner channels to customers. | Use your free channels yourself, and create separate channels for the client and pay for them. |
| Give customers discounts at the expense of your commission and sell the service cheaper than what is listed on the site in the “tariffs” section. | Sell the service at the prices on the site and take the commission — you do not work for nothing. |
| Drive any “black” traffic to Wazzup sites. For example, ClickUnder, Pop-under, Adult-traffic, spam-mailing.<br>Buy our branded traffic. | Share referral links with your friends and clients.<br>Post links on your sites and pages on social networks.<br>Buy traffic to your resources where the referral link is published. |
| Copy or create “mirrors” of Wazzup sites on domains not owned by Wazzup. | Create your own materials about Wazzup: presentations, weblinks, and more. |
| Distribute any material that contains misinformation regarding users. | Make independent reviews, constructively criticize or praise the service, and distribute [Wazzup materials](https://wazzup24.com/en/main-blog-en/). |
| Create branded groups on social networks and perform other actions on behalf of Wazzup. | Create interest groups, with help, discussions, etc. |

> For violation of the rules — expulsion from the partner program with deprivation of all privileges and opportunities.

## Развитие бизнеса с Wazzup

Wazzup — это сервис для интеграции WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram и ВКонтакте с CRM-системами и Help-desk’ами. Мы помогаем компаниям улучшить коммуникацию с клиентами и автоматизировать бизнес-процессы.

Вы можете общаться с клиентами через удобные для них способы связи из окна CRM, а вся история переписки будет храниться в карточке контакта или сделки.

UX-проектировщик

Днем интегрируем WhatsApp в CRM, а ночью планируем захват международного рынка.

Мы не стартап, который завтра развалится. Не живем на деньги ангелов и инвесторов. У нас уже 10 тысяч платящих клиентов. Мы первые в нише по СНГ и начинаем завоевывать штаты и Южную Америку. Уже сейчас 12% процентов выручки приходит в долларах.

Сейчас мы ищем в свою команду опытного **UX-проектировщика**.

**Что предстоит делать:**

- Собирать и анализировать требования к новому функционалу;
- Прорабатывать пользовательские сценарии;
- Проектировать пользовательский интерфейс с использованием готовой дизайн-библиотеки;
- Создавать адаптивный дизайн;
- Составлять сопроводительную документацию, ставить задачи разработчикам;
- Постоянно быть в тесном контакте с командой разработки, контролировать реализацию логики и дизайна продукта.

**Важно:** на этом проекте используется дизайн-система, оформлением и поддержкой которой занимается дизайн-команда основного проекта.

**Вы подходите, если:**

- Имеете опыт работы на должности **UX-проектировщика** с аналогичными функциями **от 2 лет**;
- Умеете просчитывать поведение пользователя в различных ситуациях, понимаете его психологию;
- Умеете проектировать сложные пользовательские интерфейсы, с учетом адаптивности;
- Уверенно владеете Figma;
- Понимаете принципы построения крупных дизайн-систем; имеете опыт использования и поддержки текущей дизайн-системы;
- Умеете писать сопроводительную документацию для разработчиков;
- Знаете принципы usability и умеете их применять;
- Знаете основы верстки;
- В портфолио имеете веб-интерфейсы со сложным функционалом, плюсом будут мобильные.

**Будет плюсом:**

- Навыки работы с Material Guidelines.

**Условия:**

- 5/2, фултайм, удалёнка;
- **Размер оклада обсуждаем**. На старте платим по рынку или выше, релевантно вашим навыкам, учитываем ваши потребности. Но и росту зарплаты — быть: ежегодная индексация зарплаты — разумеется, ходить за повышением к руководителю — тоже норм, если растет качество;
- Оплачиваемый отпуск, трудоустройство;
- Возможность внести лепту в завоевание мира.

Редактор

Привет! Ищем **редактора с опытом** в молодое бренд-медиа для начинающих предпринимателей и самозанятых. Молодое — это значит что нам нет двух недель 🙂

Рассказываем обо всём, что помогает жить, работать, достигать результатов и быть устойчивее к «сюрпризам» этого мира.

Балансируем между психологией и бизнесовыми темами, потому что по-другому это не работает — невозможно просто изучить техники продаж, например, а потом сразу начать колотить деньги, если в тебе сидят установки вроде: «я боюсь, мне откажут, покусают, засмеют, я опозорюсь» и всё в таком духе.

Стараемся не назидать и не занудствовать, но и при этом делать так, чтоб после прочтения можно было взять и применить новые знания.

Внутри команды от недели к неделе мы что-то поддаем сомнению, упрощаем, совсем откидываем, улучшаем. Кажется, что только так у нас получится сделать крутой продукт, завоевать сердечки читателей и вырасти. Для будущего редактора это значит, что отсидеться не получится.

**Что нужно будет делать?**

1. Контролировать качество контента:
   - _**​​​​​​​​​​​​​​**_ не хромает ли логика, вытекает ли одна мысль из другой, не противоречат ли какие-то тезисы друг-другу, есть здравый смысл;
   - достоверные ли автор взял источники, не привел ли эксперта с каким-то сомнительным опытом, мы точно не врём читателям?
   - есть ли полезное действие, раскрыто ли оно или понятно только автору?
   - примеры реальны, отражают жизненные сценарии нашей аудитории, или больше похожи на фантазию?
   - как дела с визуальным повествованием, не напихали ли авторы бездумных картинок, можем какие-то мысли раскрыть лучше с помощью визуализации?
   - как дела с читабельностью, получилось ли выдержать голос медиа, не ушел ли автор в нудятину или наоборот, в хабальство?

2\. Давать обратную связь авторам на каждом этапе работы. С помощью аудио, видео, комментов в гуглдоке или как-угодно ещё. Главное, чтоб вашу обратную связь понимали и принимали, а ещё лучше — если эта самая обратная связь поможет авторам расти.

3\. Находить косяки и точки роста. Не только в контенте, но и редпроцессах, концепции, подходе, рубриках и чём-угодно ещё. Здорово, если редактор вольется и сможет предлагать улучшения. Мы такое любим и по нашему эго не ударяют аргументированные замечания.

**Ваша ключевая задача:**

1\. Обеспечить реализацию контент-плана. Это значит сделать так, чтобы контента делалось столько, сколько запланировали, он соответствует качеству, которое мы установили и опубликован в нужные даты.

Текущий объем в месяц: 12 статей, 2 интервью, до 40 коротышей для соцсеток, 1 рассылка ВК, какие-то разовые штуки, вроде рекламных постов.

2\. Привести контент к значительным улучшениям. Это значит, что редактор находит какие-то повторяющиеся паттерны, которые считает не ок, выносит их на обсуждение, что-то предлагает и участвует во внедрении от недели к неделе.

**Вы подходите, если:**

01. Имеете опыт на позиции редактора от 1 года и работы, которые могут это доказать;
02. Пользуетесь базовым софтом: googledocs, googlesheet, figma — только проверка материалов и комментирование, notion — ведение задач и баз данных;
03. Умеете выстроить коммуникацию с командой авторов, иллюстратором, корректором и вышестоящими;
04. Умеете формулировать обратную связь — так, чтоб авторы ее понимали и развивались;
05. Очень преочень логичный, можете заметить когда в тексте есть нестыковки или одна мысль нелогично перетекает в другую;
06. Сами пишете в инфостиле, вам не надо объяснять про «мир читателя» и «полезное действие». Разделяете этот подход и готовы развивать это в своих людях;
07. Имеете опыт в проверке материалов на достоверность;
08. Умеете подстраиваться под ToV или просто «свой в доску», сможете писать на языке нашего медиа;
09. Умеете находить, проверять на адекватность и договариваться с экспертами на сотрудничество;
10. Четко излагаете свои мысли и умеете задавать вопросы.

**Как работаем и платим**

По графику: полностью удаленно, фулл-тайм, но на связи с 10 до 19 мск;

По деньгам: кажется, что это стоит около 80к рублей, но мы готовы обсуждать;

По оплатам: платим два раза в месяц. Две недели отработал — получил половину оклада, ещё 2 отработал — ещё половину;

По карьерной лестнице: расти можно и нужно, работы дофига — главное чтоб вам было что предложить.

Аналитик (Data Analyst)

IT-компания Wazzup приглашает в команду **Продуктового аналитика.**

Днем мы интегрируем WhatsApp в CRM, а ночью планируем захват международного рынка.

Мы не стартап, который завтра развалится. Не живем на деньги ангелов и инвесторов. У нас уже 10 тысяч платящих клиентов. Мы первые в нише по СНГ и начинаем завоевывать штаты и Южную Америку. Уже сейчас 12% процентов выручки приходит в долларах.

**Что предстоит делать:**

- Строить дашборды в BI инструменте;
- Эдхоки (PostgreSQL / Big Query);
- Участвовать в разработке дизайна и проведении **A/B-тестов**;
- Разрабатывать аналитические витрины;
- Участвовать в развитии продукта: искать инсайты в данных и доносить их до команды.

**Мы ждем, что вы:**

- Имеете опыт работы в области анализа данных (воронки, когортный анализ, A/B-тесты) от 6 месяцев;
- Работали с системами визуализации данных: Tableau, PowerBI, Data Studio;
- Строили витрины данных;
- **Уверенно владеете SQL**, умеете писать сложные запросы к базам данных;
- Имеете опыт работы с BigQuery;
- Имеете опыт применения статистических методов проверки гипотез, построения оценок и прогнозов;
- Готовы решать нетривиальные задачи в условиях неполных данных;
- Имеете опыт работы с Яндекс Метрикой, Google Analytics и Google Tag Manager, Amplitude;
- Способны аргументированно защитить свою точку зрения.

**Что предлагаем?**

- Отличную возможность прокачаться и пополнить свою копилку успешных кейсов;
- Достойную оплату труда;
- Оплачиваем профильное обучение (75%);
- 5/2, фултайм, удалёнка или офис в Москве;
- Оплачиваемый отпуск, трудоустройство.

Бизнес-аналитик

Днем интегрируем WhatsApp в CRM, а ночью планируем захват международного рынка.

Мы не стартап, который завтра развалится. Не живем на деньги ангелов и инвесторов. У нас уже 10 тысяч платящих клиентов. Мы первые в нише по СНГ и начинаем завоевывать штаты и Южную Америку. Уже сейчас 12% выручки приходит в долларах.

Мы ищем в команду **бизнес-аналитика**, опытного и самоходного, который способен решать сложные задачи. Первый проект, который предстоит реализовать – интеграция Wazzup в 1C. Задача сложная из-за трудностей реализации: у 1С много версий и “поженить” нас с ними так, чтобы это было полезно для пользователей и масштабируемо — нетривиально.

**Что предстоит делать:**

- Собирать технические ограничения;
- Выяснять какие у пользователей есть потребности и проблемы (custdev);
- Описывать требования;
- Взаимодействовать с командами разработки, дизайна, аналитики.

**Вы подходите, если:**

- Имеете опыт на аналогичной позиции от 2 лет;
- Способны разобраться с техническими ограничениями продукта;
- Умеете работать с пользователями: выявлять потребности, проблемы, формировать требования;
- Умеете писать запросы в SQL;
- Имеете опыт описания требований и постановки задач в разработку;
- Вы логичный и скрупулезный.

**Условия:**

- 5/2, фултайм, удалёнка;
- **Размер оклада обсуждаем**. На старте платим по рынку или выше, релевантно вашим навыкам, учитываем ваши потребности. Но и росту зарплаты — быть: ежегодная индексация зарплаты — разумеется, ходить за повышением к руководителю — тоже норм, если растет качество;
- Оплачиваемый отпуск, трудоустройство;
- Компенсация профессионального обучения и психотерапии.

## People often ask us

[Do you connect the WhatsApp Business API?](https://wazzup24.com/millionmakers/)

Yes, we do. You can integrate WhatsApp Business API with CRM. Do it yourself or contact our [support team](https://wazzup24.com/en/contact-en/) for assistance. We can help you to apply for verification, agree the templates, get a green tick.

[Is bulk messaging possible?](https://wazzup24.com/millionmakers/)

It’s possible, WhatsApp Business API is great for this. You can send out unlimited bulk messages and add buttons to messages to boost the conversion rate.

[Do you support group chats?](https://wazzup24.com/millionmakers/)

Yes. Moreover, if you use one number for all sales reps, they will see group chats only with their clients, not with anyone else.

[What other messengers do you serve?](https://wazzup24.com/millionmakers/)

We can integrate WhatsApp Business API, Telegram, and Instagram, any of them or all at once. Even if there are several messengers, you can respond to clients from one window.

[I don’t have any of the CRMs on the list. Do you integrate with other CRMs?](https://wazzup24.com/millionmakers/)

If your CRM isn’t on the list, you can use [Wazzup via API](https://wazzup24.com/help/en/all-about-wazzup-en/integration-by-api-en/).

[All my sales reps have their own numbers, is the service for me?](https://wazzup24.com/millionmakers/)

Yes, all sales reps will text using CRM or our mobile app but will not see each other’s messages.

[Can I use Wazzup if I have many sales reps?](https://wazzup24.com/millionmakers/)

Yes, no problem. It’s possible to move all sales reps to one channel or create a separate one for each.

[I have several branches with different numbers. Is the service suitable in this case?](https://wazzup24.com/millionmakers/)

Yes, we have companies that operate this way. Each branch has its own phone number, which is used by all sales reps at that branch. When new inquiries are made to this number, they are distributed among the sales reps of this branch.

[Can you hook up end-to-end analytics?](https://wazzup24.com/millionmakers/)

Yes, we can set up integration with Roistat, CoMagic, and any other analytics system that works with Google ID.

[Do you collect and store any message data?](https://wazzup24.com/millionmakers/)

Yes, so that you can chat with clients through Wazzup. But we transmit and store all data encrypted so no one can intercept and access your chat history.

We comply with international personal data processing policies and keep a close eye on our systems to make sure they’re secure and safe.

# \#20: attached files in templates, pictures in VK and dialogues counte

February 20, 2023

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/wz-blog-post-duration-2.svg)

6 минут

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/changelog_image_3-10-1024x768.png)

Wazzup, fellas! Here we are with some updates — we tidied up the dialogue counter in the personal account, fixed file uploads in the Wazzup activity and stopped cropping wide pictures from VK (Vkontakte).

Details about all of this here in our new changelog.

### New working rules for end-to-end analytics in Kommo

A reminder for Kommo users who:

— work with Google Analytics using the Wazzup script,

— independently added fields and prescribed their names in order to receive tags from messages.

Important note: If your tags come to the gclientId Kommo system field, you can skip this news – straight to bug fixes 🙂

The rules for working with Kommo fields have changed. Tags from messages are pulled into fields with “google” in the title only.

If the field names contain “ga”, it must be renamed. With tags that have already been pulled into the fields everything is going to be okay, nothing will change.

So, what you need to do in that case:

1. Open any deal card → “Setup” tab.
2. Find the field for tags → click on it.
3. Enter a new name “google”.

Click “Save” → the name will automatically change in the fields in all leads.

4. In the “Integration with CRM” section of your Wazzup account, click “Update data from CRM”.

If “google” is already indicated in the field names, nothing needs to be changed. Even if there are others besides these words. For example, the name “google\_analytics” would also work. The tags will continue to pull up in the field.

If you have any questions — write to support. We will explain and help with everything you need.

### The file automatically attaches to the WABA template when you configure automation

**How it worked before** **:** the file uploaded to the WABA template header in the personal account wasn’t pulled up in the Wazzup activity in Bitrix or Salesbot. During the automation setup you had to search for the desired file and manually upload it again.

**How it works now** **:** now the template is loaded immediately within the file. If necessary, you can replace it and use another one.

### Showing the correct number of dialogs for the Pro plan

**How it worked before** **:** some users with the Pro tariff indicated in the dialogue counter that there were 100 total dialogues on the channel, although in fact there are 500 of them.

**How it works now** **:** now we show the correct number.

### Integration domains can be added without “https://” in its link

**How it worked before** **:** when the user connected the integration and inserted a link to the CRM, the integration wasn’t added if the link was copied without “https://”.

**How it works now:** now we have support for a little bit shorter links 🙂

### VK: we don’t crop wide images anymore

**How it worked before** **:** wide images that customers sent from VK were cut off in our chats. The full picture could be seen only by opening the correspondence in the VK chat itself.

**How it works now** **:** now images can be seen in its original form.

That’s all for now, folks. Stay tuned to our newswire to keep up with our updates.

Hugs to everyone :\*

## Global Wazzup update. Mobile app, new design, chats and settings - Wazzup - integration WhatsApp and Instagram with KommoCRM, Bitrix24, Planfix, Envy CRM, Megaplan, Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot

> **Source:** https://wazzup24.com/news-en/global-wazzup-update-mobile-app-new-design-chats-and-settings/

> **Description:** Mobile app for correspondence with clients Now managers will be able to correspond not only from their computer, but also from their phone. Absolutely

[Skip to content](https://wazzup24.com/news-en/global-wazzup-update-mobile-app-new-design-chats-and-settings/#content)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/wz-logo-mobile.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/)

Menu

# Global Wazzup update. Mobile app, new design, chats and settings

May 5, 2021

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/wz-blog-post-duration-2.svg)

6 min

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/mehanika-tarifikaczii-1024x675.png)

## Mobile app for correspondence with clients

Now managers will be able to correspond not only from their computer, but also from their phone. Absolutely everything that the manager has in the chat on the computer will also be in the mobile app: the same filters, accesses and correspondence history.

In the “Mobile App” tab of the Wazzup personal account, you will see a list of employees from the CRM. The account administrator will need to add employees’ phone numbers so that they are sent an invitation to the app. When new employees are added to roles in the integration settings, the invitation will be sent automatically.

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/telefon.png)

## New chat interface

The interface has become simpler and more intuitive. Thanks to this, you won’t have to spend a lot of time studying its features.

We adapted the interface for screens with different resolutions, so that it works on any monitor.

**Before**

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/1.png)

**After**

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/2.png)

## New chat logic

Previously, messages were included in one dialogue if there were several channels of correspondence with the client. This was done so that you could see all correspondence in chronological order — what someone wrote and when.

Viewing all correspondence at once was convenient for the manager, but it only hindered the ordinary employees: a manager and a support employee do not need to see each other’s messages — this only confuses them.

Now we have made it so that in Wazzup chats everything is the same as on the client side — in correspondence with one client from different channels, each channel has its own separate dialogue. For example, if support and sales correspond from different channels with one customer, in Wazzup these will be two different conversations.

If a manager wants to see all correspondence with a customer in one chat, they can do it using the “View all dialogs” button.

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/3.png)

## New settings interface

**Only one CRM can be connected to one account**

Previously you could connect more than one CRM to an account. We looked at statistics and out of 5,000 accounts with active integrations, only five had two CRMs connected. No one had three CRMs.

We will personally contact these five accounts and help them create another personal account and move the integrations to it. If you have two active integrations in one account and we haven’t contacted you yet, [write to our support team](https://wazzup24.com/contact/).

Because we removed the connection of multiple CRM, we were able to simplify the interface settings.

**Integration settings won’t slow down on accounts with 50+ employees**, because we moved settings with user selection to separate windows.

**Removed the pull-down settings panel**

Now settings have their own separate page which is convenient to use.

**Before**

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/4.png)

**After**

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/5.png)

## Changes in integration settings

**Removed the “Channels in this integration” setting**

Now only one CRM can be connected to one account, so channels are immediately added to the integration.

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/6.png)

**We removed load balancing** from the “Assign Responsible for New Deals” setting. We looked at the statistics and found out that only 5% of users used this setting. The other 95% were putting the same workload on all employees, which corresponds to the “in order” setting — all managers took turns getting new clients.

Now when creating “Incoming leads” in amoCRM the first responding sales rep will receive the client, and when creating a deal in any funnel sales reps will receive new customers in order.

In Bitrix24 the distribution of new clients needs to be selected in a separate setting.

**Before**

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/7.png)

**After**

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/8.png)

**Group chats are now always visible**, so we removed the “Group chats” setting. A group chat is needed to connect an accountant or an assistant on the client side or a related person on the sales rep side to the correspondence. Displaying group chats is a unique feature that only Wazzup has.

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/9.png)

**Changed the “Ability to write from channels in Wazzup chats” and “Inside Wazzup chat” settings**

Access to correspondence in the channel is now set when selecting the role of an employee:

- Quality Control — checks sales reps’ work. They see all sales reps’ correspondence, but can’t write anything.
- Sales rep — communicates with clients and conducts deals. They can only write to the clients he is responsible for in the CRM. They cannot see the correspondence of other sales reps.
- Manager — manages and supervises large deals. They see the correspondence of all sales reps and can write to any client.

**Before**

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/10.png)

**After**

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/11.png)

**Added funnel selection for a deal in Bitrix24**

Previously, in Bitrix24, you could create a lead, contact, or contact with a deal. A deal was created in the default funnel. We removed the “create contact” item, because it makes no sense to create a contact without a deal.

Now in Bitrix24 you can create a lead or a deal in the desired funnel. When creating a deal, a contact will be created as well.

**Before**

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/12.png)

**After**

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/13.png)

**Changed the “Duplicating dialogues into deal card” and “Log messages into…” settings in Bitrix24**

We used to send comments to the event feed once an hour or once a day. We removed this setting because it was breaking the chronology of events.

For example, a sales rep set a task for himself. After that, he received a comment with the messages he had sent before setting the task. We ended up confusing the sales rep.

Now we send each comment separately to keep the chronology. The comments are duplicated in the lead, in the contact, and in the deal, so they don’t get lost.

**Before**

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/14.png)

**After**

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/15.png)

# How new mechanics of accounting limits for pricing plans work

January 18, 2021

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/wz-blog-post-duration-2.svg)

6 минут

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/mehanika-tarifikaczii-angl-1024x675.png)

Since January, we have changed the mechanics of accounting limits for pricing plans because the old system did not meet the needs of our customers.

## What problems new mechanics solved

**Problem 1.** There was a limit on the number of active dialogues per hour. The system considered an active dialogue any chat where there was an outgoing message. When the limit was over, all outgoing messages stopped being dispatched and were sent only at the beginning of the next hour. This system hit companies hard during their peak hours.

It was unprofitable to temporarily change the pricing plan to a higher one since a higher plan was needed only 2-3 hours a day. However, when the subscription was changed, the tariff was applied for the entire paid period.

**Solution.** New mechanics consider each specific WhatsApp or Instagram of a client as a unique dialogue. The client wrote to you once; the system recorded it, and then you can communicate with the client for a month without any restrictions.

**Problem 2.** A company needs to know the number of processed leads. However, the system gave only data on the number of active dialogues that say nothing.

**Solution.** You can monitor the dynamic of customer growth by month in your Wazzup account:

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/2021-01-18_12-09-18-2-1024x381.png)

Opposite to each date, there is the sum of unique dialogues, taking into account the previous days of the month and not only specific date:

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/frame-46-3.png)

If you exceeded the limit before the end of the month — your company has grown, and it is great 🙂  To [switch to the senior pricing plan](https://wazzup24.com/en/pricing-en/), you need to pay the difference in the cost of plans for days before the end of the subscription.

## Current limits on the number of unique dialogues

- Start — up to 100 dialogues per month,
- Pro — up to 500 dialogues per month,
- Max — unlimited number of dialogues per month.

❗ Comments on Instagram are not considered as dialogues, only messages to direct.

❗  If the client wrote to you first on Instagram, and then on WhatsApp, the system will record two unique dialogues.

If you have a subscription that you paid before January, conditions will stay the same for the end of a subscription period.

If you do not want to wait for the end of the subscription period and try new mechanics today, you need to write to our support on [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/79856256113), [Telegram](https://teleg.run/wazzup_support_bot), [Facebook](https://m.me/wazzup24com/) or email [support@wazzup24.com](mailto:support@wazzup24.com).

## How we transplanted the call center to WhatsApp: history and numbers - Wazzup - integration WhatsApp and Instagram with KommoCRM, Bitrix24, Planfix, Envy CRM, Megaplan, Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot

> **Source:** https://wazzup24.com/news-en/how-we-transplanted-a-call-center-on-whatsapp-history-and-numbers-en/

> **Description:** Author: Alexander Fuch. Company: Posylka.de Gmb. Niche: Home goods through online store and paper catalogs for Russian-speaking expats in Germany. Staff:

[Skip to content](https://wazzup24.com/news-en/how-we-transplanted-a-call-center-on-whatsapp-history-and-numbers-en/#content)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/wz-logo-mobile.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/)

Menu

# How we transplanted the call center to WhatsApp: history and numbers

December 8, 2020

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/wz-blog-post-duration-2.svg)

6 минут

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/7cd6622b-601e-cb7c-91d2-236f3b83edf2.png)

**Author:** Alexander Fuch.

**Company:** Posylka.de Gmb.

**Niche:** Home goods through online store and paper catalogs for Russian-speaking expats in Germany.

**Staff:** 52 employees, including 25 in the call cente.

**Sales volume:** about 7000 trades per mont.

**Number of calls:** about 1000 conversations with clients per day.

We have been working since 2005, and initially communicated with clients only by phone. Call center calls are of three types:

- Inbox from potential customers looking to buy something.
- Inbox from current customers with questions or problems about items already purchased.
- Outgoing from the base for the purpose of upselling.

Calls of the first and third types bring money, while the second (service) calls do not. And when operators are on service calls, they do not call customers, so the speed of their processing directly affects sales.

Service calls are rarely closed with one call, because often need to share photos and documents with the buyer. For example, send him instructions on the product or, conversely, take a photo from him with the image of marriage and then make another call to agree on a solution to the problem.

We used e-mail to send documents, but sometimes people asked, “Can I send you to WhatsApp.” I decided to give it a try – I registered WhatsApp and transferred one of the operators to it. Bottom line: the operator began to process 26% more calls than his colleagues “on the phone”, despite the fact that he had to copy all the correspondence in CRM by hand.

Reason: the operator could communicate with several clients in parallel and did not waste time pauses in the conversation and waiting for the client’s response.

It became clear that it was necessary to transfer everyone to WhatsApp, but immediately ran into a problem: only one person can use the web version of WhatsApp at a time, so it just didn’t work out that way. The option with 25 WhatsApp numbers was not considered, because advertising 25 numbers is ineffective and there would be problems when transferring a client between managers.

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/center.png)

We searched and considered several options for solutions and, as a result, settled on wazzup24.com – a service that integrates WhatsApp with CRMs, including Bitrix, which we use. (By the way, they had just launched then – it was the fall of 2018 – so we became one of the first users of it.)

With the integration, all 25 operators were able to send and receive messages simultaneously through the familiar CRM interface. At the same time, from the client’s point of view, everything looks like ordinary communication through a messenger with one interlocutor.

The integration also solved the problem of transferring WhatsApp correspondence to CRM, which took the first WhatsApp operator 30-60 minutes a day. This simplified the work with clients: you can quickly restore the entire history of communication, there is no problem of transferring clients between managers.

As soon as we solved the problem of scaling, we began to tell customers that they can write in WhatsApp. For half a year, 85% of service calls began to come to the messenger.

Why the majority of customers started to write on WhatsApp:

- In Germany, WhatsApp is the most popular messenger. 89% of the population use messengers, 81% of them use WhatsApp.
- It is easier to write a message than to make a phone call and the client does not need to listen to beeps, wait for the operator to answer.
- It is convenient for customers to take photos directly from the phone.

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/aa1776c5-f1bc-71b0-0111-728bfaf883e4.png)

This is how we promote WhatsApp in the catalog.We tried to post QR codes when scanning which people immediately opened a WhatsApp chat, but it didn’t take off – clients did not know how to scan it.Therefore, we write the instructions as in the picture.It is worth considering that our audience is 55+ years old.

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/7cd6622b-601e-cb7c-91d2-236f3b83edf2.png)

We ship 520 of these pallets per year.

In addition to the service, we began to accept orders from customers via WhatsApp.We send out 870,000 catalogs a year across our entire client base, people choose what they want to buy, cut out an order coupon, fill it out and send it to us.They used to send it by regular mail (yes, Germany is a very traditional country), now we ask them to send a photo of the coupon in WhatsApp.This saves us 2 days and simplifies the ordering process for customers.

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/617aa8ab-3441-8bdc-f7c5-9c53e33a299d.png)

Our coupon from the catalog

As a result, we unloaded the call center by 20%. The operators spend the freed time on sales and call current customers. Sales per operator grew by 34%

Customers also like to communicate via WhatsApp: customers often thank operators directly in the chat and say that they liked the service. Previously, there were much fewer positive reviews. This is expressed in numbers: customers who have communicated with us through WhatsApp at least once are 30% more likely to refer friends through our referral program.

Now we have also connected Viber, but so far there are few calls from there, because it loses a lot in the popularity of WhatsApp.

I hope my experience will be useful to other companies that are thinking about starting to communicate with customers in messengers.

# Instagram API now in Wazzup. Before anyone else. Well, almost.

August 31, 2021

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads//2021/07/wz-blog-post-duration-2.svg)

6 минут

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/frame-76.png)

Clean Instagram without proxies, mumbo-jumbos and unexpected bans is now available at Wazzup.

**How much does it cost?** — As before: Start — 1500 ₽, Pro — 3000 ₽, Max — 6000 ₽.

**How to add an Instagram API channel?** — We [wrote in the instructions](https://help.wazzup24.com/en/all-about-wazzup-en/security-en/how-to-create-a-channel-in-wazzup-en/#Instagram_API_channel).

**How do I switch to the new Instagram API?** — Delete the old Instagram channel with your contacts and posts intact and add a new Instagram API channel.

In the list of chats, select the desired contact and click “Create a dialog”, the chat will be added to the contact. If you select “View all dialogues”, both the correspondence from the old channel and new messages will be shown in one chat.

Add the Instagram API channel to the same subscription where the Instagram channel was. Done.

**Can I add an Instagram account to the Instagram channel and the Instagram API channel at the same time?** — You can, but there will be a mess of chat messages — they will come several times and drive everyone crazy. Don’t do it that way.

**Will old customer correspondence be pulled up when you add an Instagram API channel?** — No. When adding the Instagram API channel, old correspondence in Wazzup chats will not be pulled up.

**If the channel has been unauthorized or unpaid for a while, will the messages not be pulled up during that period either?** — Yes. If the channel has changed its status from “Active” to something else for a while, the messages in Wazzup for this period will not be pulled up.

**Can the Instagram API change to “Not Authorized” status?** — It can. For example, if the user who added the channel is no longer the administrator of the Facebook business page to which the Instagram account is linked.

**Do the “Filter for comments by keyword” and “Show comments” settings for the Instagram API channel work?** — Yes, the settings for the Instagram API channel are the same as for the Instagram channel.

**Can I write first to Direct from the Instagram API channel?** — No. You can write first to Direct from the app on your phone. When the client responds to your message, a 7-day dialog box will open. During this time, you can write to the client from the Instagram API channel. Each incoming message from the client extends the dialog box for another 7 days. If the 7 days have passed, you won’t be able to send a message to the client.

**Can I reply to a comment on a post from the Instagram API channel?** — You can. The comment to the post will come as an incoming message to the chat. If you reply to a message with a quote, the message will go as a reply to a comment on the post.

_Replying to a comment with a quote is only possible from Wazzup chats. From amoCRM native chats or Bitrix24 Open Channels, you cannot reply to a comment with a quote._

**Can I reply to a comment on a post with a Direct message?** — Yes. If you reply to a comment without quoting, the message will go to the client in Direct. Reply to a comment in Direct can only be sent within seven days from the date of publication of the comment. And for each comment, you can only send one message to Direct, and then you have to wait for the client to respond.

When the client responds to your Direct message, a 7-day dialog window opens. During this time, you can write to the client from the Instagram API channel. Each incoming message from the client extends the dialog box for another 7 days. If the 7 days have passed, you can’t send a message to the client.

## Removing two settings for integration with amoCRM - Wazzup - integration WhatsApp and Instagram with KommoCRM, Bitrix24, Planfix, Envy CRM, Megaplan, Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot

> **Source:** https://wazzup24.com/news-en/removing-two-settings-for-integration-with-amocrm-en/

> **Description:**   In a week, we remove two settings for integration with amoCRM: 1. The additional setting "1. Create tasks for incoming messages". 2. The setting

[Skip to content](https://wazzup24.com/news-en/removing-two-settings-for-integration-with-amocrm-en/#content)

[![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/wz-logo-mobile.svg)](https://wazzup24.com/)

Menu

# Removing two settings for integration with amoCRM

June 17, 2021

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads//2021/07/wz-blog-post-duration-2.svg)

6 минут

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/angl.png)

In a week, we remove two settings for integration with amoCRM:

1\. The additional setting “1. Create tasks for incoming messages”.

2\. The setting “3. All the deals with a certain client are closed, and then this client writes in again. What to do?”:

— notify the sales rep responsible in the CRM. The sales rep will decide on their own if a new deal needs to be created;

— automatically create a new deal as if it was a new client.

## Removing the additional setting “1. Create tasks for incoming messages”

**Why we did it.** We originally did this setup as a notification tool. We didn’t have a chat window in amoCRM at the time, and we needed to notify of incoming messages.

**Why we kept it.** Once the chat window appeared, we left the setting for two purposes: to notify sales reps about incoming messages from clients and to monitor sales reps. In fact, it turned out that the setting did both tasks poorly.

**Why this setting is a bad notifier.** Inbox tasks get mixed up with other tasks. For example, a sales rep has a task for a meeting with a client. Before the meeting, the sales rep receives a bunch of incoming messages and a task is created for each incoming message. As a result, the sales rep gets lost in these tasks and misses the meeting.

**What a good notifier is.** Notifications of incoming messages from the client work well in the Wazzup chat window. They don’t get lost among other notifications and don’t disappear until the sales rep responds to the client. The sales rep needs to follow one simple rule: there should be no unanswered message icons in the chat window.

**Why this setting is a bad control method.** Tasks that are created on incoming messages clutter up the sales rep’s task book, and it becomes impossible to assess the quality of his work.

**What’s a good way to control.** Controlling sales reps’ answers and watching correspondence is more convenient in the Wazzup widget, setting up the manager’s role as “Manager”. He will see which sales reps didn’t answer the customer, and can go directly to the chat and read the history of correspondence. To get an even better look at sales reps’ work, connect your analytics.

## Removing the setting “3. All the deals with a certain client are closed, and then this client writes in again. What to do?”

There were two options in this setting:

— notify the sales rep responsible in the CRM. The sales rep will decide on their own if a new deal needs to be created;

— automatically create a new deal as if it was a new client.

**This setting is unnecessary**, because the second option “Automatically create a new deal” only hinders the sales department: for every “Thank you” from a client a new extra deal is created.

**If you still need this setting,** enable it in amoCRM. To do this, go to “Settings” → “Communication tools” → “Conversations” → “Select the rules for creating a new conversation” in amoCRM.

**The way it will be now**. After deleting the setting, the default option will be “Notify the person in charge in the CRM manager. He will decide himself whether to create a new transaction or not.” If you had this option, nothing will change for you.

## Why do we remove settings?

We provide a service for sales departments. Our sales department uses amoCRM and, of course, our integration. We are constantly thinking about how to improve sales reps’ efficiency, how to help managers keep track of salespeople’s work, and how to make our service simpler and more convenient. We collect feedback, look at statistics on the use of settings, observe how our sales reps use the service tools and draw conclusions about what works, what needs to be fixed or removed.

Behind each setting in the interface there is a piece of software code. This code needs to be maintained: something has changed in amoCRM — you need to debug the code, WhatsApp has been updated — you need to fix the code, something has broken somewhere — you need to go back and repair the code.

If a setting isn’t useful, there’s no point in leaving it in the interface and maintaining it. By removing unnecessary settings, we simplify the interface and make the service more stable.

If you do not agree with our decision or you have any questions and suggestions, [write to our support](https://wazzup24.com/contact/). When we make decisions to change the service, we rely on your feedback.

Mobile app for correspondence with clients Now managers will be able to correspond not

# Updating the “Subscriptions” section of the personal account

August 4, 2021

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads//2021/07/wz-blog-post-duration-2.svg)

3 минуты

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/changelog_image_3.png)

This time we did not cut out big chunks of the service or delete any settings. No changes to the service are expected — messages will come and go.

The changes will affect only those who are going to change the parameters of the subscription or buy a new one. See [our instructions](https://help.wazzup24.com/en/all-about-wazzup-en/working-with-subscription/) for how to do this.

## What’s new

**Renaming the section.** Now you can add, change, or rename a subscription in the “Subscriptions” section.

**Getting rid of the balance.** There is no longer the notion of a balance that you have to refill and then use it to pay for a subscription. It became much easier— you add a subscription and pay for it.

**Transferring money from the balance to the bonus account.** What used to be called an affiliate account is now called a “Bonus account”.

If you have money left on your balance, it will be transferred in the form of bonuses to your bonus account: “Affiliate” section of your Wazzup personal account → tab “Bonus Account”.

You can use the bonuses when you buy or renew a subscription.

**Adding bonus payment to your subscription.** Part of a subscription or the entire subscription can be paid for with bonuses. Any Wazzup user can earn bonuses by participating [in the affiliate program](https://wazzup24.com/en/referral-affiliate-program-en/).

**Removing the restriction on creating multiple subscriptions with one tariff.** It was a strange restriction 🙂 We couldn’t figure out what it was for, so we listened to those who were bothered by it and decided to remove it.

Now large companies can create separate subscriptions for their departments and branches.

**Offering a discount in real money, not in extra days.** Previously, when buying a subscription, we gave extra days, but now we offer a discount in cash: when buying a subscription for 6 months — 10%, when buying a subscription for a year — 20%.

**Making it pretty.** We changed the look of the section and put all the useful information on one screen. If you need to change the subscription parameters, click the three dots on the right side of the screen.

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/image1.png)

If you noticed a mistake, a missing functionality, something moved or flopped in the interface of the section — [please write to support](https://wazzup24.com/contact/). Feedback is important to us and we will gratefully accept it.

## كيف تصبح شريك

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/6-1.png)

- تواصل معنا، وسنتحدث إليكم بالتفصيل حول الشراكة
- سنقدم التعليم بطريقة سهلة وبسيطة عبر مكالمة ZOOM
- أصبحت شريك رسمي 🙂

- استكشف الخدمة بنفسك
- استلام مواد تساعدكم في البيع من قبل فريقنا
- قم بالبيع لعملائك واحصل على العمولة

[كُن شريكاً](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-ar/#partn)

## قيادة السوق & تحسين اتصالات إدارة علاقات العملاء (CRM).

- رؤيتنا هي توسيع الريادة في السوق في جميع أنحاء العالم
- تعزيز دور Wazzup في تكامل المراسلة
- تعزيز النمو المتسارع من خلال شراكات موثوقة وقابلة للتطوير
- المواقع: أمريكا اللاتينية، الشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا، أوروبا

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/4-1-1.png)

## الأسئلة الشائعة

[عندما أقوم ببيع الخدمة للعميل العاشر، هل سأحصل على 50% من الدفعات من العملاء الجدد فقط؟](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-ar/)

سوف تتلقى نصف المدفوعات لجميع العملاء: الجدد وأولئك الذين قمت بتكوين الخدمة لهم من قبل.

[كيف سيتم الدفع لي؟ كيف أعرف أنك دفعت لي كامل المبلغ؟](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-ar/)

ستستقبل الأموال من العميل، وتحتفظ على الفور بالعمولة لنفسك وتدفع مقابل الخدمة.

[هل هناك مكافآت للشركات التابعة؟](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-ar/)

– WhatsApp و Instagram مجاناً. وللشركاء الذين لديهم أكثر من 10 عملاء – أيضاً WhatsApp Business API.

– مدير شخصي.

– شهادات يمكن نشرها على الموقع أو إرسالها للعميل.

– اجتماعات مع إدارة الشركة. في الاجتماعات، يمكنك التأثير على تطوير الخدمة.

[إذا قمت بربط عميل وقام بدفع الاشتراك بنفسه، فهل سأتوقف عن استلام المكافأة؟](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-ar/)

في هذه الحالة سوف تحصل على 20% من مدفوعات العميل خلال عام من لحظة تسجيله. إذا بدأت بدعم المستخدم مرة أخرى وقمت بتجديد اشتراكاته، فسوف تكسب ما يصل إلى 50%، كما كان من قبل.

[ماذا يفعل affiliate ؟](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-ar/)

1 ربط العميل، وتكوين التكامل له.

2 يقبل دفع IE للمستخدم من حساب الشريك.

3 دعم العملاء: يساعد على فهم الخدمة والإجابة على الأسئلة.

4 عند انتهاء الاشتراك، قم بإصدار فواتير التجديد والعودة إلى الخطوة 2

[هل تقومون بتدريب affiliates على كيفية العمل مع العميل؟](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-ar/)

سنعلمكم كيفية تقديم الخدمة وسنقدم لكم المواد التي ستساعدكم على بيع Wazzup حتى للعملاء “الباردين”. إذا كانت لديك أسئلة حول حالات محددة، يمكنك دائمًا التوجه إلى مديرنا للحصول على المشورة. نعقد أيضًا اجتماعات حيث نناقش أسئلتك.

[هل يمكنك مساعدتي إذا لم أفهم شيئًا ما؟](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-ar/)

نحن لا نتخلى عن الشركاء – يستجيب الدعم خلال 5 دقائق ويعمل على مدار الساعة طوال أيام الأسبوع. إذا كانت لديك أسئلة حول الترويج للخدمة والمبيعات، فسيساعدك مديرنا في معرفة ذلك. يمكنك أيضًا مناقشة إعداد الخدمة مع موظفي Wazzup والشركاء الرائعين مثلك في دردشة الشركاء.

[لدي عملاء يستخدمون Wazzup. هل يمكنني الحصول على نسبة مئوية من مدفوعاتهم؟](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-ar/)

إذا كنت تساعد عميل Wazzup حالي ولا يعمل مع شريك آخر، فيمكنك ربطه بنفسك من خلال الدعم.

[لماذا يقوم العميل بالتسجيل من خلال affiliate أو رابط إحالة؟](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-ar/)

يحصل جميع عملاء الشريك على مكافأة قدرها 10 دولارات عند التسجيل.

## Preguntas frecuentes

[Cuando venda el servicio a los diez clientes, ¿recibiré el 50% de los pagos solo de nuevos clientes?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-es/)

Recibirás la mitad del pago de todos los clientes: de los nuevos y de aquellos a los que hayas configurado el servicio anteriormente.

[¿Cómo me pagarán? ¿Cómo me daré cuenta de que me han pagado el monto total?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-es/)

Al recibir el dinero del cliente, es necesario retener inmediatamente la comisión y pagar con el resto por el servicio del cliente

[¿Hay bonos para asociados?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-es/)

– WhatsApp e Instagram gratis. Y para socios con más de 10 clientes, también WhatsApp Business API.

– Gerente personal.

– Certificados que pueden publicarse en la web o enviarse al cliente.

– Reuniones con la dirección de la empresa. En las reuniones, puedrás influir en el desarrollo del servicio.

[Si conecto a un cliente y él mismo paga la suscripción, ¿dejaré de recibir la comisión?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-es/)

Entonces recibirás el 20% de los pagos del cliente durante un año a partir del momento de su registro. Si vuelves a dar soporte al usuario y renuevas sus suscripciones, ganarás hasta un 50%, como antes.

[¿Qué hace un socio?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-es/)

1\. Conecta a los cliente y configura su integración .

2\. Acepta el pago de IE para el usuario desde la cuenta de socio.

3\. Atención al cliente: ayuda a comprender el servicio y responde preguntas.

4\. Cuando finaliza la suscripción, factura la renovación y vuelve al paso 2

[¿Capacitas a los socios sobre cómo trabajar con el cliente?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-es/)

Te enseñaremos a presentar el servicio y te daremos materiales que te ayudarán a vender Wazzup incluso a clientes “fríos”. Si tienes preguntas sobre casos específicos, siempre puedes acudir a nuestro gerente para que te asesore. También tenemos reuniones donde discutimos tus preguntas.

[¿Pueden ayudarme si no entiendo algo?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-es/)

No abandonamos a nuestros socios: el soporte responde en 5 minutos y funciona las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana. Si tienes preguntas sobre la promoción del servicio y las ventas, nuestro gerente te ayudará a resolverlo. También puedes hablar sobre la configuración del servicio con el personal de Wazzup y otros excelentes socios como tú en el chat de socios.

[Tengo clientes que usan Wazzup. ¿Puedo obtener un porcentaje de sus pagos?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-es/)

Si estás ayudando a un cliente existente en Wazzup y él no trabaja con otro socio, puedes vincularlo contigo a través del soporte.

[¿Por qué un cliente se registraría a través de un enlace de socio o referencia?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners-es/)

Todos los clientes del socio reciben un bono de 10 dólares al registrarse.

## FAQ

[When I sell the service to the tenth clients, will I get 50% of the payments from new customers only?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners/)

You will receive half the payment of all customers: new and those to whom you have configured the service before.

[How will I get paid? How will I realize that you have paid me the full amount?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners/)

You will accept money from the client, immediately keep the reward for yourself and pay for the service.

[Are there bonuses for affiliates?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners/)

- Free WhatsApp and Instagram. And for partners with more than 10 clients – also WhatsApp Business API.
- Personal manager.
- Certificates that can be posted on the website or sent to the client.
- Meetings with company management. At meetings, you can influence the development of the service.

[If I connect a client, and he pays for the subscription himself, will I stop receiving the reward?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners/)

Then you will receive 20% of the client’s payments within a year from the moment of his registration. If you start supporting the user again and renew his subscriptions, you will earn up to 50%, as before.

[What does an affiliate do?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners/)

1. Connects a client, configures his integration.
2. Accepts payment of IE for the user from the partner account.
3. Customer support: helps to understand the service and answers questions.
4. When the subscription ends, invoices the renewal and returns to step 2.

[Do you train affiliates on how to work with the client?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners/)

We will teach you how to present the service and give you materials that will help you sell Wazzup even to “cold” clients. If you have questions about specific cases, you can always come to our manager for advice. We also hold meetings where we discuss your questions.

[Can you help me if I don't understand something?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners/)

We do not abandon partners – the support responds within 5 minutes and works 24/7. If you have questions about the promotion of the service and sales, our manager will help you figure it out. You can also discuss setting up the service with Wazzup staff and great partners like you in the partner chat.

[I have clients who use Wazzup. Can I get a percentage of their payments?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners/)

If you are helping an existing Wazzup client and he does not work with another partner, you can attach him to yourself through support.

[Why would a client sign up through an affiliate or referral link?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partners/)

All clients of the partner receive a bonus of 10 dollars upon registration.

[How will I receive payments? How do I know that you paid me the full amount?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partnership-en/)

You will accept money from the client, immediately keep the reward for yourself and pay for the service.

[Are there any bonuses for partners?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partnership-en/)

- Free WhatsApp and Instagram. And for partners with more than 10 clients – also WhatsApp Business API.
- Personal manager.
- Certificates that can be posted on the website or sent to the client.
- Meetings with company management. At meetings, you can influence the development of the service.

[If I connect a client, and he pays for the subscription himself, will I stop receiving rewards?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partnership-en/)

Then you will receive 20% of the client’s payments within a year from the moment of his registration. If you start supporting the user again and renew his subscriptions, you will earn up to 50%, as before.

[What does the partner do?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partnership-en/)

1. Connects a client, configures his integration.
2. Accepts payment of IE for the user from the partner account.
3. Customer support: helps to understand the service and answers questions.
4. When the subscription ends, invoices the renewal and returns to step 2.

[Do you teach partners how to work with a client?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partnership-en/)

We will teach you how to present the service and give you materials that will help you sell Wazzup even to “cold” clients. If you have questions about specific cases, you can always come to our manager for advice. We also hold meetings where we discuss your questions.

[Will you help me if I can't figure it out?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partnership-en/)

We do not abandon partners – the support responds within 5 minutes and works 24/7. If you have questions about the promotion of the service

and sales, our manager will help you figure it out. You can also discuss setting up the service with Wazzup staff and great partners like you in the partner chat.

[I have clients who use Wazzup. Can I get a percentage of their payments?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partnership-en/)

If you are helping an existing Wazzup client and he does not work with another partner, you can attach him to yourself through support.

[Why should a client register through a partner or via a referral link?](https://wazzup24.com/official-partnership-en/)

All clients of the partner receive a bonus of 10 dollars upon registration.

## Privacy policy Wazzup - Wazzup - integration WhatsApp and Instagram with KommoCRM, Bitrix24, Planfix, Envy CRM, Megaplan, Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot

> **Source:** https://wazzup24.com/privacy-policy-en/

> **Description:** This Privacy Policy for personal data applies to all information that "Wazzup" can receive about the User.
