# Wazzup Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 12th, 2020

### **Definitions**

For the purposes of this Privacy Policy, the following terms have the meanings set out below:

“GDPR” means the General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) including as amended and incorporated into UK law after the GDPR ceases to apply in the UK. “Controller”, “Processor”, “Data Subject”, “Personal Data”, “Personal Data Breach”, and “Processing” have the same meanings as in the GDPR, and “Processed” and “Process” shall be construed in accordance with the definition of “Processing”.

This Privacy Policy describes how Wazzup SIA and its affiliates collect and process your personal information through [https://wazzup24.com/](https://wazzup24.com/) website, products, services and applications (collectively “Wazzup” or the “Service”) that reference this Privacy Policy. By using Wazzup, you are consenting to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

### **The Information We Collect**

Personal Information (Personal Data) is collected and processed when you use the Service. This information can be divided into two general categories: Information you provide to us and Information collected automatically.

### **Information You Provide**

We ask for and collect the below personal information when you use the Service. We process this information for the adequate performance of any contract between us and you, including but not limited to the Terms of Use. Without it, we may not be able to provide you with all the requested services and features of the Service.

#### **Information Provided by You At Wazzup**

We gather information that you directly provide to us. This occurs when you engage in interactive features of our Services, complete forms, conduct transactions, apply for job positions, communicate with us through third-party social media platforms, seek customer support, or interact with us in any other way. The types of information we may collect include your email address and any other details you voluntarily provide.

To send periodic e-mails We may use the information we collect from you when you register or use certain other site features. This might be for security reasons, to ask your opinion about the website, or it may be to keep you updated on any changes to the services provided on the Website and our Services. We may also send periodic emails with news and Services updates, or use this information to follow up with you following live chat or email.

#### **Your profile Information**

- Name, first name, middle name;
- Contact phone number of the User;
- E-mail address;
- Goods delivery address;
- Place of residence.

#### **Your Messages**

We retain your messages in the ordinary course of providing our Service to you. We offer end-to-end encryption for our Service, which is on by default. End-to-end encryption means that your messages are encrypted to protect against us and third parties from reading them.

#### **Your Connections**

To help you organize how you communicate with others, we may create a favorites list of your contacts for you, and you can create, join, or get added to groups and broadcast lists, and such groups and lists get associated with your account information.

### **Information We Collect Automatically**

There is certain information that we collect automatically as the result of your use of the Service, or through the use of cookies and other web analytics services. This information generally includes:

**Usage Information** – We collect information about your interactions with the Wazzup, including the pages that you visit and links you click on, the time, frequency and duration of your visits to the Service.

**Log Data** – We automatically collect log information when you use the Service, even if you have not registered for an account or logged in. That information includes, among other things: details about how you’ve used the Service (including links to third party sites or services), Internet Protocol (IP) address, access times, your browser type and operating system, device information, device event information (e.g., crashes, browser type), and the page you’ve viewed or engaged with before or after using the Service.

**Cookies**– We use cookies and other similar technologies, such as pixels, local storage, and mobile device identifiers and may also allow our business partners to use these tracking technologies on the Service, or engage others to track your behavior on our behalf.

**Location Data** – When you use certain features of the Service, we may collect data about your general location (e.g. IP address). We use this data to provide you with location-based services (such as advertising and personalized content). Most mobile devices allow you to control or disable the use of location services for applications in the device’s settings.

**Device Information** – We collect information from and about the devices you use, including how you interact with the Service and information about the device itself, such as the hardware model, operating system, IP addresses, cookie information, device settings, mobile device and advertising identifiers, apps installed, browser type, language, battery level and time zone. This information allows us to recognize and associate your activity, and provide personalized content and advertising, consistently across all of your devices.

### **Purposes of using Personal Information**

We use your personal information to operate, provide, develop, and improve the products and services that we offer our customers. These purposes include:

- Identification of the User;
- Provision of personalized services and services to the User;
- Communication with the User, including sending notifications, requests and information concerning use of the Service, provision of services, as well as processing of requests and requests from the User;
- Carrying out statistical and other studies based on impersonal data;
- Carrying out marketing actions for Users, including for the purpose of distribution of offers to participate in the promotion and receipt of prizes/rewards provided by the promotion;
- Distribution of advertising and information materials on telecommunication networks, including through the use of telephone, Internet, mobile radiotelephone, or direct contacts;
- To resolve disputes and identify problems;
- To prevent potentially prohibited and illegal acts;
- Targeting of mailing, advertising materials and other information communicated to the Users.

### **Cookies and Other Identifiers**

To enable our systems to recognize your browser or device and to provide and improve Wazzup Services, we use cookies and other identifiers.

We use cookies, pixels, and other technologies (collectively, “cookies”) to learn more about your interests, and provide you with essential features and services, including:

- Recognizing you when you sign-in to use our services. This allows you to use the Service.
- Keeping track of your specific preferences. This allows us to honor your preferences, such as whether or not you would like to see interest-based ads. You may set your preferences through Your Account.
- Conducting research and diagnostics to improve Wazzup’s content, products, and services.
- Prevention of fraud.
- Increase security when using the Service.
- Delivering content, including ads, relevant to your interests on Wazzup site and third-party sites.
- Reporting. This allows us to measure and analyze the performance of our services.

Approved third parties may also set cookies when you interact with Wazzup services. Third parties include search engines, providers of measurement and analytics services, social media networks, and advertising companies. Third parties use cookies in the process of delivering content, including ads relevant to your interests, to measure the effectiveness of their ads, and to perform services on behalf of Wazzup.

You can manage browser cookies through your browser settings. The ‘Help’ feature on most browsers will tell you how to prevent your browser from accepting new cookies, how to have the browser notify you when you receive a new cookie, how to block cookies, and when cookies will expire. In case of cookie blocking, some functions of the Service may not be available

### **Transfer of user’s information to third parties**

Wazzup does not sell or transfer personal information of users to third parties. Personal information of users can be provided only in the following cases, as well as to affiliates who comply with the requirements of this Policy and take all necessary actions to protect personal data.

#### **Subcontractors**

We engage other companies and individuals to provide individual services such as: website support, deleting repetitive information, analyzing data, providing marketing assistance, providing search results and links, processing payments, providing customer service and others. Subcontractors may have access to personal information which is necessary to carry out their tasks, but may not use the data for other purposes.

#### **Compliance with Laws**

We may disclose your information to courts, law enforcement agencies, and governmental authorities (i) to comply with our legal obligations, (ii) to comply with legal process and to respond to claims asserted against Wazzup, (iii) to respond to verified requests relating to a criminal investigation or alleged or suspected illegal activity or any other activity that may expose us, you, or any other of our users to legal liability, (iv) to enforce agreements with users, or (v) to protect the rights, property or personal safety of Wazzup, its employees, and affiliates.

#### **Business Transfers**

We may, at our discretion, assign all of our rights and obligations under this Privacy Policy to any of our affiliates in connection with the merger, accession, restructuring or sale of the Service, by law or otherwise. In addition, information about you may be transferred to any of our affiliates, successors or the new owner of the Service.

## WhatsApp vs WhatsApp Business: the main Difference

> **Source:** https://wazzup24.com/review-articles-en/differences-between-whatsapp-and-whatsapp-business/

> **Description:** We would like to make an overview, to understand what is the difference between WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business. Whatsapp business can help to improve customer experience.

# Differences between WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business

May 16, 2023

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads//2021/07/wz-blog-post-duration-2.svg)

8 минут

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/wa-vs-wa-business-2048x1024.png)

Now we can admit that personal whatsapp messenger has become an indispensable type of communication tool in our everyday lives, giving people an option if they want to stay connected with friends, family, and colleagues. With the growing popularity of this messaging app in personal use and considering its regular usage, whatsapp launched a business-focused version called whatsapp business, which seems to become a great opportunity for instant growth.

In today’s fast-paced digital world, when a person can feel himself always on the run, enterprises are constantly searching for new and innovative ways to grow. One of the most popular methods of communication is through messaging applications like whatsapp, which leads entrepreneurs to engage with their audience in real-time and provide them with fast and easy access to information.

For the start, we would like to make an overview, to understand what is the difference between two versions, including the features that are unique to each platform, and theутеукх benefits that each of them can provide for enterprises of various sizes. While they may seem similar on the surface, there are several key differences between those two versions that are important for enterprises’ owners to learn about before deciding which version to use.

## **Main differences between WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business api**

1\. Business Profile: Whatsapp users have personal profiles displaying their name and picture, while whatsapp business allows enterprises to create a profile with important information such as company description, email address, physical address, and website URL. This feature helps enterprises to build trust with their auditory and also provides a way to easily access important information about the company.

2\. Labels: Labels are a powerful feature in whatsapp business that allows enterprises to categorize their conversations with the audience. For example, a company can create labels such as “New Customers,” “Open Orders,” or “Users Support” to better organize and manage their chats.

[![Labels](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/3.jpg)](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/3.jpg)

3\. Quick Replies: Quick Replies are pre-written messages that enterprises can use to quickly respond to frequently asked questions or to acknowledge a message. This feature saves a lot of hours and ensures that customers receive prompt answers through the messenger.

4\. Automated Messages: Whatsapp business account also lets enterprises create and schedule automated messages, such as greeting or away messages. Those can be customized to fit the company’s brand and niche, and they can help to improve the user’s experience by providing quick and helpful responses in their account. Automation saves time.

[![Automated Messages](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/2.jpg)](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/2.jpg)

5\. Broadcast Messages: Broadcast messages are a solution for enterprises to send notifications to multiple users at once. However, it’s important to note that enterprises can only send broadcast messages to users who have opted-in to receive from them. This feature can be useful for sending promotions or updates to a large group of users in the form of chat.

6\. Product Catalog: Whatsapp business app provides a solution to create a product catalog with images, allowing enterprises to showcase their products and services within the app. This solution is particularly useful for small enterprises that don’t have their own website or online store, so they don’t need sharing the link, and can use a whatsapp account for that purpose. It allows the audience to select products using the catalog, which is really comfortable.

[![Product Catalog](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/1.jpg)](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/1.jpg)

7\. Customer Support: One of the major advantages of whatsapp business usage is the ability for enterprises to offer customer support within the app. Customers can easily send messages or queries to the company and receive a prompt response, making it a convenient and effective way to resolve any issues or concerns using whatsapp chat.

8\. Messaging Statistics: Whatsapp business provides messaging statistics, which can help enterprises to track the messages and to be able to understand how their users are engaging with their messaging strategy. These statistics include information such as the number of messages sent, delivered, and read, as well as the number of those that resulted in a sale. Whatsapp business provides analytics, helping enterprises understand their messaging performance and make data-driven decisions about messaging strategy in their whatsapp account.

9\. Integration with Other Platforms: Whatsapp business can be integrated with other business tools and platforms including social media, such as Facebook Ads and Shopify, allowing enterprises to manage their messaging and sales in one place.

## **Whatsapp business benefits**

[Whatsapp business](https://wazzup24.com/whatsapp-business-api-en/) provides a range of solutions that are specifically designed to help enterprises communicate with their audience in the most efficient way. From automated messages to product catalogs, these solutions can help enterprises to improve their customer experience and ultimately grow their business only using a free whatsapp account.

Whatsapp business is a cost-effective way for enterprises to deal with their audience. There are no additional charges for using the app beyond the cost of internet access, which is often included in business phone plans.

## **Whatsapp business Security features**

Talking about the Security features of whatsapp business, one should know that whatsapp and whatsapp business have the same end-to-end encryption technology, ensuring that only the sender and receiver can read the messages. In terms of security, both apps are equally safe, but whatsapp business offers additional security capacities that enterprises can use to enhance account security and protect data, including:

- Two-step Verification: This optional feature allows enterprises to add some percent of security to their accounts, requiring a six-digit PIN when setting up whatsapp business on a new device. Whatsapp business profiles are verified by whatsapp, guaranteeing the high security level.
- Privacy Settings: Whatsapp business offers additional privacy settings, such as controlling who can see the business profile picture and status updates.
- Backup Encryption: Whatsapp business provides backup encryption, allowing enterprises to encrypt their message backups stored on Google Drive.

## **Tips for whatsapp and whatsapp business effective usage**

Businesses can effectively use whatsapp and whatsapp business using the certain procedures, we would like to list:

- Choose the Right Platform: Depending on the size and nature of your company, determine whether whatsapp or whatsapp business better suits your and your audience needs. Small enterprises with a limited users’ base may find whatsapp sufficient, while larger enterprises with broader customer relations may benefit from whatsapp business’s additional capacities.
- Establish a Professional Presence: Create a comprehensive and informative campaign on whatsapp business. Ensure that your available profile includes your company name, logo, description, and contact information in the form that will be suitable for users. Verified profiles usually become much more popular among the users.
- Leverage Messaging Features: In both versions you can use Quick Replies, Automated Messages, and Labels to streamline customer communication and provide timely, accurate responses.
- Showcase Products and Services: Whatsapp business’s catalog solution will help to display your products and services. Keep your catalog up to date and make it easy to browse and inquire about your offers.
- Implement Promotional Strategies: With user consent, use whatsapp business to send updates about new products, promotions, and events. Keep users engaged by providing valuable and timely content.
- Provide Stable Customer Support: Use whatsapp business as a guide and customer support channel, addressing inquiries, concerns, and feedback promptly and professionally.
- Analyze and Optimize: Regularly review and check your messaging analytics to understand user engagement and make proper decisions about your messaging strategy. Optimize your approach to better serve your audience.
- Integrate with Other Tools: Connect whatsApp business with other managing tools, to streamline your messaging and sales processes.
- Ensure Security and Privacy: Safeguard your processes by implementing security features, such as two-step verification and backup encryption in whatsapp business . Regularly review your privacy settings to control who can access your business profile and status updates.
- Optimize for Mobile Experience: Given that both versions of the app are primarily used on mobile devices, ensure your content, catalogs, and promotional materials are optimized for mobile viewing, to make it interesting for the audience. This will enhance the user experience and encourage engagement.
- Ask for Customer Reviews and Recommendations: Request satisfied customers to leave reviews and recommendations through your whatsapp or whatsapp business, which can be shared in your business profile or other marketing channels. Positive feedback helps build trust and attract new users.
- Group Chats for Customer Segmentation: Organize your users into different groups based on their preferences and interests. This allows you to send targeted messages, texts, promotions, and updates to specific user segments, increasing the likelihood of engagement and conversion.
- Train Your Team: Ensure your employees are well-versed in using whatsapp business and its capacities. Provide training on best practices for customer communication, managing catalogs, and handling customer inquiries.
- Monitor and Manage Customer Interactions: Regularly monitor customer interactions and address any issues or concerns promptly. This not only helps maintain a positive relationship with your audience on the web but also provides valuable insights into areas that may need improvement.
- Evaluate and Iterate: Continuously assess the effectiveness of your strategies. Adapt and refine your approach based on such things as customer feedback, messaging analytics, and industry trends to stay ahead of the competition.

## **Incorporating whats app and whatsapp business best practices**

Incorporating these best practices into your business processes will enable you to effectively communicate with the audience, provide exceptional support, and drive company growth. By leveraging the unique features and benefits of these platforms, enterprises can create meaningful connections with customers, foster brand loyalty, and ultimately boost their bottom line. As technology and customer preferences evolve, staying agile and adaptable in your messaging approach will be key to staying relevant and successful in an increasingly competitive marketplace.

With over 2 billion active users worldwide, whatsapp is one of the most popular messaging apps on the planet. Whatsapp is a messaging app that is available on android and ios platforms, and users can download and use it on their android or ios devices to stay connected with their contacts, and all you need is a phone number. By using whatsapp business, you will be able to connect with your audience directly on the platform they already use every day. Whatsapp business is a powerful tool for enterprises looking to connect with audiences in a more personalized and functional way.

## **Whatsapp and whatsapp business – road to success**

In conclusion, while regular whatsapp and whatsapp business api share similarities, whatsapp business offers additional capacities tailored to the needs of company owners. By understanding the differences, advantages, and limitations of these platforms, enterprises can reach success, making informed decisions about their messaging strategy and using these tools accordingly, manage customer support, and drive sales within a short time period.

## كيف تصبح شريك

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/6-1.png)

- اتصل بنا، وسنتحدث معك بالتفصيل حول الشراكة
- سنقوم بشرح كل شيء عن طريقة عمل التكامل، بما في ذلك وثائق واجهة برمجة التطبيقات وخارطة الطريق
- لديك حساب اختبار كشريك تقني

- سنقدم الدعم الفني على طول الطريق
- الاختبارات قبل الإصدار النهائي
- قدم الخدمة لعملائك واكسب عمولة

## قيادة السوق & تحسين اتصالات إدارة علاقات العملاء (CRM).

- رؤيتنا هي توسيع الريادة في السوق في جميع أنحاء العالم
- تعزيز دور Wazzup في تكامل المراسلة
- تعزيز النمو المتسارع من خلال شراكات موثوقة وقابلة للتطوير
- المواقع: أمريكا اللاتينية، الشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا، أوروبا

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/lider.png)

## الأسئلة الشائعة

[عندما أقوم ببيع الخدمة للعميل العاشر، هل سأحصل على 50% من الدفعات من العملاء الجدد فقط؟](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-ar/)

سوف تتلقى نصف المدفوعات لجميع العملاء: الجدد وأولئك الذين قمت بتكوين الخدمة لهم من قبل.

[كيف سيتم الدفع لي؟ كيف أعرف أنك دفعت لي كامل المبلغ؟](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-ar/)

ستستقبل الأموال من العميل، وتحتفظ على الفور بالعمولة لنفسك وتدفع مقابل الخدمة.

[هل هناك مكافآت للشركات التابعة؟](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-ar/)

– WhatsApp و Instagram مجاناً. وللشركاء الذين لديهم أكثر من 10 عملاء – أيضاً WhatsApp Business API.

– مدير شخصي.

– شهادات يمكن نشرها على الموقع أو إرسالها للعميل.

– اجتماعات مع إدارة الشركة. في الاجتماعات، يمكنك التأثير على تطوير الخدمة.

[إذا قمت بربط عميل وقام بدفع الاشتراك بنفسه، فهل سأتوقف عن استلام المكافأة؟](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-ar/)

في هذه الحالة سوف تحصل على 20% من مدفوعات العميل خلال عام من لحظة تسجيله. إذا بدأت بدعم المستخدم مرة أخرى وقمت بتجديد اشتراكاته، فسوف تكسب ما يصل إلى 50%، كما كان من قبل.

[ماذا يفعل affiliate ؟](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-ar/)

1 ربط العميل، وتكوين التكامل له.

2 يقبل دفع IE للمستخدم من حساب الشريك.

3 دعم العملاء: يساعد على فهم الخدمة والإجابة على الأسئلة.

4 عند انتهاء الاشتراك، قم بإصدار فواتير التجديد والعودة إلى الخطوة 2

[هل تقومون بتدريب affiliates على كيفية العمل مع العميل؟](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-ar/)

سنعلمكم كيفية تقديم الخدمة وسنقدم لكم المواد التي ستساعدكم على بيع Wazzup حتى للعملاء “الباردين”. إذا كانت لديك أسئلة حول حالات محددة، يمكنك دائمًا التوجه إلى مديرنا للحصول على المشورة. نعقد أيضًا اجتماعات حيث نناقش أسئلتك.

[هل يمكنك مساعدتي إذا لم أفهم شيئًا ما؟](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-ar/)

نحن لا نتخلى عن الشركاء – يستجيب الدعم خلال 5 دقائق ويعمل على مدار الساعة طوال أيام الأسبوع. إذا كانت لديك أسئلة حول الترويج للخدمة والمبيعات، فسيساعدك مديرنا في معرفة ذلك. يمكنك أيضًا مناقشة إعداد الخدمة مع موظفي Wazzup والشركاء الرائعين مثلك في دردشة الشركاء.

[لدي عملاء يستخدمون Wazzup. هل يمكنني الحصول على نسبة مئوية من مدفوعاتهم؟](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-ar/)

إذا كنت تساعد عميل Wazzup حالي ولا يعمل مع شريك آخر، فيمكنك ربطه بنفسك من خلال الدعم.

[لماذا يقوم العميل بالتسجيل من خلال affiliate أو رابط إحالة؟](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-ar/)

يحصل جميع عملاء الشريك على مكافأة قدرها 10 دولارات عند التسجيل.

## Cómo convertirse en socio

![](https://wazzup24.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/6-1.png)

- Póngase en contacto con nosotros y le informaremos detalladamente sobre la asociación
- Le explicaremos todo sobre el funcionamiento de la integración, incluida la documentación de la API y la hoja de ruta.
- Tiene una cuenta de prueba como Socio Técnico

- Le proporcionaremos asistencia técnica durante todo el proceso
- Pruebas antes de la versión final
- Ofrezca el servicio a sus clientes y gane una comisión

[Conviértete en Socio](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-es/#partn)

## Preguntas frecuentes

[Cuando venda el servicio a los diez clientes, ¿recibiré el 50% de los pagos solo de nuevos clientes?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-es/)

Recibirás la mitad del pago de todos los clientes: de los nuevos y de aquellos a los que hayas configurado el servicio anteriormente.

[¿Cómo me pagarán? ¿Cómo me daré cuenta de que me han pagado el monto total?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-es/)

Al recibir el dinero del cliente, es necesario retener inmediatamente la comisión y pagar con el resto por el servicio del cliente

[¿Hay bonos para asociados?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-es/)

– WhatsApp e Instagram gratis. Y para socios con más de 10 clientes, también WhatsApp Business API.

– Gerente personal.

– Certificados que pueden publicarse en la web o enviarse al cliente.

– Reuniones con la dirección de la empresa. En las reuniones, puedrás influir en el desarrollo del servicio.

[Si conecto a un cliente y él mismo paga la suscripción, ¿dejaré de recibir la comisión?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-es/)

Entonces recibirás el 20% de los pagos del cliente durante un año a partir del momento de su registro. Si vuelves a dar soporte al usuario y renuevas sus suscripciones, ganarás hasta un 50%, como antes.

[¿Qué hace un socio?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-es/)

1\. Conecta a los cliente y configura su integración .

2\. Acepta el pago de IE para el usuario desde la cuenta de socio.

3\. Atención al cliente: ayuda a comprender el servicio y responde preguntas.

4\. Cuando finaliza la suscripción, factura la renovación y vuelve al paso 2

[¿Capacitas a los socios sobre cómo trabajar con el cliente?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-es/)

Te enseñaremos a presentar el servicio y te daremos materiales que te ayudarán a vender Wazzup incluso a clientes “fríos”. Si tienes preguntas sobre casos específicos, siempre puedes acudir a nuestro gerente para que te asesore. También tenemos reuniones donde discutimos tus preguntas.

[¿Pueden ayudarme si no entiendo algo?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-es/)

No abandonamos a nuestros socios: el soporte responde en 5 minutos y funciona las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana. Si tienes preguntas sobre la promoción del servicio y las ventas, nuestro gerente te ayudará a resolverlo. También puedes hablar sobre la configuración del servicio con el personal de Wazzup y otros excelentes socios como tú en el chat de socios.

[Tengo clientes que usan Wazzup. ¿Puedo obtener un porcentaje de sus pagos?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-es/)

Si estás ayudando a un cliente existente en Wazzup y él no trabaja con otro socio, puedes vincularlo contigo a través del soporte.

[¿Por qué un cliente se registraría a través de un enlace de socio o referencia?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners-es/)

Todos los clientes del socio reciben un bono de 10 dólares al registrarse.

## FAQ

[When I sell the service to the tenth clients, will I get 50% of the payments from new customers only?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners/)

You will receive half the payment of all customers: new and those to whom you have configured the service before.

[How will I get paid? How will I realize that you have paid me the full amount?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners/)

You will accept money from the client, immediately keep the reward for yourself and pay for the service.

[Are there bonuses for affiliates?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners/)

- Free WhatsApp and Instagram. And for partners with more than 10 clients – also WhatsApp Business API.
- Personal manager.
- Certificates that can be posted on the website or sent to the client.
- Meetings with company management. At meetings, you can influence the development of the service.

[If I connect a client, and he pays for the subscription himself, will I stop receiving the reward?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners/)

Then you will receive 20% of the client’s payments within a year from the moment of his registration. If you start supporting the user again and renew his subscriptions, you will earn up to 50%, as before.

[What does an affiliate do?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners/)

1. Connects a client, configures his integration.
2. Accepts payment of IE for the user from the partner account.
3. Customer support: helps to understand the service and answers questions.
4. When the subscription ends, invoices the renewal and returns to step 2.

[Do you train affiliates on how to work with the client?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners/)

We will teach you how to present the service and give you materials that will help you sell Wazzup even to “cold” clients. If you have questions about specific cases, you can always come to our manager for advice. We also hold meetings where we discuss your questions.

[Can you help me if I don't understand something?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners/)

We do not abandon partners – the support responds within 5 minutes and works 24/7. If you have questions about the promotion of the service and sales, our manager will help you figure it out. You can also discuss setting up the service with Wazzup staff and great partners like you in the partner chat.

[I have clients who use Wazzup. Can I get a percentage of their payments?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners/)

If you are helping an existing Wazzup client and he does not work with another partner, you can attach him to yourself through support.

[Why would a client sign up through an affiliate or referral link?](https://wazzup24.com/technical-partners/)

All clients of the partner receive a bonus of 10 dollars upon registration.

# Integration with WhatsApp for CRM systems\|

- От 500 рублей в месяц за аккаунт WhatsApp или Telegram
- Простая интеграция WhatsApp и Telegram с аmoCRM и Битрикс
- Подключение за 5 минут без разработчиков и черной магии

Your clients will be able to correspond in WhatsApp directly from your system. The client is comfortable → the client is satisfied → the client pays.

[Negotiate conditions](https://app.wazzup24.com/signup/)

And you can write to customers on WhatsApp?

## Benefits of Wazzup integration

##### White label

We don’t show our logos in the interfaces and we don’t lead your customers to sign up for Wazzup. For customers, the integration with WhatsApp is entirely your product.

##### Short and clear API

Our api has what you need. All available methods and functions are described in the doc. Let me know if you need anything else to work – we’ll discuss it, we’ll finish it.

##### Postpaid

We don’t care when customers pay you. Collect payment when it’s convenient for you – you’ll pay us by one check at the end of the month.

##### Set of ready-made interfaces

In addition to a set of methods, you can take elaborate interfaces on the web sockets, which covers the usual user cases: voice messages, quoting, etc.

##### Free pricing

Your prices are your business. You can sell WhatsApp above the market, you can sell it below, or you can include the cost of integration in your rate.

##### Personal support

We’ll assign you a personal manager and a developer. All questions will be answered quickly and to the point.

##### Zero burden on accounting

We’ll take care of all our settlements and paperwork on us. All you have to do at the end of the month is look at the paperwork and pay the bill, by card or by bank transfer, as you like.

## We make sales in Telegram easier

### for both managers and team leads

Clients stay in CRM

Full control for team leads

Easy to sell

Less daily grind

In touch any time, any place

CLIENTS AND MESSAGES FROM TELEGRAM — IN YOUR CRM

All contacts and chats are stored in CRM. If a manager goes on vacation or quits, the full chat history stays in CRM — not in their phone. You can hand off clients to a new teammate in just a couple of clicks — no stress.

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/clients_tg_crm.DWB_CdSS.png)

THE TEAM LEAD HAS FULL CONTROL

The team lead can see every conversation and track how many messages each manager sends, when they send them, and who they talk to. No more excuses.

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/calm_manager.CnKKWasH.png)

SELLING MADE EASY

Client messages go straight to CRM — the deal and contact are created automatically. The entire chat is stored in the client’s card, so any manager can quickly jump in and continue the dialogue — the client won’t notice a thing.

If the client’s phone number is hidden, you can still message them first using their username

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/convenient_sales_tg_crm.he51nAH1.png)

MORE CLIENTS, LESS DAILY GRIND

Auto-replies and templates save time and keep you connected 24/7. Rest assured, your competitors won’t stand a chance — even at night, the client gets a quick response.

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/routine.D27eQzvC.png)

ALWAYS CONNECTED — ANYWHERE

By the water cooler, on the road, or even in line at the ATM — your managers can message clients right from the Wazzup mobile app. All conversations are synced to your CRM.

Employees can access the mobile app via their Wazzup personal account

## Less routine — more sales in Telegram

### Wazzup doesn't slow things down — it makes things easier

### Familiar features

Wazzup keeps all the features you’re used to from Telegram: message statuses, emojis, voice notes, quoting

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/features_for_everyone.FAs_s0zp.png)

### Just what you need

Managers don’t get lost in chats — they only see conversations with their own clients, while the team lead sees everything

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/nothing_personnel_kid_amo_tg.BBTns7pr.png)

### No message gets lost

When things get hectic, a manager may read a message but forget to reply. No need to worry! The chat stays at the top of the list, and the notification won’t go away until they send a reply

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/clients_always_answered_amo_tg.B6M6B25x.png)

### From chat — straight to the deal

No need to copy phone numbers or look for clients in the CRM. Just click a button and go directly from the chat to the deal

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/from_chat_to_deal.lvlBqUH-.png)

### Attach images and files

Managers can send any files to Telegram directly from CRM. Important documents won’t get lost in emails — they’re saved in the CRM

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/pin_files_and_images.DZKWbRVa.png)

## We make sales in Telegram easier

### for both managers and team leads

Clients stay in amoCRM

Full control for team leads

Easy to sell

Less daily grind

In touch any time, any place

CLIENTS AND MESSAGES FROM TELEGRAM — IN YOUR CRM

All contacts and chats are stored in amoCRM. If a manager goes on vacation or quits, the full chat history stays in amoCRM — not in their phone. You can hand off clients to a new teammate in just a couple of clicks — no stress.

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/clients_amocrm_tg.CMApSAvL.png)

THE TEAM LEAD HAS FULL CONTROL

The team lead can see all chats and track how much, when, and who the manager communicates with. End-to-end analytics show where the client came from, how much the lead cost, and which channels actually make money.

Yes, we can set up analytics that tracks users via their Google ID

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/calm_manager.CnKKWasH.png)

SELLING MADE EASY

Client messages go straight to amoCRM — the deal and contact are created automatically. The entire chat is stored in the client’s card, so any manager can quickly jump in and continue the dialogue — the client won’t notice a thing.

If the client’s phone number is hidden, you can still message them first using their username

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/convenient_sales_amocrm_tg.l31FHN1Q.png)

MORE CLIENTS, LESS DAILY GRIND

Auto-replies, chatbots, and templates save time and keep you connected 24/7. Rest assured, your competitors won’t stand a chance — even at night, the client gets a quick response.

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/routine.D27eQzvC.png)

ALWAYS CONNECTED — ANYWHERE

By the water cooler, on the road, or even in line at the ATM — your managers can message clients right from the Wazzup mobile app. All chats are synced to amoCRM.

Employees can access the mobile app via their Wazzup personal account

## Less routine — more sales in Telegram

### Wazzup doesn't slow things down — it makes things easier

### Familiar features

Wazzup keeps all the features you’re used to from Telegram: message statuses, emojis, voice notes, quoting

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/features_for_everyone.FAs_s0zp.png)

### Just what you need

Managers don’t get lost in chats — they only see conversations with their own clients, while the team lead sees everything

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/nothing_personnel_kid_amo_tg.BBTns7pr.png)

### No message gets lost

When things get hectic, a manager may read a message but forget to reply. No need to worry! The chat stays at the top of the list, and the notification won’t go away until they send a reply

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/clients_always_answered_amo_tg.B6M6B25x.png)

### From chat — straight to the deal

No need to copy phone numbers or look for clients in the amoCRM. Just click a button and go directly from the chat to the deal

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/from_chat_to_deal.lvlBqUH-.png)

### Attach images and files

Managers can send any files to Telegram directly from amoCRM. Important documents won’t get lost in emails — they’re saved in the CRM

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/pin_files_and_images.DZKWbRVa.png)

## We make sales in Telegram easier

### for both managers and team leads

Clients stay in Bitrix24

Full control for team leads

Easy to sell

Less daily grind

In touch any time, any place

CLIENTS AND MESSAGES FROM TELEGRAM — IN YOUR CRM

All contacts and chats are stored in Bitrix24. If a manager goes on vacation or quits, the full chat history stays in Bitrix24 — not in their phone. You can hand off clients to a new teammate in just a couple of clicks — no stress.

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/clients_bitrix_tg.Dw9o5wKL.png)

THE TEAM LEAD HAS FULL CONTROL

The team lead can see all chats and track when and who the manager communicates with. End-to-end analytics show where the client came from, how much the lead cost, and which channels actually make money.

Yes, we can set up analytics that tracks users via their Google ID

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/calm_manager.CnKKWasH.png)

SELLING MADE EASY

Client messages go straight to Bitrix24 — the deal and contact are created automatically. The entire chat is stored in the client’s card, so any manager can quickly jump in and continue the dialogue — the client won’t notice a thing.

If the client’s phone number is hidden, you can still message them first using their username

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/convenient_sales_bitrix_tg.CBIVD-uh.png)

MORE CLIENTS, LESS DAILY GRIND

Auto-replies, chatbots, and templates save time and keep you connected 24/7. Rest assured, your competitors won’t stand a chance — even at night, the client gets a quick response.

![Sales](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/routine.D27eQzvC.png)

ALWAYS CONNECTED — ANYWHERE

By the water cooler, on the road, or even in line at the ATM — your managers can message clients right from the Wazzup mobile app. All conversations are synced to Bitrix24

Employees can access the mobile app via their Wazzup personal account

## Less routine — more sales in Telegram

### Wazzup doesn't slow things down — it makes things easier

### Familiar features

Wazzup keeps all the features you’re used to from Telegram: message statuses, emojis, voice notes, quoting

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/features_for_everyone.FAs_s0zp.png)

### Just what you need

Managers don’t get lost in chats — they only see conversations with their own clients, while the team lead sees everything

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/nothing_personnel_kid_amo_tg.BBTns7pr.png)

### No message gets lost

When things get hectic, a manager may read a message but forget to reply. No need to worry! The chat stays at the top of the list, and the notification won’t go away until they send a reply

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/clients_always_answered_amo_tg.B6M6B25x.png)

### From chat — straight to the deal

No need to copy phone numbers or look for clients in the Bitrix24. Just click the button and go directly from the chat to the deal

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/from_chat_to_deal.lvlBqUH-.png)

### Attach images and files

Managers can send any files to Telegram directly from Bitrix24. Important documents won’t get lost in emails — they’re saved in the CRM

![Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/_nuxt/pin_files_and_images.DZKWbRVa.png)

# Author\`s license agreement (offer)

This license agreement (hereinafter **«Agreement»**) is an offer of SIA Wazzup, a company duly incorporated under the laws of Republic of Latvia and registered at the legal address Ganību dambis 26A, Rīga, Latvia, LV-1005 (hereinafter **«Rightholder»**) addressed to an unlimited number of individuals/legal entity (hereinafter **«User»**), collectively referred to as the **«Parties»** that have accepted the following terms of this Agreement.

1. **Terms and definitions used**

1.1. In order definite interpretation of following Agreement, the following terms:

**Wazzup** (hereinafter – « **Wazzup**», « **Service**») is an online service posted on the website in the Internet at the following address: [https://wazzup24.com/](https://wazzup24.com/) and allows you to correspond via WhatsApp with the use of CRM tools (Kommo CRM, Bitrix24, planfix, etc.), services, support services and other systems. The use of Wazzup is governed by this Agreement.

**User** – an individual or a legal entity acting through their representative, who are provided with Access to Wazzup.

**Parties** – Rightholder and User.

**Access** – the right, provided by the Rightholder to the User, for a fee, to use the Wazzup functionality intended for the Users.

1.2. In this Agreement, terms that are not defined in clause 1.1 of this Agreement may be used. In this case, the interpretation of such a term is made in accordance with the text of the Agreement. In the absence of an unambiguous interpretation of the term, one should be guided by the interpretation of the term, defined: first of all – by the legislation of the Republic of Latvia, secondly – as stated on the website https://wazzup24.com/, and thirdly – by the prevailing (generally used meaning) on the Internet.

1.3. By entering into this Agreement, the User agrees that the use of the Service will not be carried out for personal and / or family needs not related to business activities.

1.4. This agreement does not contain any provisions that conflict with the provisions of the Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council of the European Union on copyright in the digital single market (COM (2016) 0593 – C8-0383 / 2016 – 2016/0280 (COD)), Directive ( EU) N 2019/790 of the European Parliament and of the Council of the European Union on copyright and related rights in a digital single market and amending directives 96/9 / EC AND 2001/29 / EC, Directive 2000/31 / EC of the European Parliament and Of the Council of the European Union on certain legal aspects of information services in the internal market, in particular on e-commerce (e-commerce directive).

2. **Conditions for providing access**

2.1. The subject of this Agreement is the provision by the Rightholder to the User for a fee of Access to use the Wazzup program for WhatsApp correspondence using CRM (Kommo CRM, Bitrix24, planfix, etc.), support services and other systems. Additionally, the Rightholder provides technical support to Users on the use of Wazzup. The accession of the User to this Agreement is carried out in accordance with clause 2.7. present Agreement.

2.2. The Rightholder provides the following Wazzup functions:

1) Maintaining the status of messages: sent to the system / delivered to the client / read by the client;

2) Reception and sending of files, voice messages and images – as in an integrated application;

3) Alert system;

4) Multi-user interface;

5) Full-featured API (access on demand).

2.3. The functions of the Wazzup program can be expanded or reduced in the future. Actual information about the possibilities of Wazzup is published on the website at: [https://wazzup24.com/](https://wazzup24.com/).

2.4. This agreement should be considered as a License Agreement within the meaning of Section 41 and other applicable provisions of the Copyright Law of the Republic of Latvia (adopted on 06.04.2000).

2.5. The User confirms that he will use Wazzup exclusively on the terms of this Agreement, use Wazzup exclusively for business purposes to simplify business processes. The User will not use Wazzup to meet personal, family, household and other needs not related to the User’s business.

2.6. The User uses Wazzup at his own risk. The User is solely responsible to third parties for his actions related to the use of Wazzup. At the same time, the Rightholder confirms the existence of exclusive rights to the Wazzup Service. In the event that the User presents claims, statement of claim by the User of the rights of third parties in connection with the use of the Service provided under this Agreement, the Rightholder undertakes to make all necessary efforts to resolve the dispute that has arisen, as well as to compensate the User for losses incurred in this regard.

2.7. This Agreement is concluded through full and unconditional acceptance of its terms by registering on the page at: [https://app.wazzup24.com/](https://app.wazzup24.com/?reg). The User is assigned a unique identification code (login) and password. Payment for Access is an additional confirmation of acceptance of the terms of this Agreement.

# UTM Builder

UTM tags are small pieces of code that are added to the URL of a link on a page of your site to show ads for ad campaigns in Google AdWords and Yandex.Direct. It is a mistake not to use UTM tags, because they are a great help, as you can get more detailed information about each source of traffic in the contextual media network on any given day. When you decide to generate a link, every parameter in the UTM tag should have two main inserts: when you create UTM tags, it’s important to specify the parameter name and its value. Always write an equal sign (=) in the parameter=value pair entry to separate these parts of the tag, and to separate one such pair from the other, substitute an ampersand (&).

## What is the purpose of a link with UTM tags?

Internet marketers and traffic managers are in the business of generating and setting up UTM tags if:

- lead contextual or targeting advertising campaigns in the services of Google, Yandex or from the advertising offices of social networks, and recently in advertising posts in the messengers Whatsapp, Telegram, etc. (UTM tags are also useful for showing ads to the target audience of retargeting campaigns);
- want to analyze in detail every possible channel of traffic coming to the site, to evaluate and count the parameters of its effectiveness for conversion.

#### Announcement identifier

**utm\_content** — this optional label parameter is used for additional information, it will allow you to distinguish campaigns from each other if other parameters match.

**Why do you need it:** It is most often used as a label for an ad within an ad campaign. The name can be set arbitrarily, but it is more convenient to select and use a list of important ad characteristics.

**Examples:** utm\_content=text\_link\_on\_left\_sidebar — text link in the left sidebar;

utm\_content=skidka\_45 — offer in the text on the banner;

utm\_content=test\_B — the option of announcing during the A/B/C tests at some of the sites.

#### Source of the campaign

**utm\_source** — the name of your advertising platform.

**Why do you need it:** Most often this parameter is used to indicate the type of advertising platform from which your site traffic came.

**Examples:** utm\_source=yandex — contextual advertising ad in Yandex.Direct;

utm\_source=google — contextual advertising in Google Ads (Adwords);

utm\_source=targetmail — advertising via the myTarget network;

utm\_source=vk — targeting on the Vkontakte site;

utm\_source=facebook — advertising on the social networking site Facebook;

utm\_source=Instagram — Instagram ads.

#### Type of traffic

**utm\_medium** — type of advertising traffic.

**Why do you need it:** Most often, this tag parameter is filled with common traffic values and transmits the type of this ad to analytics.

**Examples:** utm\_medium=email – mailing;

utm\_medium=cpc — contextual advertising per click (cost per click);

utm\_medium=organic — free transfer;

utm\_medium=social — social media;

utm\_medium=banner — media advertising;

utm\_medium=cpa — another type of advertising with cost per action (cost per click).

#### Campaign name

**utm\_campaign** — you can use this mandatory label parameter at your discretion, as long as it transmits the campaign name from the advertising system to analytics in a way you understand.

**Why do you need it:** Allows you to distinguish the results of advertising campaigns in analytics.

**Example:** utm\_campaign=arsens\_whites\_with\_kittens – advertising of belyash with special stuffing.

#### Keyword

**utm\_term** — this optional parameter is used to pass the keywords for which your ad was displayed. You can add your own list of minus-words in advertising services, which will help you avoid untargeted impressions by substituting them when setting up your campaign.

**Why do you need it:** Most often used to analyze the advertising campaign to the level of specific keywords.

**Example:** utm\_term=plastikovye\_okna\_zakazat — the keyword analogue of «order plastic windows» advertisement.

## Dynamic variables when generating UTM tags

Dynamic Variables is a tool that allows you to use substitutions from advertising systems of additional parameters. Designated parameters are a way to get a larger set of information about an advertising campaign in automatic mode.

They are called that because each dynamic parameter has a function to accept the value passed by the advertising system. For example, if you set up utm\_term={keyword} tag, the keyword used by the ad visitor when he clicked on it will be automatically replaced by {keyword} in Yandex.Direct, and you will not have to manually enter all these parameters in the UTM tag. This is the advantage of dynamic insertion.

## What's important to keep in mind if you want to generate a link with UTM tags

- The mandatory parameters of UTM tags must be filled in, otherwise the information will not be transmitted to analytics, and UTM tag analysis will not be possible.
- When you create your tags, use only the Latin alphabet, Cyrillic will distort the data.
- You should not capitalize UTM tags, so use lower case.
- Use underscores (\_) or hyphens (-) instead of spaces.
- Do not forget the URL parameter sign (?).
- When creating each new parameter, make sure that it contains an ampersand sign (&) at the beginning, and only one.

## Here you can find answers to frequent questions about UTM tags

[How to track the effectiveness of the site on UTM-tags in the analytics systems?](https://wazzup24.com/utm-generator-en/)

Basically, there are two most popular analytics systems: Google Analytics and Yandex.Metrika.

In Google Analytics, **the utm\_source** (source) and **utm\_medium** (channel) parameters can be seen and analyzed in the “Traffic Sources” → “All Traffic” → “Source/Channel” report. On the page you will see the marked traffic.

Parameters **utm\_campaign** (campaign), keyword **utm\_term** and **utm\_content** (ad content) can be viewed in “Traffic Sources” → “Campaigns” → “All campaigns”. You will also need to add an additional parameter to the report → Advertising → keyword or ad content.

Yandex.Metrika has a separate report on UTM tags “Reports” → “Sources” → “UTM tags”.

[What values are adopted for utm\_medium?](https://wazzup24.com/utm-generator-en/)

Switching from a search engine: organic

Direct transfer from the site: referral

Email: email

Contextual advertising: utm\_medium cpc \| ppc (pay per click) \| paidsearch

Social media: utm\_medium social \| social-network \| social-media \| sm \| social network social media

Media advertising: display \| cpm (cost per mile) \| banner

Other advertising: cpv (cost per visitor) \| cpa (cost per action) \| cpp (cost per point) \| content-text

[Where else can I generate a UTM tag?](https://wazzup24.com/utm-generator-en/)

The advertising system from Google also has its own link generator, which is customized only for this advertising system. Campaign URL Builder is a free link builder from Google, for which I want to thank you very much.

[How does UTM stand for?](https://wazzup24.com/utm-generator-en/)

UTM stands for Urchin Tracking Module. It was created at Urchin Software, which was bought by Google in 2005.

By the way, [Wazzup](https://wazzup24.com/) successfully passes all UTM tags from users who have come

to your site and messaged you on WhatsApp or Telegram from your site page.

Read more [in the instructional article](https://wazzup24.com/help/ru/how-to-configurate/roistat-yandex-metrics-and-google-analytics-in-amocrm-ru/)

Источник кампании

**utm\_source** — отвечает за источник трафика. Тут указывают, откуда именно пришел клиент: yandex, google, vk, telegram и т.д. В аналитике будет видно, с какой площадки клиент пришел на ваш сайт

utm\_source

Тип трафика

![Tooltip](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20width='20'%20height='20'%20viewBox='0%200%2020%2020'%20fill='none'%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3e%3cpath%20d='M9.99739%2018.3346C5.39502%2018.3346%201.66406%2014.6036%201.66406%2010.0013C1.66406%205.39893%205.39502%201.66797%209.99739%201.66797C14.5997%201.66797%2018.3307%205.39893%2018.3307%2010.0013C18.3307%2014.6036%2014.5997%2018.3346%209.99739%2018.3346ZM9.99739%2016.668C13.6793%2016.668%2016.6641%2013.6832%2016.6641%2010.0013C16.6641%206.3194%2013.6793%203.33464%209.99739%203.33464C6.3155%203.33464%203.33073%206.3194%203.33073%2010.0013C3.33073%2013.6832%206.3155%2016.668%209.99739%2016.668ZM9.16406%2012.5013H10.8307V14.168H9.16406V12.5013ZM10.8307%2011.1306V11.668H9.16406V10.418C9.16406%209.95772%209.53714%209.58463%209.99739%209.58463C10.6877%209.58463%2011.2474%209.02497%2011.2474%208.33463C11.2474%207.64428%2010.6877%207.08463%209.99739%207.08463C9.39098%207.08463%208.88539%207.51649%208.77139%208.08944L7.13682%207.76252C7.4027%206.42563%208.58239%205.41797%209.99739%205.41797C11.6082%205.41797%2012.9141%206.7238%2012.9141%208.33463C12.9141%209.65588%2012.0355%2010.772%2010.8307%2011.1306Z'%20fill='%2389909D'/%3e%3c/svg%3e)

**utm\_medium** — указывает, через какой канал пришел трафик. Например, cpc — контекстная реклама, email — рассылка, banner — баннер. В аналитике сразу видно, с какой рекламы пришел клиент.

utm\_medium

Название кампании

**utm\_campaign** — метка обязательная, а вот чем ее наполнять — решаете вы. Главное, чтобы в ней было понятно, про какую именно рекламную кампанию идет речь. Так вы легко отследите эффективность рекламы в аналитике.

utm\_campaign

Необязательные параметры

Идентификатор объявления

![Tooltip](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20width='20'%20height='20'%20viewBox='0%200%2020%2020'%20fill='none'%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3e%3cpath%20d='M9.99739%2018.3346C5.39502%2018.3346%201.66406%2014.6036%201.66406%2010.0013C1.66406%205.39893%205.39502%201.66797%209.99739%201.66797C14.5997%201.66797%2018.3307%205.39893%2018.3307%2010.0013C18.3307%2014.6036%2014.5997%2018.3346%209.99739%2018.3346ZM9.99739%2016.668C13.6793%2016.668%2016.6641%2013.6832%2016.6641%2010.0013C16.6641%206.3194%2013.6793%203.33464%209.99739%203.33464C6.3155%203.33464%203.33073%206.3194%203.33073%2010.0013C3.33073%2013.6832%206.3155%2016.668%209.99739%2016.668ZM9.16406%2012.5013H10.8307V14.168H9.16406V12.5013ZM10.8307%2011.1306V11.668H9.16406V10.418C9.16406%209.95772%209.53714%209.58463%209.99739%209.58463C10.6877%209.58463%2011.2474%209.02497%2011.2474%208.33463C11.2474%207.64428%2010.6877%207.08463%209.99739%207.08463C9.39098%207.08463%208.88539%207.51649%208.77139%208.08944L7.13682%207.76252C7.4027%206.42563%208.58239%205.41797%209.99739%205.41797C11.6082%205.41797%2012.9141%206.7238%2012.9141%208.33463C12.9141%209.65588%2012.0355%2010.772%2010.8307%2011.1306Z'%20fill='%2389909D'/%3e%3c/svg%3e)

**utm\_content** — необязательный, но полезный параметр. Помогает различать кампании между собой, если все остальные параметры одинаковые.

utm\_content

Ключевое слово

![Tooltip](data:image/svg+xml,%3csvg%20width='20'%20height='20'%20viewBox='0%200%2020%2020'%20fill='none'%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3e%3cpath%20d='M9.99739%2018.3346C5.39502%2018.3346%201.66406%2014.6036%201.66406%2010.0013C1.66406%205.39893%205.39502%201.66797%209.99739%201.66797C14.5997%201.66797%2018.3307%205.39893%2018.3307%2010.0013C18.3307%2014.6036%2014.5997%2018.3346%209.99739%2018.3346ZM9.99739%2016.668C13.6793%2016.668%2016.6641%2013.6832%2016.6641%2010.0013C16.6641%206.3194%2013.6793%203.33464%209.99739%203.33464C6.3155%203.33464%203.33073%206.3194%203.33073%2010.0013C3.33073%2013.6832%206.3155%2016.668%209.99739%2016.668ZM9.16406%2012.5013H10.8307V14.168H9.16406V12.5013ZM10.8307%2011.1306V11.668H9.16406V10.418C9.16406%209.95772%209.53714%209.58463%209.99739%209.58463C10.6877%209.58463%2011.2474%209.02497%2011.2474%208.33463C11.2474%207.64428%2010.6877%207.08463%209.99739%207.08463C9.39098%207.08463%208.88539%207.51649%208.77139%208.08944L7.13682%207.76252C7.4027%206.42563%208.58239%205.41797%209.99739%205.41797C11.6082%205.41797%2012.9141%206.7238%2012.9141%208.33463C12.9141%209.65588%2012.0355%2010.772%2010.8307%2011.1306Z'%20fill='%2389909D'/%3e%3c/svg%3e)

**utm\_term** — сюда подставляются ключевые слова, по которым показывалась реклама. Необязательный параметр, но полезный: помогает копнуть глубже и понять, какие запросы реально привели людей на сайт.

## Динамические переменные   при генерации UTM-меток

Динамические переменные в UTM-метках — это параметры, которые рекламная система меняет на реальные данные. Например, если вставить В UTM-метку переменную {keyword} — Яндекс.Директ подтянет запрос, по которому клиент кликнул на объявление

Яндекс.Директ

Google Adwords

ВКонтакте

myTarget

Параметры динамической вставки

Что система подставит вместо {параметра}

{campaign\_id}

ID рекламной кампании

{campaign\_name}

Название кампании — до 60 символов

{campaign\_name\_lat}

Название кампании, но латиницей

{campaign\_type}

Тип кампании:

type1 — Текстово-графические объявления;

type2 — Реклама мобильных приложений;

type3 — Динамические объявления;

type4 — Смарт-баннеры;

type5 — Баннер на поиске

{ad\_id}

ID объявления — поможет понять, что именно сработало

{banner\_id}

Параметр работает как {ad\_id}

{keyword}

Ключевая фраза, по которой пользователь увидел рекламу

{addphrases}

Был ли показ по дополнительной фразе: «yes» — показ был, «no» — показа не было

{addphrasestext}

Текст дополнительной фразы или «none», если фразы не было

{source}

Где показали объявление: домен площадки (например, wazzap24.ru) или «none» — если это поиск

{source\_type}

Тип площадки, на которой показали объявления: «search» — поиск, «context» — сети

{gbid}

ID группы объявлений

{match\_type}

Тип совпадения фразы: «rm» — автотаргетинг, «syn» — семантическое соответствие

{matched\_keyword}

Подобранная фраза, которую система решила показать

{device\_type}

Тип устройства, на котором показали объявление: «desktop» — десктоп, «mobile» — мобильный телефон, «tablet» — планшет

{position}

Позиция объявления в блоке (например, 1) или 0, если показ был в сетях

{position\_type}

Где показали объявление: «premium» — верх страницы, «other» — сбоку или внизу, «none» — если в сетях

{region\_name}

Идентификатор региона, где показали объявление

{adtarget\_name}

Название правила таргетинга, по которому система решила показать динамическое объявление

{coef\_goal\_context\_id}

ID правила, которое сработало при показе рекламы

Параметры динамической вставки

Что система подставит вместо {параметра}

{campaign\_id}

Номер вашей рекламной кампании

{adgroupid}

ID группы объявлений

{creative}

ID конкретного объявления — поможет понять, что именно сработало

{keyword}

Ключевая фраза, по которой показалось объявление

{matchtype}

Тип соответствия ключевому слову: «e» — точное, «p» — фразовое, «b» — широкое

{feeditemid}

На что именно кликнул пользователь в объявлении — кнопка, телефон, адрес и т.д.

{adposition}

Где показалось объявление. Например: «1t2» — первая страница, верх, позиция 2

{network}

Где показалась реклама: «g» — поиск Google, «s» — партнерские сайты, «d» — КМС (контекстно-медийная сеть)

{device}

Устройство, с которого был клик: «m» — мобилка, «t» — планшет, «c» — комп

{devicemodel}

Бренд и модель гаджета — если клик с мобилки или планшета через КМС. Например, Apple+iPhone

{target}

Тематика площадки в КМС. Например: спорт, путешествия, финансы

Параметры динамической вставки

Что система подставит вместо {параметра}

{campaign\_id}

ID рекламной кампании

{campaign\_name}

Название вашей кампании — как указали в кабинете, так и попадет в метку

{ad\_id}

ID конкретного объявления — поможет понять, что именно сработало

{keyword}

До трех ключевых фраз, по которым человек увидел и кликнул рекламу: не больше 200 символов в сумме

{search\_phrase}

То же, что и {keyword} — дублер для некоторых систем

{platform}

Откуда был клик: комп, мобилка или планшет

Параметры динамической вставки

Что система подставит вместо {параметра}

{{campaign\_id}}

ID рекламной кампании

{{campaign\_name}}

Название вашей кампании — как указали в кабинете, так и попадет в метку

{{banner\_id}}

ID объявления — помогает отследить, что именно сработало

{{search\_phrase}}

Запрос, который ввел пользователь перед тем, как увидеть объявление

{{geo}}

ID региона, откуда пришел клик (по геодереву myTarget)

{{gender}}

Пол пользователя, который перешел по рекламе

{{age}}

Возраст пользователя, который кликнул по объявлению

### Маркетинг

Собираем команду

###### Что делает

Ведут клиентов за ручку по лестнице Ханта, делятся мудростью в блоге, дарят конфеты и стикерпаки на конфах, креативят за чашкой кофе с тоником. Короче, делают всё, чтобы донести весть о самом пиздатом продукте на рынке.

# Для полного счастья нам нужны

#### Таргетолог в Your Good's

![Wazzup](data:image/svg+xml,%3c?xml%20version=%271.0%27%20encoding=%27UTF-8%27?%3e%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20width=%2732%27%20height=%2732%27%20viewBox=%270%200%2032%2032%27%20fill=%27none%27%3e%3cpath%20d=%27M9.89333%2011.4531L16%2017.5598L22.12%2011.4531L24%2013.3331L16%2021.3331L8%2013.3331L9.89333%2011.4531Z%27%20fill=%27%234E4E4E%27%3e%3c/path%3e%3c/svg%3e)

###### Что будете делать

- Настраивать и запускать контекстную и таргетированную рекламу в Яндекc.Директ и Google Ads;
- Настраивать и запускать рекламные кампании в VK, Telegram ads, FaceBook ads;
- Следить за эффективностью кампаний в Яндексе.Директ (подбор новых минус-слов, чистка площадок, корректировка ставок и стратегий, запуск новых иструментов);
- Готовить медиаплан по своим каналам с указанием бюджетов, лидов, конверсий на основании исторических данных и гипотез;
- Участвовать в создании креативов, лендингов, подборе аудиторий и площадок;
- Понимать всю цепочку пользователя от визита до оплаты и предлагать свои гипотезы по увеличению конверсий на каждом из этапов.

###### Вы подходите, если

- Имеете опыт более 3-х лет с кейсами и цифрами на руках;
- У вас есть знание FaceBook Ads на 10/10 — это наш основной источник трафика;
- Умеете составлять прогнозы по бюджетам и эффективности их открутки на основе предыдущего опыта;
- В состоянии самостоятельно написать внятный текст и внести небольшие правки в иллюстрации;
- Имеете опыт работы создания и ведения прозрачной маркетинговой отчётности;
- Имеете знание систем сквозной аналитики, например Roistat;
- У вас есть понимание unit-экономики;
- Проактивны – находитесь в постоянном поиске, предлагаете, тестируете новые идеи;
- Умеете составлять воронки;
- Умеете защищать свои идеи, а также делать выводы из поражений, ошибок, и не повторяете их в будущем.

###### Условия

- **Человеческие условия.** Сорокачасовая рабочая неделя на удаленке или в московском офисе. Оформляем по фэн-шую и ежегодно индексируем зарплату;
- **Достойная оплата.** Оклад по договоренности \+ бонусы (по итогам KPI);
- **Человеческое отношение.** В команде нет винтиков, шестеренок и гаечек, есть только люди. С пониманием относимся к потребностям и проблемам каждого. Если что-то нужно: поддержка, психолог, обучение, лечение — поможем. Такой вот соцпакет.

#### Специалист службы технической поддержки

![Wazzup](data:image/svg+xml,%3c?xml%20version=%271.0%27%20encoding=%27UTF-8%27?%3e%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20width=%2732%27%20height=%2732%27%20viewBox=%270%200%2032%2032%27%20fill=%27none%27%3e%3cpath%20d=%27M9.89333%2011.4531L16%2017.5598L22.12%2011.4531L24%2013.3331L16%2021.3331L8%2013.3331L9.89333%2011.4531Z%27%20fill=%27%234E4E4E%27%3e%3c/path%3e%3c/svg%3e)

###### Что будете делать

- Письменно в чате консультировать пользователей, помогать им разобраться в сервисе;
- Предлагать другие возможные решения для закрытия проблем клиента;
- Есть возможность работать со звонками;
- Принимать пожелания от клиентов и записывать их;
- Всегда быть в курсе нововведений и работы сервиса в целом;
- Отстаивать честь и интересы Wazzup;
- Придерживаться корпоративного стиля в общении;
- Помнить, что если бы ни у кого не было никаких проблем – у вас не было бы работы;
- Учиться, развиваться и расти.

###### Вы подходите, если

- Имеете опыт в клиентском сервисе от 6 месяцев;
- Базово владеете письменным английским (гугл-переводчиком пользоваться можно);
- Быстро печатаете;
- У вас грамотная письменная и устная речь;
- Уверенное владение компьютером;
- Интерес к IT сфере, потому что у нас именно она, и способность разбираться в технических вопросах (будет тестовое задание);
- Опыт работы с CRM и понимание основных моментов: чем отличается лид от сделки, кто такой ответственный и зачем нужна воронка;
- Человеколюбие и общительность — это про вас. Если вам быстро надоедают люди и после 20-ти одинаковых вопросов вам хочется забиться в угол или “расстрелять всех из гранатомета” – вы не подходите;
- Умеете взять на себя ответственность, уважаете дедлайны, воспринимаете конструктивную критику;
- Имеете гражданство РФ.

###### Условия

- **Человеческие условия.** Сорокачасовая рабочая неделя на удаленке или в московском офисе. Оформляем по фэн-шую и ежегодно индексируем зарплату.
- **Достойная оплата.** Оклад 45 000 рублей до вычета, со 2 месяца к нему добавляем KPI 5 000 рублей. Есть рост в грейдах. На максимальном совокупный доход 74 000 рублей; до него наши специалисты растут за 6-12 мес. (зависит от показателей).
- **Человеческое отношение.** В команде нет винтиков, шестеренок и гаечек, есть только люди. С пониманием относимся к потребностям и проблемам каждого. Если что-то нужно: поддержка, психолог, обучение, лечение — поможем. Такой вот соцпакет.

#### Senior UX/UI дизайнер (проектировщик) в Your Good\`s

![Wazzup](data:image/svg+xml,%3c?xml%20version=%271.0%27%20encoding=%27UTF-8%27?%3e%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20width=%2732%27%20height=%2732%27%20viewBox=%270%200%2032%2032%27%20fill=%27none%27%3e%3cpath%20d=%27M9.89333%2011.4531L16%2017.5598L22.12%2011.4531L24%2013.3331L16%2021.3331L8%2013.3331L9.89333%2011.4531Z%27%20fill=%27%234E4E4E%27%3e%3c/path%3e%3c/svg%3e)

###### Что будете делать

- Получать от заказчика идею по фиче/продукту, осмыслять, докручивать, собирать требования и выдавать в результате проработанные макеты;
- Напрямую обсуждать решения с заказчиком, лидом команды проектирования и разработкой;
- Работать в команде с другими дизайнерами на продукте;
- Собирать кейсы, рисовать карты пути, при необходимости проводить исследования;
- Постоянно быть в контакте с разработкой и тестированием, отвечать на вопросы, делать ревью прода.

###### Вы подходите, если

- Логичный/логичная;
- Уже проработали **UX-проектировщиком/продуктовым дизайнером** с аналогичными функциями **от 4 лет в продуктовой команде**;
- Готовы работать в режиме стартапа и спокойно переносите высокую степень неопределённости (в процессах, не в зарплате:);
- Уверенно владеете Figma;
- Проектировали сложные интерфейсы с нуля;
- Понимаете техническую сторону разработки интерфейсов;
- Отличаете важное от неважного при решении задачи.

###### Условия

- **Человеческие условия.** Сорокачасовая рабочая неделя на удаленке или в московском офисе. Оформляем по фэн-шую и ежегодно индексируем зарплату;
- **Достойная оплата.** Оклад 276 000 рублей до вычета + ежеквартальные премии 180 000-210 000 рублей на руки (расчет премий на основе опросов 360);
- **Человеческое отношение.** В команде нет винтиков, шестеренок и гаечек, есть только люди. С пониманием относимся к потребностям и проблемам каждого. Если что-то нужно: поддержка, психолог, обучение, лечение — поможем. Такой вот соцпакет.

#### Бизнес-аналитик / Технический писатель в Your Good's

![Wazzup](data:image/svg+xml,%3c?xml%20version=%271.0%27%20encoding=%27UTF-8%27?%3e%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20width=%2732%27%20height=%2732%27%20viewBox=%270%200%2032%2032%27%20fill=%27none%27%3e%3cpath%20d=%27M9.89333%2011.4531L16%2017.5598L22.12%2011.4531L24%2013.3331L16%2021.3331L8%2013.3331L9.89333%2011.4531Z%27%20fill=%27%234E4E4E%27%3e%3c/path%3e%3c/svg%3e)

###### Что будете делать

- Вместе с командой присутствовать на созвонах, посвящённым обсуждению бизнес-логики и технической стороны интерфейсов, фиксировать договорённости;
- Формировать список гипотез и кейсов, которые нужно закрыть при решении задачи;
- Писать документацию по макетам: описывать бизнес-логику, поведение интерфейса при взаимодействии с пользователем, состояния интерфейса;
- Собирать и анализировать требования к новому функционалу у внутренних заказчиков.

###### Вы подходите, если

- Имеете релевантный опыт работы от 2 лет;
- Логичны, умеете структурно и грамотно излагать свои мысли;
- Готовы работать в режиме стартапа;
- Умеете работать с гугл таблицами. Пользуетесь формулами QUERY и VLOOKUP (ВПР);
- Обладаете системным мышлением, умеете выделять главное и расставлять приоритеты;
- Имеете опыт в UX-проектировании;
- Организованы, соблюдаете дедлайны, умеете организовать свое время и рабочее пространство;
- Знаете, что такое CJM, JTBD, применяли в своей работе;
- У вас есть опыт работы с Confluence, Notion или аналогами;
- Владеете коммуникацией на высоком уровне;
- Умеете систематизировать, анализировать и составлять требования.

###### Условия

- **Человеческие условия.** Сорокачасовая рабочая неделя на удаленке или в московском офисе. Оформляем по фэн-шую и ежегодно индексируем зарплату;
- **Достойная оплата.** ЗП обсуждается на собеседовании с успешным кандидатом. Платим по рынку.
- **Человеческое отношение.** В команде нет винтиков, шестеренок и гаечек, есть только люди. С пониманием относимся к потребностям и проблемам каждого. Если что-то нужно: поддержка, психолог, обучение, лечение — поможем. Такой вот соцпакет.

#### Руководитель направления аналитики

![Wazzup](data:image/svg+xml,%3c?xml%20version=%271.0%27%20encoding=%27UTF-8%27?%3e%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20width=%2732%27%20height=%2732%27%20viewBox=%270%200%2032%2032%27%20fill=%27none%27%3e%3cpath%20d=%27M9.89333%2011.4531L16%2017.5598L22.12%2011.4531L24%2013.3331L16%2021.3331L8%2013.3331L9.89333%2011.4531Z%27%20fill=%27%234E4E4E%27%3e%3c/path%3e%3c/svg%3e)

###### Что будете делать

- Управлять и развивать команду аналитиков. Нужно прокачивать текущих ребят, организовывать их работу и быть, своего рода, сенсеем;
- Выстраивать архитектуру данных. Что, как, где и зачем мы собираем и насколько это “чистые” данные;
- Настраивать мост с DWH;
- Организовывать/пересобирать отчетность в Табло под запрос стейкхолдеров и здравого смысла;
- Организовывать/пересобирать процессы работы команды. Мы даем полную свободу, главное доказать, что это эффективно работает;
- Управлять и жонглировать бэклогом;
- Презентовать результаты.

###### Вы подходите, если

- Имеете опыт на аналогичной позиции в IT компаниях не менее 3 лет;
- Владеете SQL;
- Сильны в управлении и обучении сотрудников;
- Умеете строить дашборды в Табло;
- Умеете грамотно управлять бэклогом;
- У вас развиты аналитические навыки: способны решать проблемы на основе анализа данных, формулировать гипотезы и измерять влияние реализованных изменений;
- Понимаете, как устроена архитектура данных и можете внедрять best practice.

###### Условия

- **Человеческие условия.** Сорокачасовая рабочая неделя на удаленке или в московском офисе. Оформляем по фэн-шую и ежегодно индексируем зарплату;
- **Достойная оплата.** Оклад обсуждается индивидуально. Наша вилка \- 300 000-400 000 рублей
- **Человеческое отношение.** В команде нет винтиков, шестеренок и гаечек, есть только люди. С пониманием относимся к потребностям и проблемам каждого. Если что-то нужно: поддержка, психолог, обучение, лечение — поможем. Такой вот соцпакет.

#### Заместитель Финансового Директора / Руководитель казначейства и Администрирования

![Wazzup](data:image/svg+xml,%3c?xml%20version=%271.0%27%20encoding=%27UTF-8%27?%3e%3csvg%20xmlns=%27http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%27%20width=%2732%27%20height=%2732%27%20viewBox=%270%200%2032%2032%27%20fill=%27none%27%3e%3cpath%20d=%27M9.89333%2011.4531L16%2017.5598L22.12%2011.4531L24%2013.3331L16%2021.3331L8%2013.3331L9.89333%2011.4531Z%27%20fill=%27%234E4E4E%27%3e%3c/path%3e%3c/svg%3e)

###### Что будете делать

- Организация переводов денежных средств зарубежным контрагентам;
- Взаимодействие с государственными органами, налоговой, банками, административными единицами;
- Участие в описании бизнес процессов, регламентов. Анализ неэффективных бизнес-процессов финансовых отделов. Их оптимизация и улучшение;
- Взаимодействие с руководителями подразделений;
- Курирование международного контура (сдача отчетности, банки, платежные системы и т.д.);
- Готовность изучать нюансы и специфику налогообложения и отчетности других стран;
- Оказание помощи менеджерам в решении различных финансовых вопросов.

###### Вы подходите, если

- Имеете опыт успешной работы на аналогичной должности от года;
- Имеете профессиональные навыки работы с Excel;
- У вас есть умение планировать, контролировать и доводить до результата долгосрочные задачи;
- Обладаете высоким уровнем самодисциплины;
- У вас есть знание и понимание управленческой отчетности;
- У вас есть опыт работы с IT компаниями.

###### Условия

- **Человеческие условия.** Сорокачасовая рабочая неделя на удаленке или в московском офисе. Оформляем по фэн-шую и ежегодно индексируем зарплату;
- **Достойная оплата.** Оклад обсуждается индивидуально. Наша вилка \- 150 000-200 000 рублей
- **Человеческое отношение.** В команде нет винтиков, шестеренок и гаечек, есть только люди. С пониманием относимся к потребностям и проблемам каждого. Если что-то нужно: поддержка, психолог, обучение, лечение — поможем. Такой вот соцпакет.
